tiers.description: Dětské běhy zdarma, nutná online registrace

description: Tišnovské Kozy 2026 is a charity trail run taking place on April 18 in Tišnov. The race offers two options - a relay for pairs over 2x5 km and an individual race over 10 km, guided through the scenic Tišnov nature with gentle ascents and flat sections. The event celebrates movement, fun, and community, with accompanying activities for children and adults. All proceeds from registration fees and jersey sales are donated to support the Lokomoce association and the Člověče, hýbej se! initiative.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic Tišnov nature with gentle ascents and flat sections
A time limit of 3 hours allows completing the course even on foot
Start and finish at the Tišnov elementary school athletic oval, with a climb to Květnice and Klucanina
additional: Children's races are free but require online registration due to timing chips. The start and finish are at the Tišnov elementary school athletic oval. The main race has a time limit of 3 hours. An original running jersey with your name is available for order until March 8, 2026. After the race, a raffle with valuable prizes takes place. The accompanying program includes archery, airsoft shooting range, face painting, music and drum shows, and other activities for children and adults. The trail race can be registered online, with proceeds supporting children's initiatives. The event also includes walking, refreshments, and activities for all age groups.

name: Děčín Run Fest 2026
location: Mariánská louka, Děčín, Czech Republic
price_range: 399,- Kč to 850,- Kč podle druhu závodu a data registrace
description: Děčín RunFest 2026 is a traditional running event held on April 18th in Děčín at Mariánská louka along the Labská cycle path. It offers a half marathon, a 5 km run, a family run, children's races, and a relay for pairs, including a Nordic Walking half marathon. The event is complemented by presentations of sports activities and an accompanying program that invites all age groups to active sports and family entertainment. Starts are divided from morning to afternoon with results announced and a charitable focus for the family and children's runs.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 5 km run along the Labská cycle path
Family run and children's races of various lengths
Nordic Walking half marathon and relay for pairs
additional: Registration from 08:30 to 12:55, with the latest registration 20 minutes before the start. Starts are divided into Nordic Walking half marathon, half marathon, 5 km run, family run, and children's races. The family and children's runs have a charitable focus, with registration fees going to charitable causes. The relay for pairs involves a handover at the turnaround point. Categories are based on age and gender. The event includes an accompanying program and sale of sports equipment. It takes place at Mariánská louka and around the Labská cycle path in Děčín.

name: Běh do vrchu Jiřetín - Jedlová
location: Jiřetín pod Jedlovou, Česká republika
description: The Jiřetín - Jedlová uphill run is a traditional sporting event organized by the Varnsdorf Running Club, taking place on Saturday, April 18, 2026, in Jiřetín pod Jedlovou. The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers a challenging route of 5.7 km with an elevation gain of 340 meters, leading from 434 meters above sea level to the summit of Jedlová Mountain at 774 meters above sea level. The course is a combination of asphalt, gravel, and forest paths. Participants start at 8:00 AM from the sports complex and can look forward to monetary prizes and a running raffle.
course_highlights: Length of the course 5.7 km with an elevation gain of 340 m
Surface: 10% asphalt, 60% gravel, 30% forest paths
Start at the sports complex in Jiřetín pod Jedlovou, finish at the top of Jedlová Mountain
additional: Categories by age from juniors to seniors, monetary prizes for category winners and for breaking the course record, running raffle with prize draws, race at own risk, basic medical care provided. Terrain: hilly, trail; registration: online or on-site; Memorial of Milan Krupka.

name: Dehtářská 10°
location: RS Kletečná, Kletečná u Humpolce, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Dehtářská 10° is a cross-country race in the Vysočina region intended for the general public and all age groups. It offers courses of 5, 10, and 20 km, with the main race approximately 10 km long and an elevation gain of 85 meters. The race takes place at RS Kletečná near Humpolec and is known for its friendly atmosphere, where everyone who surpasses themselves is a winner. Registration takes place on the race day from 11:00 to 13:30, and the start is at 14:00. Participants can enjoy the beauty of Vysočina and a sporting experience in a pleasant community of runners.
course_highlights: Main course approximately 10 km with an elevation gain of 85 m
Option to choose between courses of 5, 10, and 20 km
Race in the picturesque nature of Vysočina at RS Kletečná
additional: Race registration takes place on the race day from 11:00 to 13:30. The race is suitable for all age and performance categories. Maps of all routes are available for download in SVG format. Contact persons are listed with phone numbers for technical support, marketing, and course/registration. Registration is from 11:00 to 13:30, with the race start at 14:00 at RS Kletečná. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners and families.

name: Safari běh ČSOB
location: Safari Park Dvůr Králové, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Safariběh ČSOB is a running race held in Dvůr Králové Safari Park, offering three courses: a family run of 2 km, a 5 km race, and a 10 km race. The routes mainly lead along paved asphalt paths and include passages through African and walking safaris, providing a unique experience in contact with nature and animals. The start and finish are at the main entrance to the safari park. The race is suitable for the general public, including families, and promotes the protection of bald zebras and other animals in the park.
course_highlights: Routes lead through African and walking safaris
Surface mainly paved asphalt paths
Start and finish at the main entrance to Dvůr Králové Safari Park
additional: Start number with an embedded chip that remains with the runner. Entry to the safari park is free on race day. The registration fee includes a registration bag with gifts, a voucher for refreshments after the race (one drink and one meal), a commemorative medal, and light refreshments during the race (water, fruit). There is an option to contribute to elephant protection as part of the registration fee. Activities for children are available at the main partner ČSOB's booth. The event has been moved to October 18, 2026, due to animal protection measures against foot-and-mouth disease. The park operates with safety measures; registration is possible with options for transfer or refund of the registration fee. The event is suitable for families and athletes, with beneficent activities supporting animal protection in Africa.

name: Běh O pohár století
location: Zámecký park Pacov, Pacov, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: The Run for the Cup of the Century is a cross-country race held in Pacov in the castle park, offering courses on circuits of 1100 and 500 meters long. The race takes place on hilly terrain along park paths and is suitable for trail shoes. Men run a distance of 5.5 km, women 3.3 km. The organizer is TJ Slavoj BANES Pacov, which ensures a quality sports experience in the beautiful Vysočina environment.
course_highlights: Circuits of 1100 and 500 meters in the castle park
Hilly terrain along park paths
Option to use trail shoes
additional: The first category starts at 9:30, the main category begins at 11:40. The organizer is TJ Slavoj BANES Pacov, contact Pavel Zajíc, phone 731 189 985. The race is a cross/trail type cross-country in the castle park in Pacov, Vysočina. The race is part of the local athletics calendar; specific registration details are not provided, but it is suitable for runners of all levels who enjoy trail and cross races.

name: 5. Prunéřovský půlmaratón
location: Prunéřov, Kadaň, Czech Republic
organizer: Běžecký klub F - C Kadaň, z.s.
description: The 5th Prunéřov Half Marathon is the first race of the SUMMER RUNNING CUP, held on a cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice. The course is certified, looped, and run on two laps with minimal elevation gain, ensuring a fast and enjoyable run. The race is organized by the Running Club F - C Kadaň, z.s. and is suitable for the general running public. The start is at 10:00 AM, and participants can enjoy a quality running atmosphere in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: Certified looped course
Two laps with minimal elevation gain
Running on a cycle path between Prunéřov and Černovice
additional: The race is part of the SUMMER RUNNING CUP. Shorter races for children are also available: Prep (250 m), Younger pupils (750 m), and Older pupils (1,500 m), all with looped courses. Registration is simple and allows for data adjustments and transfer of registration to another runner. The entry fee is 250 CZK without division into time or price segments. The race is open to the general public, offers various distances, and is part of the running cup, with minimal elevation gain and a flat course.

name: Běh kolem Hluboké 25 km - Krajský přebor v silničním běhu
location: Hluboká nad Vltavou, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Run around Hluboká is the regional championship in road running over 25 km, held in the picturesque environment of Hluboká nad Vltavou. This race offers runners the opportunity to test their strength on a challenging course with beautiful views and a quality asphalt surface. The race is part of the South Bohemian regional athletics calendar and is suitable for experienced runners seeking a challenge in a longer road distance. The organizer is Atletika Veselí, which ensures a professional race course and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Road course 25 km long around Hluboká nad Vltavou
Regional championship in road running with official timing
Beautiful views and a quality asphalt surface
additional: Registration for the race often takes place on the day of the event, usually up to 30 minutes before the start. Atletika Veselí also offers the sale of club caps and headbands. Parking is available at the sports complex. Athletics training sessions are held outdoors at the stadium according to the spring schedule. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup, taking place on April 19, 2026, and is suitable for the general running public.

name: Racio běh kolem Dyje
location: Národní hrdinů, Břeclav, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 50 Kč běh na 5 km, ostatní kategorie zdarma
description: The Dyje Run Race is a traditional athletic event organized by the Athletic Club TJ Lokomotiva Břeclav, taking place on Sunday, April 19, 2026. The race offers courses for various age categories from the youngest children to adults, with the main 5 km run on a loop around the Dyje River. Youth categories run within the Racia complex, the former sugar factory, and the race is suitable for the general public as well as competitors. The registration office opens at 8:30 at the start location, and changing rooms are available in the TJ Lokomotiva Břeclav sports hall.
course_highlights: 5 km loop around the Dyje River (3 laps)
Youth courses in the Racia complex (former sugar factory)
Various course lengths adapted to age categories
additional: The race office will be open from 8:30 at the start site. Changing rooms and showers are available in the TJ Lokomotiva Břeclav sports hall. The youth and junior categories run simultaneously but are evaluated separately. The race takes place in the park at Racia on Národní hrdinů Street. Registration is possible online or on-site. Changing rooms and showers are available in the TJ Lokomotiva Břeclav sports hall.

name: Bolatická 20
location: Bolatice, Moravskoslezsko, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč pro běžce, zdarma pro děti do 15 let; 30 Kč za pěší pochod

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné 150kč. Děti do 15 let zdarma. Platba v hotovosti v den závodu.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Poplatek účastníka pochodu 30kč (děti do a včetně 15 let zdarma).

description: The Bolatice Twenty is a traditional event for tourists and runners, held annually in Bolatice. The race offers distances of 20 km and 10 km with routes mainly through forest terrain, alternating cross-country sections with asphalt. There is also a walk of 20 km or a shortened 10 km route in a pleasant forest environment. The event has a long-standing tradition since 1977 and attracts hundreds of participants, including friends from Slovakia. The start and finish are at the local swimming pool, where entertainment is provided after the race.
course_highlights: Routes mainly lead through the forest around Strahovské Ponds and Chuchelnický Forest
Alternation of cross-country sections with asphalt parts
Both walk and run are marked in yellow
additional: Registration for runners on site takes place from 8:00 to 8:55, pre-registered participants only need to report their name and pick up their number. The 3 km run starts at 9:20 and the 500 m run at 9:22. The walk starts from 7:30 to 9:00. The race takes place amidst full road traffic; participants must adhere to traffic rules. After the race, from 12:00, entertainment with the country band CARAVANA is available. Registration is possible on-site; the event will be held on April 19, 2026; routes mainly pass through forested areas.

name: CRAFT Brněnský půlmaraton a Brněnská desítka
location: Velodrom, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: CRAFT Brno Half Marathon, Ten and Five is a traditional running event of international significance held in Brno with the center at the velodrome. The event is open to the general public, from world-class athletes to recreational runners, and includes children's races. The race offers courses of 21.1 km, 10.5 km, and 5 km, with the possibility to participate in relay races. The organizers are BehejBrno.com and MARATON BRNO z.s., who annually prepare this popular sporting event.
course_highlights: Center of the race at the Brno velodrome
Traditional road courses of 21.1 km, 10.5 km, and 5 km
Races for all age categories including children
additional: The first category starts at 10:00, the main category at 11:00. The race is open to the general public, including relay races and children's categories. The organizers are BehejBrno.com and MARATON BRNO z.s. The race is part of the traditional running calendar, offering races for children and adults, and is organized with an emphasis on a friendly atmosphere and promoting a healthy lifestyle.

name: Chřibská – Studenec
location: Chřibská, Lužické hory, Czech Republic
description: We invite all runners to the 15th edition of the Chřibská Town Race in the uphill run to Studenec, which takes place in the picturesque environment of the Lusatian Mountains. The race is suitable for both top competitors and recreational runners and serves as a qualification for the World Youth Championships in uphill running. The course measures 6.1 km with an elevation gain of 397 meters, and the finish line is at the Studenec lookout tower. The start is at 10:00 AM in the Chřibská town square, with registration starting at 8:30 AM at the Chřibská Town Hall.
course_highlights: 6.1 km course in the varied terrain of the Lusatian Mountains
Elevation gain of 397 meters
Finish at the Studenec lookout tower
additional: Registration from 8:30 AM at the Chřibská Town Hall. Prizes for the top three in each category and a running raffle. The race is a qualification for the World Youth Championships in uphill running. The race takes place in the Lusatian Mountains area, registration begins at 8:30 AM, the start is at 10:00 AM, the course passes through beautiful natural scenery and is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Žatecký půlmaratón a desítka
location: Žatec, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Žatec Half Marathon and 10K is a popular running race held in Žatec, taking place on April 19, 2026. Participants can choose between the half marathon (21 km) and the 10K (10 km), both courses run on paved paths along the Ohře River towards Vičice and Stroupeč. The event also includes children's races of 400 m, 750 m, and 1,500 m. Registration takes place at the football field behind the river, the main races start in the morning, and all finishers receive a participation medal.
course_highlights: Courses run on paved paths along the Ohře River
Half marathon 21 km and 10K 10 km
Accompanying children's races of 400 m, 750 m, and 1,500 m
additional: Registration for participants takes place from 8:00 to 10:00 at the football field behind the river. Children's races start at 10:00, the half marathon at 11:00, and the 10K at 11:15. All finishers receive a participation medal. Registration is already ongoing, and the races include the half marathon, 10K, triathlon, and Advent run; the races are suitable for all age groups and running levels.

name: Petřín třikrát jinak
location: Praha, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
price_range: Dětské závody: 80-100 Kč, hlavní závod: 200-250 Kč, štafety: 200 Kč
description: Petřín Three Ways is a unique race in Prague where participants conquer Petřín Hill in three different ways: by interval running up 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower, running uphill with a mass start, and interval running down a slope on an unpaved path and stairs. The overall classification is based on the sum of times from all three segments, with bonuses for the best runners. There are ten age categories for children with routes around Hladová Zed. The race also offers a relay option, where three runners each complete one part of the race.
course_highlights: Running up 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower with interval start
Uphill run of 1 km with an elevation gain of 118 m with a mass start
Interval running down a slope of 1 km on an unpaved path and stairs
additional: Race office and facilities are in tents near the Petřín Lookout Tower. Interval starts are every 30 seconds, with a break after 30 runners for descending from the tower. Children's races have routes of 200 m, 365 m, and 730 m with results announced immediately after finishing. Relays consist of 3 runners, each running one part of the race, starting together with individual runners; relay participants cannot compete in the main race. The schedule runs from 7:45 to 12:35 with main race results announced at 11:30. Terrain includes stairs and unpaved paths; registration is via the Apachi platform; the race is part of the series "Lookouts in Motion"; it offers multiple categories and a relay running option.

name: Charitativní běh NF Křídla dětem
location: Ostrava-Poruba, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: dobrovolné startovné, 150-400 Kč podle věkové skupiny a registrace
description: Charity run of the Křídla dětem Foundation is a traditional annual event held in Ostrava-Poruba to support sick children in pediatric hematology-oncology at the University Hospital. The run is open to all age groups, including children's races and walking routes. The event combines sports activity with a charitable purpose, with proceeds helping to make hospital stays more pleasant for children through necessary gifts. The run takes place on Sunday, April 19, 2026, and offers the opportunity to contribute even without participating in the run.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Ostrava-Poruba at the University Hospital, pediatric hematology-oncology department
Children's races over 550 m and 1000 m, adult routes of 5 km and 10 km (2 laps)
Free parking next to the VŠB Sports Hall with access from Studentská street
additional: Children's races start at 9:30 (up to 6 years old) and 9:45 (7-12 years old). Adult routes are 5 km and 10 km (2 laps). Free parking at VŠB Ostrava Sports Hall. In case of registration errors, contact guras@kridladetem.cz. Entry fee is non-refundable in case of absence. It is possible to donate the entry fee as a gift certificate. The event includes various routes, online and on-site registration, free parking, options to contribute financially or in kind, and is associated with a charity collection and accompanying activities.

name: Šaratický běh
location: Šaratice, South Moravia, Czech Republic
description: The Šaratice Run is a traditional 10 km road race held in the village of Šaratice in the South Moravian Region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to test their strength on a fast and well-marked course. The start is at the municipal office, and the race atmosphere is friendly and sports-oriented. The event is organized by the municipality of Šaratice, which ensures smooth operation and supports the local running community.
course_highlights: Road course 10 km long
Start and finish at the municipal office in Šaratice
Suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The race is part of the local running calendar, registration details are not explicitly provided, and it is suitable for the general public.

name: Charitativní běh Karlštejn
location: Nádvoří hradu Karlštejn, Karlštejn, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Charity Run Karlštejn is a running event organized by Charita Beroun, offering the opportunity to combine a sporting experience with supporting a good cause. The run takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Gothic Karlštejn Castle and the Velká Amerika quarry, providing a unique terrain experience. The start is directly from the courtyard of Karlštejn Castle, allowing participants to experience the atmosphere of a historic site. The event is open to all runners who want to run with heart and support charitable activities.
course_highlights: Start directly from the courtyard of Karlštejn Castle
Trail run around the Gothic Karlštejn Castle
The route also passes around the Velká Amerika quarry
additional: The event takes place on April 19, 2026, from 10:00 to 14:00 in the beautiful environment of Karlštejn. The entry fee also serves as a contribution to the charitable activities of Charita Beroun. Routes of 12 km, 18 km, and 30 km; included in the UTMB Index Race; charitable and sporting character; finisher jerseys; option to download GPX route.

name: Craft Brněnský půlmaraton | desítka | pětka
location: Velodrom, Brno, Czech Republic
description: Craft Brno Half Marathon is a running event with start and finish at the Velodrome in Brno. The course passes through the BVV exhibition grounds and along a new pedestrian path behind the Riviera swimming pool. Runners can choose from three distances: 21 km, 10 km, or 5 km, and there are races for children held within the Velodrome area. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant sporting experience in an attractive environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Velodrome in Brno
Course passes through BVV exhibition grounds and around the Riviera swimming pool
Option to choose between 21 km, 10 km, and 5 km distances
additional: Children's races are held within the Velodrome area. The course includes a new pedestrian path behind the Riviera swimming pool. The races take place in April 2026, with registration available through the official website. The event is part of Brno's sports calendar and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: 15 brodů Bílého potoka
location: Javůrka, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The 15 Brods of the White Creek is an off-road adventure running race taking place through the beautiful valley of the White Creek around the settlement of Šmelcovna. The longest route measures approximately 22 km and includes 16 fords, which are runnable and most can be bypassed via a footbridge. The race is suitable for hobby runners and moderately trained athletes, with a time limit of 3 hours. There are three routes available: 7 km non-competitive, 15 km with 7 fords, and 22 km with an additional loop and elevation gain. The course mainly runs through forests and meadows along hiking trails and cycle paths, is well-marked, and offers beautiful natural scenery.
course_highlights: 16 fords on the longest 22 km route, most fords are runnable or can be bypassed via a footbridge
The course mainly runs through forests and meadows away from asphalt, with an elevation gain of 400 meters on the longest route
At the end of the race, there is approximately 1.7 km of steep ascent
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours, with a 50-minute window to split the route into 6.6 km segments. Slower runners are directed to the finish line and evaluated on the shorter route. The course is marked with arrows and ribbons. Water in the fords is above ankle level; the fords are runnable, and most of the heavier fords can be bypassed. There is an option to change the route length even during the race. An off-road race with fords, routes of 7, 15, and 22 km, easy terrain, natural environment, marked trails, and a time limit of 3 hours.

name: Silniční běh kolem Hluboké nad Vltavou
location: TJ Hluboká, Hluboká nad Vltavou, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The road race around Hluboká nad Vltavou is a traditional road race with a distance of 25 km, starting and finishing at the TJ Hluboká stadium. The route goes along asphalt cycle paths and third-class roads through picturesque villages Bavorovice, Vondrov, Munice, Zahájí, and Zliv. The race is suitable for runners who want to test their endurance on a road course in the beautiful South Bohemian environment. The organizer is TJ KOH-I-NOOR České Budějovice with contact person Růžena Smolíková.
course_highlights: 25 km route along asphalt cycle paths and third-class roads
Passes through villages Bavorovice, Vondrov, Munice, Zahájí, and Zliv
Start and finish at TJ Hluboká stadium
additional: The start and finish of the race are at TJ Hluboká stadium. The route goes mainly along asphalt cycle paths and third-class roads. The organizer is TJ KOH-I-NOOR České Budějovice, contact person Růžena Smolíková, phone 607 525 403. The race takes place on April 19, 2026. Registration is possible for 200 CZK. The route primarily follows asphalt cycle paths and third-class roads, with start and finish at TJ Hluboká stadium.

description: Paskovská devítka is a traditional running race organized by the town of Paskov, held for the eighth time. The race is open to the general public, from young children to adults, and offers several categories including the main race over 9 km, youth races, and a non-competitive run for Paskov Castle. This year, there has been a change in the registration and start location of the main race, which begins at 9:15 AM. The event is a sporting activity emphasizing safety and supporting the local community.
course_highlights: Main race over 9000 m
Youth races over 940 m, 480 m, and 160 m for the youngest
Non-competitive run for Paskov Castle over 3000 m
additional: The race takes place with traffic restrictions on Nádražní, Mírová, Fučíkova, Krátká, U Potoka, Bezručova, Boženy Němcové, Jiřího Wolkra, and U Parku streets from 9:00 AM to approximately 12:00 PM. Each participant runs at their own risk. The race is suitable for all age groups, including a non-competitive run for those born in 2014 and earlier. Races include the 9000 m main race, youth races over 940 m, 480 m, 160 m, and a run for Paskov Castle over 3000 m. The registration and start location of the main race have changed, with traffic restrictions on the course from 9:00 AM to approximately 12:00 PM.

name: Běh Chýní
location: Chýně, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Chýně Run 2026 is an athletic race organized by the ASK Dipoli club in the village of Chýně in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the club's four-event series RUN THE TRIO and is intended for youth, juniors, men, and women. ASK Dipoli club also offers other races and athletic activities for various age groups and levels. Registrations and training schedules are available online, and the race promotes active sports life and the athletic community in the region.
course_highlights: The race is suitable for all age groups, from children to adults
Part of the ASK Dipoli running event series in 2026
Online registration available with attractive prizes for winners
additional: The race is part of the club's four-event series RUN THE TRIO. ASK Dipoli club also organizes other races in the region and offers training for different age categories. To register for the races, participants can contact trainers, and the entry fee can be paid individually or deducted from club points. The race takes place on April 19, 2026, in Chýně, with various courses including children's and adult runs, online registration, prizes, and diplomas for participants.

location: Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 50,- kč dětské kategorie (předem na účet i v den registrace na místě)

description: The Česík Run is a running race held in the beautiful environment of Hradec Králové forests, specifically on the forest "Finnish" running trail near the Forest Cemetery in Hradec Králové. The race offers categories for children and adults and is suitable for the whole family. For children, shorter routes without timing measurement are prepared, while the main race is intended for adults. The event is traditional and friendly, with medals and gifts for the best competitors in children's categories.
course_highlights: Forest "Finnish" running trail in Hradec Králové
The course runs through the natural environment of Hradec Králové forests
Categories for children and adults with medals and gifts for winners
additional: Registration is possible online until April 15, 2026, or on-site on the race day. Registration for children's races is from 09:30 to 10:15, with children's categories starting at 10:20. The main race starts between 11:00 and 11:45. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the first three finishers in each children's category. Results are published within 24 hours after the race. The race is part of a series of local runs, with registration and details available on the official website. The race date is April 19, 2026.

name: Prunéřovský půlmaraton
location: Prunéřov, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: Běžecký klub F - C Kadaň, z.s.

The race is part of the Běžec Chodska Cup and provides a sporting challenge in a natural environment. It is suitable for runners seeking quality trail running with a tradition and atmosphere honoring prominent figures of the running community.
course_highlights: Course for men 5.1 km and for women 3.4 km
Trail running around Domažlice
Part of the Běžec Chodska Cup

description: Montacké vlny is part of the PRIMÁTOR CUP series, which connects traditional road and trail running events in the Náchodsko region. The race takes place in the Montace forest park in Náchod and offers a two-loop course 7.5 km long with an elevation gain of 230 meters. The terrain is very varied, combining asphalt, dirt, and grass, making the race attractive for both experienced and beginner runners. The program also includes shorter races for children and juniors, held at the PRIMÁTOR brewery premises. Organizers have also prepared an accompanying athletics program for children and awards for the best runners and the oldest participant.
course_highlights: Two-loop course 7.5 km with an elevation gain of 230 m
Course surface: asphalt, dirt, grass
PRIMÁTOR brewery premises in Náchod
additional: Children's races run from 9:15 to 10:15 with various distances from 150 m to 1500 m. The main 7.5 km race starts at 11:00 together with the fitness wave over 3.8 km. An athletics program for children is available in the brewery area from 9:00 to 11:00. Prizes are prepared for the top runners in each category, the youngest participants receive a small reward, and the oldest participant will receive a special prize. The first runner to enter the second lap of the main race will receive a gift pack of beer. The race offers various distances, including trail and road runs, with elevation gains up to 360 m, suitable for all ages and running levels.

name: Nymburský půlmaraton
location: Nymburk, Nymburk District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Nymburk Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Nymburk, offering a flat course suitable for recreational runners as well as those training for longer races. The route passes through the town park, along the Labe cycle path, and over two bridges, with a total length of 21.1 km. For less experienced runners, a 10 km race is also available, which is a shorter variant of the main race. The race facilities are located beneath the town walls, creating a unique atmosphere for the event.
course_highlights: Flat course with minimal elevation gain, except for stairs on the bridge and the lock crossing
The route runs on asphalt roads (95%) and paths or cobblestones (5%)
Runners cross two bridges over the Labe River, including a bridge with 60 stairs
additional: Refreshments are provided at the start, finish, and every 5 km (water, isotonic drinks, fruit, chocolate). A race bib with the runner's name is available for registrations paid by April 12, 2026. Children's races have separate starts from 8:30 to 9:05 with results announced at 9:15. Refreshments, medals, diplomas, and small gifts are prepared for children. The registration fee must be paid within 7 days of registration, otherwise the registration will be canceled. The course runs through the town park, along cycle paths, and over two bridges; registration is online, and the entry fee varies depending on the registration date; the race has no significant elevation gain, with a 3-hour limit for completion.

name: Modřany Ravine Run!
location: U Liščích děr, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Modřany Ravine Run is a traditional running race in the Modřanská rokle nature park in Prague, held for the 23rd time. It offers two courses for adults - a more challenging 10 km with an elevation gain of 215 meters and an easier 6.1 km with an elevation gain of 110 meters, mainly on forest and field paths with several steep ascents and descents. For children, shorter flat courses are prepared on the Meadow near Liščí Děry, including a track for the youngest children up to 4 years old. The race is part of the Modřanský Running Triathlon, which includes three different races throughout the year with scoring and a joint announcement.
course_highlights: Two courses in the hilly terrain of Modřanská rokle - 10 km and 6.1 km
Forest and field paths with several steep ascents and descents
Flat circuits for children on the Meadow near Liščí Děry
additional: The youngest children up to 4 years old can run a 50 m track accompanied by parents. The race is part of the Modřanský Running Triathlon, which includes three races with scoring and a joint announcement. After the race, diplomas, medals, prizes, and light refreshments are prepared. The race includes various age categories, including children, and is part of the Modřanský Running Triathlon series. The event also offers an accompanying program and the possibility to participate in special editions with a modified route.

name: Mistrovství Moravy a Slezska v běhu do vrchu – Contica běh na Radhošť 2026
location: Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Contica Run to Radhošť 2026 is the 3rd edition of the Moravia and Silesia Mountain Running Championship held in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm. The race is part of the 40th Krakonoš Czech Cup Mountain Running and offers a course of 6.5 km with an elevation gain of 734 meters, leading from the Rožnov camp to the top of Radhošť near the statue of Cyril and Methodius. The race is open to all competitors over 15 years old and also includes children's races and an accompanying program. The adult race starts on Sunday at 10:00, with online and on-site registration available. After the race, refreshments, chip timing service, and participant medals are provided.
course_highlights: 6.5 km course with an elevation gain of 734 m
First kilometer on asphalt, then rocky and forest terrain
Finish at the chapel on Radhošť at an altitude of 1129 m
additional: Children's races take place on Saturday at 14:00 in the Rožnov city park. Registration for competitors is on Saturday from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Sunday from 7:30 to 9:30 at Camping Rožnov. Transportation of belongings to the finish line is provided by car from the start at 9:30; personal transport from the top of Radhošť is not arranged. The winners will be announced around 13:00 at the Camping area. Vehicle entry to Radhošť is prohibited without permission. The race is intended for runners interested in mountain running and wanting to experience the challenging terrain in the beautiful environment of Radhošť. Details about registration and the exact route are available on the official website.

name: Vratislavický Běhoun 2026
location: Koupaliště SLUNÍČKO, Vratislavice nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: Vratislavický Běhoun is a traditional cross-country race held at the SLUNÍČKO swimming pool area in Vratislavice nad Nisou. This 32nd edition of the race offers running on field and forest paths with a small section on asphalt, ensuring a diverse and interesting terrain for all participants. The race is also the 28th edition for the Mayor's Cup of Vratislavice nad Nisou and is suitable for the general public as well as runners of various categories. Come enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beautiful environment of Liberec region.
course_highlights: The course runs in the SLUNÍČKO swimming pool area
Running on field and forest paths
A small part of the course is on asphalt
additional: The start and finish of the race are in the SLUNÍČKO swimming pool area. The race is part of the Mayor's Cup of Vratislavice nad Nisou. The course is suitable for different age groups and runners of various performance levels. Facilities at the Loděnice complex provide comfortable conditions including a buffet, changing rooms, and showers. Přeštická desítka is part of the Running Cup of Plzeň Region and promises a friendly atmosphere and sporting experience.

Support for a healthy lifestyle and community spirit

The event is organized by the experienced team of TJ Sokol Štěpánkovice under the leadership of Jiří Bořucký.

The event also includes children's races on an asphalt track near Porubská Myslivna, where children run in various age categories. The main race is divided into categories based on age and gender, and every participant who completes the course receives an original finisher's medal. location: Nymburk, Nymburk District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

The race runs through the city park, along the Labe cycle path, and across two bridges, with the finish and facilities located under the historic city walls. For less experienced runners, a 10K race is available, which is shorter and also runs on a flat route. The event is suitable for recreational runners as well as those training for longer races, and offers quality facilities and refreshments on the course and at the finish line.

Registrations are only possible online in advance. This race is part of the running series Běžec Podblanicka, which offers a diverse calendar of running events in the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: Distance of 4.5 km
Hilly terrain on the slope of Karlov
Held in Benešov, Central Bohemian Region
additional: Registrations are only possible online in advance. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka series with other running events in 2026. The race takes place on May 1, 2026, in Benešov, and is part of the local running cup, featuring challenging hilly terrain.

name: Běh KERMI

description: KERMI Run in Stříbro is a traditional race with a distance of 10.5 km, mainly through terrain, with start and finish in the premises of KERMI. The race is suitable for runners of various levels, who can start either at 10:00 or in the main start at 10:30. After the race, results will be announced, and participants can enjoy seating and refreshments. The organizer is KERMI in cooperation with the Stříbro Endurance Association, which supports amateur athletes and runners in the region.
course_highlights: 10.5 km route mainly in terrain
Start and finish in the KERMI Stříbro premises
Option to start earlier at 10:00
additional: The race starts at 10:30, but it is possible to start earlier at 10:00 for slower runners. After the race, results will be announced, and there will be seating and refreshments with hydration. The course is mainly in terrain, registration on-site, start at 10:30, and post-race refreshments and winners' announcement are prepared.

name: Jarní přespolní běh Nýrsko
location: Areál pod Sjezdovkou, Nýrsko, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Spring cross-country run in Nýrsko is a traditional athletic event organized by TJ Nýrsko z.s., held in the area below the Sjezdovka. The race offers children's categories starting at 13:00 and the main race from 14:00. The course runs through the sports area below Pajrek with an elevation change of 20 meters per lap. The event is part of the off-track running series in the Klatovy district - Ešus League and is suitable for the general public who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and nature.
course_highlights: The course runs in the Sports Area below Pajrek
Elevation change of 20 meters per lap
The race is part of the Ešus League - off-track running series in the Klatovy district
additional: Registration on site from 12:00 PM, ending 15 minutes before the start of the respective category. Refreshments provided at the Sjezdovka area. Material prizes for the top three finishers in each category according to the organizer's possibilities. All participants run at their own risk, children at the parents' responsibility. The event includes various races, including the main run and children's race, and is part of the local sports calendar. The run is known for its tradition and friendly atmosphere.

name: Májový běh okolo rybníka Nezmaru
location: Jilešovice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The May Run around Nezmar Pond is a traditional running race organized by the Seitl Ostrava Marathon Club, held in the picturesque village of Jilešovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The Seitl Ostrava Club, founded in 1997, brings together runners of all levels and promotes sports activities in the region. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere and an opportunity to meet the running community in a beautiful natural setting. Organizers welcome new runners as well as experienced athletes who want to experience a quality running event.
course_highlights: Circuit around Nezmar Pond in Jilešovice
Picturesque natural environment of the Moravian-Silesian Region
Traditional running event with a friendly atmosphere
additional: The event is part of a series of runs in the region and emphasizes community atmosphere and sports activities for all age groups.

name: Boskovické běhy
location: Boskovice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Boskovice Runs are a significant sporting event in the region, offering courses of various lengths for all age groups, including children. The main race, Run for the Seven-Toothed Ridge, measures 12.5 km and passes through two long forest sections. The event is not only a sporting competition but also a social occasion promoting a healthy lifestyle and a family atmosphere. It also features a rich accompanying program and a new team race for three-member teams. Tourists can join and enjoy a day full of movement and fun.
course_highlights: The main course is 12.5 km long
Two long forest sections on the main course
Children's races for all age groups
additional: A new feature is the three-member team race. Starting numbers can include the runner's name. Tourists can participate in the joint event. Special children's races are prepared for kids. An information line is available on working days from 9:00 to 12:00 and from 16:00 to 19:00 at phone number 776 762 602. The event includes various races, including children's, team, and the main race, and takes place in the South Moravian region on May 1, 2026.

name: Memoriál Huberta Šuláka
location: Osada Údolí oddechu, Libečov, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hubert Šulák Memorial is a running event held at the Osada Údolí oddechu in Libečov, aimed at honoring a significant runner and supporting the running community in the region. Precise information about the course length and registration is not provided on the official website, but the event is open to all running enthusiasts who wish to celebrate the sporting spirit and contribute to the preservation of running traditions. The event is scheduled for May 1, 2026.
course_highlights: Honoring Hubert Šulák
Supporting the local running community
Taking place in the scenic environment of Osada Údolí oddechu
additional: The event is associated with a place of relaxation and nature, suitable for various age groups and running levels.

name: Jestřebí kros
location: Chlíve 62, Stárkov, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jestřebí Cross is a running race held in the picturesque environment of the village of Stárkov in the Hradec Králové Region. The event is designed for runners of all levels who want to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere. Exact distances of the courses are not specified, but the race is part of the local running calendar and offers an opportunity for sporting activity in a beautiful setting. Details about registration and the exact program are available on the official website.
course_highlights: Picturesque nature of the Hradec Králové Region
Friendly atmosphere for runners of all levels
Opportunity to enjoy the race in a natural environment

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
location: Zámecký park, Horšovský Týn, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Castle Park Run is a popular sporting event organized by Aktiv Sport Horšovský Týn, taking place on May 1, 2026, in the picturesque Castle Park in Horšovský Týn. The race includes relay races around the pond measuring 4 x 600 meters, which are part of the Youth Running Cup of the Plzeň Region. The event offers active participation for runners of all ages in the beautiful natural environment of the park. The start is scheduled for 2:00 PM, and the race is suitable for the general public and sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Relay races around the pond in Castle Park
Segment length of 600 meters, 4 segments in the relay
Picturesque environment of Castle Park in Horšovský Týn
additional: The race is part of the Youth Running Cup of the Plzeň Region. The organizer is the association Aktiv Sport Horšovský Týn, z. s. The event focuses on relays around the pond with a length of 4 x 600 m. The race takes place in Castle Park, is open to all age groups, and is part of the regional running cup.

name: Vrcholy
location: Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The peaks of Czech mountains are a unique collector's challenge for all nature lovers and outdoor adventure enthusiasts. The set of stickers features the 25 highest peaks of Czech mountains and ranges, which you can stick on your bottle as a reminder of your trips and achievements. Each sticker is hand-drawn and inspired by real peaks, made from durable material with UV protection and waterproofing to withstand tough conditions. This collection is ideal for those who want to always have an original and personal touch of adventure with them.
course_highlights: 25 highest peaks of Czech mountains and ranges
Hand-drawn and exclusively designed stickers
High-quality materials with UV protection and waterproofing
additional: The stickers are waterproof, have a strong adhesive that sticks to various surfaces even in adverse conditions, and are protected by UV lamination against fading. Some stickers are also dishwasher safe.

name: Jestřebí kros
location: Chlívce u Náchoda, Náchod, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jestřebí cross-country is a pleasant cross race run almost entirely on paved forest roads around Chlívce near Náchod. The 10.8 km course begins with a longer ascent, continues through undulating terrain, and ends with a longer descent in an open area. The race is suitable for runners who enjoy natural and forest environments with gentle elevation changes.
course_highlights: The course runs almost entirely on paved forest roads
Longer ascent at the beginning
Ending with a longer descent in open terrain
additional: Children participate for free. The organizer is BK Náchod. The race takes place at the U Lípy pub in Chlívce near Náchod. The start of the first category is at 9:30 AM, the main category starts at 11:00 AM. Terrain: forest roads, registration: required in advance, notes: course with initial ascent and descent

name: Běh Krásné vyhlídky
location: Struhařov, Mnichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč pro dospělé, zdarma pro děti a juniory
description: The Beautiful View Run is a traditional running race held in Struhařov near Mnichovice, offering a unique panoramic route along the new natural trail Beautiful View. The race is part of the Ladova Region Cup running series and is designed for a wide range of runners including children, juniors, adults, and veterans. The start and facilities are at Hliněný Rybník, where accompanying runs for the youngest categories also take place. The main race measures 7.4 km and runs one lap along the natural trail. The event is supported by volunteers, local associations, and partners.
course_highlights: Unique panoramic route along the natural trail Beautiful View
7.4 km loop for the main race
Supporting runs for children and juniors around the pond
additional: Registration for accompanying runs is from 13:00 to 14:30, with the first runs starting at 14:45. Registration for the main 7.4 km race is from 14:00 to 16:00, with the main race starting at 16:30. Categories include preschoolers (200 m), pupils (620 m), juniors (1860 m), and adults including men, women, and veterans (7.4 km). The fastest runner from Struhařov will be announced in the main race. The race is part of the regional Ladova Region Cup series, with starts at 14:45 and 16:30. The race routes include the main 7.4 km run and children's races over 200 m, 620 m, and 1860 m.

name: Běh Údolím vzdechů
location: Sudoměřice u Tábora, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Valley of Sighs Run is a traditional cross-country race organized by TJ Sokol Sudoměřice u Tábora, held annually on May 1st. In 2026, the 10th edition of this event will take place, attracting runners of all ages, including children and adults. The race offers an opportunity for sporting activity in the picturesque environment of Sudoměřice u Tábora and is accompanied by a lively atmosphere and community spirit. Results and photos from previous editions are available online.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in the scenic valley of Sudoměřice u Tábora
Course suitable for children and adult runners
Annual tradition with a community atmosphere
additional: Results for children's and adults' races are published online. Photos from the event are available on several web galleries. The event is organized by TJ Sokol Sudoměřice u Tábora, which also arranges other sports and social events in the village. The race includes children's races starting from 50 meters, registration for adults costs 150 CZK, and the races take place in natural terrain with participation open to the general public.

name: Běh údolím samoty
location: Radvanec u Nového Boru, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: The Samota Valley Run in Radvánov near Nový Bor is a traditional race as part of the District Running League of Česká Lípa, taking place on May 1, 2026. The race offers runners the opportunity to enjoy running in a picturesque valley with natural scenery and a peaceful atmosphere. It is an ideal event for nature running enthusiasts who want to combine athletic performance with the beauty of the surrounding landscape. The race is part of a broader series of running events in the region that promote an active lifestyle and community sports.
course_highlights: Picturesque valley with natural scenery
Peaceful atmosphere suitable for outdoor running
Part of the District Running League of Česká Lípa
additional: Race details and regulations are available for download; the event is part of a regional running series.

name: PM Consulting Choceňský půlmaraton
location: Choceň, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: PM Consulting Choceň Half Marathon is a running race over 21.1 km held on forest paths between Chocně and Horní Jelení. The route is on quality forest roads with gravel and some asphalt, allowing running even in light terrain. In addition to the main half marathon, shorter distances of 10 km and 5 km are available, suitable for juniors, veterans, and anyone wanting to experience the race atmosphere. The event is based at the swimming pool area in Chocně, where medical services are also provided. The race is open to the general public and takes place in any weather conditions.
course_highlights: Forest route on paved roads with gravel and asphalt surface
Facilities at the swimming pool area in Chocně
Medical services of the Czech Red Cross at the start and finish area
additional: The race also includes a variant of a three-member team competition, where the times of all team members are summed. There is a program for children including a bouncy castle. The race takes place in any weather. The route runs along the Banda water reservoir and is suitable for the general public. The event is part of a broader sports day in Chocně with additional accompanying activities.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Chomutov
location: Wakepark Chomutov, Chomutov, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 / 200,- Kč, 200 Kč - 300 Kč za měřené běhy, 100 Kč za rodinný běh

description: The Run for the Nation's Memory in Chomutov is a sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps preserve their stories. The race takes place on May 1, 2026, at Wakepark Chomutov and offers a timed 5 km run and an untimed family run of 1 km. The course runs along a flat cycle path around the Banda water reservoir and through Otvice, with the finish at the parking lot by Banda. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes endurance and remembrance of fighters for freedom.
course_highlights: Flat course along the cycle path around the Banda water reservoir
Turnaround in Otvice and return along the same route
Start and finish at Aquasvet and the parking lot by Banda
additional: Registration and pickup of race numbers are from 8:30 to 9:45 for the 1 km race and until 10:30 for the 5 km race. There is a baggage storage, sanitary facilities, water at the finish, and refreshments. Music will be provided by DJ Lukáš Budai. Students, members of the Memory of the Nation club, and runners over 65 years old receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. The race is scheduled to start at 08:30, with registration available online and on-site. The event includes refreshments, baggage storage, and musical entertainment.

name: Král Zvičiny 2026
location: Lipnice, Zaháj, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč online (250 Kč na místě) pro hlavní závod; 100 Kč online (150 Kč na místě) pro děti
description: Král Zvičiny 2026 is a mass start road race for individual uphill competitors, which is an ideal season opener. The race takes place on May 1, 2026, in the area of Dvůr Králové nad Labem - Lipnice - Zaháj and offers two main routes: an adult race approximately 10 km long with an asphalt surface and continuous ascent, and a children's race of 3 km. The finish of the main race is at Raisova Chata on Zvičina, while the children's race ends in Dehtov. The organizer is the team Carla Kupkolo.cz from Dvůr Králové nad Labem.
course_highlights: Main race approximately 10 km with asphalt surface and continuous ascent
Route passes through Lipnice, Dehtov, Třebihošť to Zvičina
Children's race 3 km with finish in Dehtov
additional: Registration takes place in Dvůr Králové - Lipnice - Zaháj from 8:30 to 9:30. The results ceremony is held at Motorest U Lípy in Třebihošť. Categories are divided by age and gender, including junior and veteran groups. The race is part of the cycling season and offers a great opportunity for competitors and amateurs to enjoy the atmosphere and challenge uphill. Registration is possible online via sportchallenge.cz.

name: Memoriál Karla Raise
location: Masarykovy sady, Louny, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrace do čtvrtka 30.4. 2026 do 20:00, platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné lidového běhu 50,- Kč, registrace do 30.4.2026 do 20:00

description: The Karel Raise Memorial is a traditional road race organized by the Athletic Sports Club ELNA Počerady, taking place on May 2, 2026, in Louny. The event features the 35th edition of the 15 km run and the 11th edition of the inline skating race. The route is certified by the AIMS measuring system and runs on closed roads with slight elevation changes, starting near the village of Volevčice and finishing in the Masaryk Gardens in Louny. The day also includes a fun run for all age groups and an accompanying program for families and children. Organizers provide transportation to the start and facilities including changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: The 15 km route runs on closed roads of classes II and III without motor vehicle traffic
Start at an altitude of 219 meters, finish at 178 meters above sea level
Certified course measured by AIMS with a validity of 10 years from 2016
additional: Start is in 4 waves according to categories. Transportation by buses from Louny to the start in Počeradech is provided. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sauna of the swimming pool next to the exhibition grounds. Personal belongings are transported by van. The fun run is suitable for everyone, including people with disabilities, and participants receive a T-shirt. The program includes Children's Day with athletic competitions and cultural activities. Registration is open until April 30, 2026. The race takes place on closed roads, with transportation arranged from Louny Municipal Swimming Pool. Race categories include various age groups and relay races.

name: Běh na 2 míle – Praha, Stromovka
location: Stromovka Park, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka is an open race covering 3.2 km, designed for all age groups and running levels, including children up to 12 years old for the shorter distance of 1.6 km. The race is ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park environment. After the race, each participant is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake. Time is recorded for everyone, and results are published online, counting towards the annual Pancake Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt paths in Stromovka
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km), children up to 12 years run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Královská obora - Stromovka, beautiful park setting
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of prior online registration for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age and gender, with an age coefficient for the annual Cup. Recommended transportation includes cycling, walking, rollerblading, or tram (stop Výstaviště). There are changing tents, a place to leave belongings, a mobile valuables storage, and portable toilets. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. The race is open to all age groups, with a course length of 3.2 km, suitable for beginners and advanced runners, aimed at promoting the joy of running. Parking is available at the bridge to Císařský Island, with changing rooms and toilets available.

name: Kačický lesní běh
location: Obora, Kačice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kačický forest run is an attractive cross-country race in the beautiful environment of Obora forest and the surroundings of Kačice, offering various distances from 100 m to 900 m for youth and adults. The event takes place on May 2, 2026, and is open to all age groups, including children's races with free participation. It also features social activities, including a sauna and refreshments after the race, creating a friendly atmosphere for the whole family. The race is part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Runners Cup, providing a great opportunity for sports meetings in nature.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in Obora forest with various distances from 100 m to 900 m
Race for all age groups including children's races
Post-race social activities including sauna and refreshments
additional: Cross-country run in Obora forest, various distances, children's races with free participation, sauna and refreshments after the race

name: Maloskalský půlmaraton
location: Malá Skála, Český ráj, Czech Republic
description: The Maloskalský Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of the Bohemian Paradise, in Malá Skála. The race offers a half marathon course with an elevation gain of approximately 25 meters and a surface combining asphalt, gravel, and field paths. The start is in the late afternoon, which adds a unique atmosphere to the event. The race also includes a 10 km course, suitable for a wide range of runners. Organizers provide complete services including chip timing, refreshments on the course and at the finish line, baggage storage, and medical services.
course_highlights: Half marathon course 21.098 km with an elevation gain of approx. 25 m
Surface of the course: 80% asphalt, 10% gravel, 10% field path
The route passes along cycle paths and hiking trails, crossing a railway bridge and passing around Hrubý Rohozec Castle
additional: Limit of 200 runners for the half marathon and 100 for the 10 km race. Starting number with the option of a name upon registration by April 26. Chip timing by STOPNITO. Refreshments on the course at 5 km, 8 km, 13 km, and 16 km, and at the finish line. Registration from 14:45 to 16:40, baggage storage until 16:40. Option to order a race logo T-shirt. Course: 21.098 km, start at 17:00, registration from 14:45 to 16:40, includes refreshments, chip timing, gifts, and medical services.

name: K6 Czech Ultramarathon Festival
location: Konstantinovy Lázně, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: K6 Czech Ultramarathon Festival is a prestigious ultramarathon race held in Konstantinovy Lázně on a 2854-meter loop. The festival includes six races with various lengths from 24 hours to a six-day run, attracting ultramarathoners from many countries. In 2026, the 24-hour race will also serve as the Czech Republic Championship. The race is known for its difficulty and international participation, making it a significant event in Czech and global ultramarathon running.
course_highlights: Loop length of 2854 meters in Konstantinovy Lázně
The longest race lasts six days
The 24-hour race is the Czech Republic Championship 2026
additional: The race takes place on an asphalt road track. The organizer is Rumning klap z.s. The start of the first category is at 12:00. The festival includes races of 50 km, 24, 48, 72, and 144 hours, as well as a six-day run. The races are held on a 2854-meter loop equipped with lighting and meet international standards. The event is part of the international ultramarathon calendar and offers various race lengths including 50 km, 24 hours, 48 hours, 72 hours, and 6 days.

name: Otrokovická 100
location: Otrokovice, Buchlovské hory, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Otrokovická 100 is an ultramarathon race covering 100 km, held in Otrokovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The event is part of a broader weekend program that also includes a 50 km variant, aimed at runners seeking a challenge in the beautiful environment of the Buchlov Hills. The race is organized by the SKÁJ team and attracts participants from across the country who want to test their strength over long distances. The event emphasizes athletic performance, active recreation, and a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon race of 100 km in the scenic environment of the Buchlov Hills
Opportunity to participate in the 50 km variant
Organized by the SKÁJ team with an emphasis on athletic performance and community
additional: The race includes refreshment stations, is intended for active athletes and running enthusiasts, with the possibility of volunteer support.

name: Avanti běh Lukov
location: Lukov u Znojma, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Avanti Lukov Run is a race in Lukov near Znojmo, offering a main race of 9 km for men and 4.5 km for women, complemented by children's races of various lengths depending on age. The course mainly runs on paved surfaces, asphalt, and field roads, with a significant ascent in the upper part of Lukov. After the race, there is a ceremonial announcement of the entire Znojmo Running Cup series with awards for the best runners and light refreshments. The event is organized by the Rabbits Znojmo team, which invites all runners to participate and to meet afterwards.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs on asphalt and field roads
Significant ascent in the upper part of Lukov
Two loops for men (9 km), one loop for women (4.5 km)
additional: Registration and sign-up take place on-site at Penzion Adalbert in Lukov near Znojmo. Children's races start at 9:15 AM, the main race at 10:00 AM. After the race, there is a ceremonial announcement of the entire Znojmo Running Cup series with handcrafted trophies and prizes from sponsors. Light refreshments are provided for participants. Organizers welcome feedback and suggestions for improvement. Following the race, there is a ceremonial announcement and refreshments; the race is open to the general public, including children.

name: Barvám Neutečeš České Budějovice
location: Sokolský ostrov, České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: Color Run is a colorful race and all-day entertainment for all age groups, families, and friends held on Sokolský Island in České Budějovice. There are two routes to choose from - 5 km with five color zones and 1.5 km with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. The event is not about speed, but about joy, friendship, and unforgettable experiences full of colors, music, and fun. Come enjoy a day full of laughter, dance, and shared energy, where no one escapes the colors.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 color zones
1.5 km route with 3 color zones and an interactive sports zone
Color zones shower runners with colors from head to toe
additional: The event takes place from 9:00 to 16:00 on Sokolský Island. It features musical performances, themed zones, photo booths, 360° videos, and accompanying programs. The event is suitable for everyone regardless of performance level; children can start on shoulders, scooters, or strollers. The event will be held on May 3, 2026, on Sokolský Island in České Budějovice. Registrations are available both on-site and online, with various packages for individuals, teams, and corporate participants. It includes a charitable aspect and various city accompanying activities.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - květen
