description: The 2-mile run in Zlín in Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps on a precisely measured asphalt track. The race takes place on the first Saturday of each month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. Each participant will be rewarded at the finish line with a warm cinnamon roll as a token of participation.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt track of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years (boys and girls). Time is measured for each runner, and the top three in each category receive small prizes. It is recommended to arrive by bike, on foot, by car, rollerblades, or by trolleybus No. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). The course length is 3.2 km, with the start at 9:00 AM at the Madal Bal company. Registration is held on the first Saturday of each month from 8:15 to 8:55. The run is open to all age groups and focuses on the joy of movement.

name: Kokina běh
location: Horka nad Moravou, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Kokina Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in Horka nad Moravou. The race is 15 km long and is part of the Great Prize of Long-distance Runners of the Olomouc Region. The Liga stovkařů club specializes in fitness and performance running and offers participants a quality sports experience in the picturesque environment of Central Moravia. The race is suitable for runners of various performance levels who want to test their strength on an interesting course.
course_highlights: Race length of 15 km
Picturesque environment of Horka nad Moravou
Part of the Great Prize of Long-distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: Registration is open until May 1, 2026. Participants agree to the race rules and participate at their own risk. The organizer is not responsible for any injuries. The race is part of the series of the Great Prize of Long-distance Runners of the Olomouc Region. The race takes place within the regional series and offers not only sporting experiences but also the opportunity to meet the local running community.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - květen
location: Stromovka Park, Praha 7, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and skill levels, including children up to 12 years old running 1.6 km. The race is ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park environment. After the race, every participant is served a warm cinnamon pancake. The time is measured for each runner and results are published online, counting towards the annual Pancake Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt paths in Stromovka
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km), children 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Královská obora - Stromovka park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (under the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of prior online registration for faster check-in. Recommended transportation includes cycling, walking, rollerblading, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is recommended at the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are changing tents and a non-guarded storage for belongings, as well as a mobile valuables storage. WC cabins are available on site. The race is part of the year-round Cup, starting at 9:07, registration from 8:15 to 8:45, online registration available, parking at the bridge to Císařský Island, changing rooms and toilets available, participants are divided into categories by age.

name: Letohradská pětka
location: Orlovna na Orlici, Letohrad, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Letohradská pětka is cross-country running race for children and adults, taking place on May 2, 2026, in Letohrad at Orlovna on Orlice. The race course is between 100 and 5000 meters long depending on the category and mainly runs through field and forest paths. The race offers a friendly atmosphere and is part of the Orel Running League. Registration takes place in the morning, and the main race starts at noon.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly through field and forest paths
Course length from 100 to 5000 meters depending on the category
Start at Orlovna on Orlice
additional: Registration for the children's category is from 8:30 to 9:45, for the adult category from 8:30 to 11:30. The start of the first category is at 10:00, the main race begins at 12:00. The course runs through field and forest paths, starting at Orlovna on Orlice, the race is part of the ISCAREX CUP 2025 and the Orel Youth Running League.

name: Přespolní běh Říp - Roudnice nad Labem
location: Tyršovo stadion, Roudnice nad Labem, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné se platí při prezenci – dospělí 100,-Kč

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startovné se platí při prezenci – děti 50,-Kč

description: Cross-country race Říp in Roudnice nad Labem is a traditional event with a rich history, held at Tyršův Stadium and around Mount Říp. The race offers various courses for all age groups from preschoolers to adults and veterans, with distances ranging from 300 meters to 15,200 meters. Registration fee is paid at check-in, and the race is suitable for the general public who want to enjoy a sports day in beautiful nature. The event is organized by T. J. Sokol Roudnice nad Labem, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities for competitors and spectators.
course_highlights: Various courses from 300 m for preschoolers to 15,200 m for endurance runners
Start and finish at Tyršův Stadium with routes passing through Mount Říp
Categories divided by age and gender with courses around Roudnice nad Labem
additional: Registration begins at 8:00 AM at Tyršův Stadium, children and youth until 8:45 AM, adults until 9:30 AM. Categories are divided by age with different starting points. The race is organized by T. J. Sokol Roudnice n.L. with contact on site and a phone number. The course is marked and secured by event staff and city police; registration is via the onZávody.cz system, start at Tyršův Stadium, registration from 8:00 to 9:30.

name: Hornobludovická sedmička
location: Horní Bludovice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Hornobludovická sedmička is a traditional running race in Horní Bludovice, held on a challenging, hilly course approximately 7 km long with an elevation gain of about 100 meters, including 63 steps on the Žermanice Dam embankment. The race is part of the Karviná District Running Cup and offers beautiful sporting experiences on a mixed surface of road, gravel, and field paths. After the race, results will be announced, a raffle will be held, and there will be seating with refreshments at the FC Horní Bludovice football complex, which provides facilities including changing rooms and showers. It welcomes runners of all categories and age groups with material prizes for the top three in each category.
course_highlights: 7 km course with an elevation gain of approximately 100 m including 63 steps on the Žermanice Dam embankment
Mixed surface: road, gravel, field path
Challenging hilly and varied course
additional: Registration on race day from 9:00 to 10:00 at the FC Horní Bludovice football field. Refreshments available at the start and finish line as per organizer’s possibilities. After the race, there will be a raffle and seating with refreshments. Categories divided by age and gender with material prizes for the top three in each category. Facilities with changing rooms and showers at the football complex. Parking at the football field. The race will take place on May 2, 2026, with registration open from January 1 to May 1, 2026, and it is part of the Karviná Cup 2026.

name: Běh Klobasnou
location: Lesy u Veselí nad Lužnicí, Veselí nad Lužnicí, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Klobasnou Run is a traditional running race organized by the athletic club in Veselí nad Lužnicí, which is held for the 64th time. The race offers various categories including a family run over 1 km and children's races, where participants receive medals, trophies, and material prizes. Registration is possible in advance and on the day of the race, making organization easier and reducing waiting times. The event takes place in a pleasant sports atmosphere and is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: Traditional running race with a 64-year history
Family run over 1 km and children's categories
Pleasant atmosphere and sports complex in Veselí nad Lužnicí
additional: Registration is possible in advance and on the day of the race from 9:00 to 11:00 AM, no later than 30 minutes before the start. On race day, only the entry fee is paid and the start number is collected. Children’s categories and the family run receive a participation medal. The club also offers the sale of jerseys, caps, and headbands. Parking is available in the sports complex. The race includes various routes, including children's and family runs, with on-site or pre-registration, forest and gravel paths, and a hilly profile of the courses.

name: Mistrovství ČR v maratonu mužů a žen
location: Staroměstské náměstí, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Czech Republic Marathon Championship 2026 for men and women is a prestigious race on the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, taking place on May 3, 2026, in Prague with the start at Old Town Square. The race is open to men, women, and juniors over 18 who meet the specified participation limits. Registration is conducted via the RunCzech website until April 15, 2026. The race office will be open on May 1 and 2, 2026, at the Exhibition Grounds in Holešovice. The race starts at 08:00.
course_highlights: The marathon route begins at Old Town Square in Prague
Classic marathon distance of 42.195 km
The race is part of the prestigious RunCzech running series
additional: The race office is open on May 1 and 2, 2026, from 10:00 to 20:00 at the Křižík Pavilion at the Exhibition Grounds in Holešovice. Only runners who have met the participation limits between January 1, 2025, and the registration deadline can register. Inclusion is decided by the technical delegate, and participants will be informed via email. Registration is open until April 15, 2026, with a participant limit set from January 1, 2024. The race is part of the national marathon championship.

name: Běh na 2 míle, Zlín – Příluky
location: Průmyslová zóna Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of less than two laps on a precisely measured asphalt track. The race takes place every first Saturday of the month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. Each participant is rewarded at the finish line with a warm cinnamon flatbread as a token of appreciation.
course_highlights: Precisely measured asphalt track of just under 2 laps
Course mostly runs between gardens in the industrial zone
Children's course length is 800 meters
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women from 13 to 127 years old and children up to 12 years old, with age categories valid throughout the calendar year. Time is measured for each runner, and the top three in male, female, and children's categories are awarded small prizes. The recommended way to reach the start is by bike, on foot, by car, rollerblades, or trolleybus No. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). The race is held regularly every month, registration is voluntary, and at the finish line, participants are served a warm cinnamon flatbread. The course is precisely measured and suitable for all running levels.

name: Prague International Marathon 2026
location: Staroměstské náměstí, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Prague International Marathon 2026 is a prestigious running event held in the historic center of Prague. The race offers a traditional marathon course of 42.195 km, passing through iconic city landmarks. The running weekend also includes accompanying races for families and children, creating a friendly atmosphere for all age groups. The start is scheduled for May 3, 2026, at 8:00 AM at Old Town Square.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic center of Prague with views of landmarks
Start and finish at Old Town Square
Marathon distance of 42.195 km with timed results
additional: The running weekend also includes races such as Active Breakfast Run (4.2 km), dm Family Mile (1.609 km), and dm Bambini Run (children's races 100-200 m). Participants can use the RunCzech mobile app for race information and a virtual packet. The race is part of the RunCzech running league and offers special categories, including the Czech Republic Championship in the men's and women's marathon. The 42.195 km race starts on Sunday, May 3, 2026, at 8:00 AM; registration includes access to additional events like Active Breakfast Run, dm Family Mile, and dm Bambini Run.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily with themselves. It also includes a trophy competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficients and runners collect points throughout the year. Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The top three places in each category are awarded.
course_highlights: Race in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc near the fountain
Distance of the course 2 miles (3.2 km), children's course 600 m
Friendly atmosphere for runners of all levels and age categories
additional: Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The race location is near the fountain in Smetanovy Sady, except for two races in June and August, which are run along the river on U Dětského domova street. Results are adjusted according to age coefficients and runners earn points for the trophy competition for the period September 2025 - August 2026. The race includes categories for all age groups, with the best in each category announced; the course runs through Smetanovy Sady and along the river, with registration from 9:30 to 10:00.

name: ORLEN Maraton Praha, MČR v maratonu mužů a žen
location: Staroměstské náměstí, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The ORLEN Prague Marathon is a prestigious marathon race held in the historic center of Prague, which also serves as the Czech Republic's championship for men and women in marathon running. The race traditionally covers the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, starting at Old Town Square. The event attracts thousands of runners and offers a unique atmosphere with beautiful views of Prague's landmarks. It is part of the RunCzech running league and is known for its professional organization and support for the running community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Old Town Square in Prague
The route passes through the historic center of Prague with views of landmarks
Classic marathon distance of 42.195 km
additional: The marathon weekend also includes accompanying runs such as ORLEN active breakfast (4.2 km), dm family mile (1.609 km), and dm bambini run (children's runs 100-200 m). The start package and additional information are available in the RunCzech mobile app. The race is part of the RunCzech running league and offers support for runners, including insurance and re-registration. The event features various categories, including relay races and accompanying runs, and is a significant sporting event with international participation. The route is challenging but offers a unique experience of running in the historic environment of Prague.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Řevnice
location: Pivovar Řevnice, Řevnice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka running series in Řevnice is part of a traditional series of races held in the picturesque environment of the Central Bohemian Region. The route mainly follows the green educational trail with beautiful views of the surrounding fields, meadows, and forests, and includes two long ascents, including passing through the Forest Theatre and the Píšťák pond. The start and finish are located at the Řevnice brewery, where refreshments and baggage storage are provided. The race is suitable for runners who want to enjoy nature and the community atmosphere of the running series.
course_highlights: The route mainly follows the green educational trail marked with red and white signs
Two long ascents, including passing through the Forest Theatre up to Píšťák pond
Views of the surrounding fields, meadows, and forests with a return around the cemetery and Havlíčkovy Sady park
additional: Registration is possible online and on-site from 17:00, with a recommended arrival by 17:30. On-site refreshments and baggage storage are available. The top three places in each category will receive diplomas. The race includes a natural terrain course, registration is also possible on-site, and race numbers, refreshments, and awards for the best in each category are provided.

name: Jarní kros Písařova
location: Tatran Písařov, Písařov, Olomoucký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Písařov Spring Cross is a traditional running race organized by SK Pašerák in the village of Písařov. This race is part of the district running competition CHLAPÁK and is open to the general public, including children. The event takes place at the Tatran Písařov sports field and offers a sporting experience in a friendly environment. The SK Pašerák club has long been dedicated to organizing sports activities for children and youth in the region.
course_highlights: Race takes place at the Tatran Písařov sports field
Part of the district running competition CHLAPÁK
Traditional spring cross-country race in the village of Písařov
additional: The race will be held on Wednesday, May 6, 2026, starting at 5:00 PM at the Tatran Písařov sports field. The organizer is SK Pašerák, which also organizes the Children's Cup - a series of races for children in various sports disciplines. The race is scheduled for May 6, 2026, the event is in Czech language, and it promotes an active lifestyle among youth in the region.

name: Běh lesoparkem Praha Hostivař
location: Lesopark Hostivař, Praha 10, Czech Republic
description: Trail run through the Hostivař Forest Park in Prague is a terrain race offering two course options: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Hostivař Forest Park in Prague 10 and is part of the SABZO series. This run is suitable for everyone who wants to enjoy running in nature with gentle elevation and a pleasant atmosphere. The race is ideal for trail running enthusiasts and offers the opportunity to compete with other runners in the beautiful setting of the Hostivař forest.
course_highlights: Terrain course in Hostivař Forest Park
Two course lengths: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men
Part of the SABZO series
additional: Registration is possible for a fee of 50 CZK, free for members of TJ Zentiva and SABZO. The race takes place in Prague 10-Hostivař, around the pavilion near the children's playground in Hostivař Forest Park.

name: Žďárák – Čerňák
location: Čerňák, Žďár nad Sázavou, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 50 Kč (startovné bude opět věnováno na dobročinnou sbírku, tentokrát pro Charitu, která podpoří Alexe Vondru, studenta ze Žďáru, který přišel o ruku a potřebuje peníze na sportovní protézu.)

description: Chernyák is a trail race run along the paths of the Black Forest near Zelená Hora and the surrounding meadows towards Vysoký. The 7 km course with an elevation gain of 180 meters offers varied terrain with 90% off-road surface and 10% asphalt, reminiscent of Scottish fell running races. The race is popular among local runners and features beautiful views of the town Žďár nad Sázavou and the UNESCO monument - the pilgrimage church of St. John of Nepomuk at Zelená Hora. The start and finish are at the parking lot by the church at Zelená Hora. The entry fee is donated to a charity collection for a sports prosthesis for student Alex Vondra.
course_highlights: 7 km trail race with an elevation gain of 180 m
Course runs along paths of the Black Forest and meadows towards Vysoký
Final climb up the stairs to the church at Zelená Hora, a UNESCO monument
additional: Start and finish at the parking lot by the church at Zelená Hora. Trail shoes are recommended. The entry fee is donated to a charity collection for a sports prosthesis. The route is marked. Photos from the race are available online. The races include trail, cross-country, road, gravel, and MTB disciplines; registration and detailed routes are provided on the website.

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice
location: České Budějovice, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice

price_tiers.distance: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: Night Run for Svetluška in České Budějovice is a charitable running event taking place on May 6, 2026, starting at 9:00 PM near the sports hall by Stromovka. Participants can choose between two routes - 2.3 km (1 lap) and 4.6 km (2 laps), and the run is suitable for both runners and those who wish to walk the route. The registration fee is 500 CZK, half of which goes directly to aid for the severely visually impaired. The event offers start packages with a headlamp or sports headband and an accompanying program including a concert by the band Byt číslo 4.
course_highlights: Night run with options between 2.3 km and 4.6 km routes
Start and finish at the sports hall by Stromovka in České Budějovice
Charitable run supporting the severely visually impaired
additional: Registration counters are open from 19:00. The capacity of the run is limited for safety and participant comfort. Start packages are available in two variants - with a headlamp or a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP, and ZTP/P cards with an escort can enter for free; they can purchase a start package on-site for 250 CZK. An entry ticket with a unique code (printed or on mobile) is required to access the area. The program includes a concert by the band Byt číslo 4 from 20:00. The route options are 2.3 km or 4.6 km, with an accompanying program, benefits for the Svetluška project, registration via GoOut.cz, tickets with codes, and free entry for ZTP and ZTP/P cardholders.

name: Mistrovství ČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km mužů a žen
location: Lázeňská kolonáda, Poděbrady, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Czech National Championship in road running for 1 mile and 5 km in Poděbrady is the inaugural open championship of the Czech Republic on these distances. The race takes place in the beautiful environment of the spa promenade with certified, very fast, and flat circuits that directly invite personal bests. Organized by the Czech Athletic Federation, the event is an ideal opportunity for runners of all levels to compete against the best in the Czech Republic. The day after the race, the European Championship in race walking is held on the same courses.
course_highlights: Certified circuits in the spa promenade
Very fast and flat course
Beautiful environment of Poděbrady
additional: The first category starts at 14:00, the main category starts at 15:00. The registration fee ranges from 250 to 550 CZK. The course is certified, and the European Championship in race walking takes place here the day after the race. The 5 km course consists of 5 laps of 1 km each, and the 1 mile course is a combination of an initial segment and a 1 km lap; the race is suitable for competitors over 15 years old and offers online registration and transfer options.

name: Běh vítězství Jihlava – Třešť
location: Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč online, 200 Kč na místě pro dospělé; zdarma pro mládež do 17 let online, 50 Kč na místě
description: Victory Run Jihlava - Třešť is an annual running event held on May 8, 2026, offering various race categories including adults, juniors, and children. The course runs from Jihlava to Třešť and includes both road sections and forest trails, with the main race measuring 14.6 km. The event is part of the Vysočina Running Cup and offers not only sporting experiences but also prizes and material rewards for winners. Registrations are possible online, and the race is suitable for the general public, including youth and children.
course_highlights: Main course of 14.6 km from Jihlava to Třešť on roads and forest trails
Categories for different age groups including children and youth
Part of the Vysočina Running Cup with online registration options
additional: The course includes asphalt roads and forest trails; the race starts approximately between 8:45 and 9:45; race categories for children and youth; winners receive prizes and material rewards; the race is complemented by refreshments and showers.

name: Běh vítězství zámeckým parkem Lány
location: Lány, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Sokol Lány, Základní škola Charlotty Garrigue Masarykové Lány
price_range: 50 Kč pro děti a mládež, 100 Kč pro dospělé, zdarma pro účastníky akce 'Běh pro zdraví'

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Děti a mládež do 18 let 50 Kč

description: The Victory Run through the Lány Castle Park is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1972, held annually on May 8th in the castle park in Lány. The race offers a wide range of categories for children and adults with distances from 60 meters up to 7800 meters. The surface of the routes is mainly sandy, gravelly, and grassy, creating a pleasant and diverse running environment. The races start at 8:20 AM and continue throughout the morning, with spectators also able to enjoy the atmosphere. Organized by TJ Sokol Lány and the Charlotta Garrigue Masaryk Elementary School under the auspices of the Lány Municipality.
course_highlights: Routes mainly run on sandy and gravel paths and grass in the castle park
Main women's race is 3900 m (one lap), men's race is 7800 m (two laps)
Children's routes from 60 m to 1500 m with color-coded laps
additional: Registration for competitors is on the day of the race from 7:30 AM at the main entrance to the castle park under the castle greenhouse. Participants pick up their start numbers no later than half an hour before their category's start. Line-up at the start begins 5 minutes before the start. Participants of the Health Run start together on a 1200 m route, with the winner determined by a draw. No entry fee is charged for the Health Run. The race begins at 8:20 AM, registration is available online or on-site, and the event has been part of the local sports calendar since 1972.

name: Čavisovská stovka
location: Čavisov, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Čavisovská Hundred is a long-distance walk around Čavisov with routes of 30, 50, and 100 km, taking place for the thirteenth time. The start and finish are at the TJ Sokol sports ground in Čavisov. The routes lead along hiking trails, cycling paths, and marked trails, with a recommendation to use digital recording for navigation at night. Organizers provide refreshments and basic facilities including toilets and showers at the start. The event is suitable for everyone regardless of gender and dog breed, with the option to participate with dogs without a time limit.
course_highlights: Routes lead along hiking trails, cycling paths, and marked trails
Royal route 100 km for experienced, challenging 50 km, and relaxed 30 km
Refreshment stations on the 100 km track at 4 points (16, 26, 53, 79 km)
additional: Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Čavisov sports ground. Routes are not marked on hiking trails and cycling paths; digital recording on watches or phones is recommended. The race ends on May 10, 2025, at 23:59 for all routes, after which the time limit results in DNF. Participation with dogs is possible without a time limit. Toilets and showers are available at the start, with hot water limited by the boiler capacity. The event offers various distances, with online registration available, and routes equipped with maps and profile previews. The walk is intended for the general public, including families and endurance runners.

name: Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice
location: Čechtice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Memorial of the Victims of Fascism Čechtice is a 6 km running race that takes place through the terrain around the village of Čechtice. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup and offers runners the opportunity to test their strength in the picturesque landscape of the Central Bohemian Region. This race is suitable for everyone who enjoys trail running and wants to experience a sporting atmosphere in a pleasant environment.
course_highlights: Trail course around the village of Čechtice
Race length of 6 km
Part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup
additional: The run is part of a memorial day honoring the victims of fascism, emphasizing the historical and social significance of the event.

name: Strážnická stovka
location: Strážnice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Strážnická stovka is an extreme sports event in the heart of the White Carpathians, intended only for persons over 18 years old. This ultratrail marathon offers a challenging 100 km route with a slightly modified 160 km course, testing the determination and physical condition of the competitors. The start and finish are in Strážnice, the race is complemented by refreshment stations and the possibility of drop bag transport. Each participant receives an original start number with their name and a beautiful metal badge as a reward for overcoming their limits.
course_highlights: 100 km route in the nature of the White Carpathians
Refreshment stations and drop bag transport at OS Května
Start number with name and metal badge upon completion
additional: The race has two start groups: the 24-hour limit starts on Friday, May 8, 2026 at 19:30 for participants without trophy ambitions, the 15-hour limit starts on Saturday, May 9, 2026 at 5:00 for competitors aiming for a trophy. Accreditation takes place on Friday, May 8 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday, May 9 from 4:15 to 4:45 (without drop bag option). The registration fee includes refreshments on the course and at the facilities, timing is provided by ORGSU chips, and there is an option to transfer the start fee to a substitute. A T-shirt with the logo is an optional item available for order via the online shop. Registration opens on November 3, 2025. The race is intended only for adults, the course includes demanding terrains and technical sections.

name: Poděbrady Running - MČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km a veřejný běh na 5 km
location: Lázeňská kolonáda, Poděbrady, Czech Republic
description: Poděbrady Running is the premier open Czech national championship in road running for 1 mile and 5 km, complemented by a public 5 km race. The race takes place in the beautiful environment of the spa promenade in Poděbrady and offers certified, very fast and flat circuits where world records are broken. This race is an ideal opportunity for runners who want to set a personal best and experience the competitive atmosphere alongside the best Czech athletes.
course_highlights: Certified circuits in the spa promenade
Very fast and flat course suitable for personal records
Beautiful environment of Poděbrady
additional: The race is organized by the Czech Athletic Federation. The start of the first and main category is at 12:00 PM. The course is certified and suitable for fast times. Registration fee can be paid in advance or on-site with a surcharge. The 5 km course consists of 5 laps of 1 km each, and the race is certified for the European Walking Championships. Registration is possible in advance or on-site. The time limit for 5 km is 38 minutes. The race is suitable for participants aged 15 and above.

name: Běh osvobození
location: Lišany, Díly, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: SK Lišany, z.s. / TJ Sokol Díly
description: The Liberation Run is a traditional road race on a route between the villages of Lišany and Lužná in the Plzeň Region. The race covers 7 km and takes place on a lightly trafficked third-class road. The start is at 11:15 AM after registration at the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany. The race is divided into six age categories and is part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Runners Cup. Cash prizes are awarded to the best competitors in each category as well as for breaking course records.
course_highlights: 7000 m route on a lightly trafficked third-class road Lišany-Lužná-Lišany
Start and finish at the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany
Breaking course records with monetary bonuses
additional: Registration begins at 9:30 AM at the U Hřiště restaurant (sokolovna) in Lišany. Entries are possible on-site no later than 30 minutes before the start. Results and awards are scheduled around 12:30 PM. The race is divided into four men's and two women's categories. Financial prizes and diplomas are awarded to the top six competitors in each category. Bonuses are also awarded for speed segments and record-breaking performances. Participants or their sending organizations are responsible for health status and start-up costs. The races are open to various age groups, including non-members of ČUS, and include monetary prizes and bonuses. The course runs on a lightly trafficked road and the races are part of regional cups.

name: Czechia Backyard Ultra Run
location: Zámecký park, Holešov, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Czechia Backyard Ultra Run 2026 is the fourth edition of a unique ultra running race with the motto "Run as long as you can". The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the castle park in Holešov and is classified as a Silver Ticket race, allowing participation in an international endurance competition. Runners complete a 6.706-kilometer loop, which must be run within a 60-minute limit, and they must start each new lap on the hour until only the last runner remains. The race is live-streamed and offers full facilities including showers, toilets, and refreshments.
course_highlights: A 6.706 km loop in the castle park in Holešov
The route passes around the castle, a water stream, and an asphalt cycle path
Start and finish at the swimming pool area with complete facilities
additional: Maximum number of participants is limited to 100 runners. Transfer registration to another competitor is possible until April 24, 2026. The registration fee includes a personalized start number indicating the number of completed laps, a commemorative medal, and refreshments. Showers, toilets, a medic, and constant supervision at the start/finish area are available. The race will be live-streamed. Terrain: castle park, registration: online, rules: running on a 6.7056 km loop every hour, without outside assistance including other runners, live streaming, max. 100 participants, no poles, showers, toilets, heated changing rooms available.

name: Memoriál otce Jožky
location: Stěbořice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Orel jednota Stěbořice, Farnost Stěbořice, Obec Stěbořice
description: The Memorial of Father Jožka is a traditional running race held in Stěbořice in the Moravian-Silesian Region, honoring the memory of priest Josef Motyka. The race offers various courses including 10 km and 4 km, suitable for men, women, and youth, as well as short distances for preschoolers. The event is organized by local clubs and the municipality and is open to the general public, who can enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the picturesque surroundings of Stěbořice. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and support of sports in the region.
course_highlights: Courses lead through the scenic surroundings of Stěbořice
Various distances from 100 m for preschoolers to 10 km for adults
The race is suitable for all age groups including veterans
additional: Participants and spectators are advised not to enter the course with dogs during the race. Registration is open, and the race takes place to honor the memory of priest Josef Motyka and is part of the local cultural calendar.

name: Běh Černou Horou
location: Černá Hora, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Black Mountain Run is a traditional cross-country race with a rich history dating back to 1928, making it the fourth oldest race in the Czech Republic. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Černá Hora and offers courses for all age groups, including children's categories with up to 200 participants. The main course measures 9.2 km and runs around Černá Hora Castle, and the race is part of the Blansko District Running League. The event is suitable for runners of all performance levels and provides a challenging yet beautiful running experience.
course_highlights: 4 loops around Černá Hora Castle, each 2.3 km
Main course 9.2 km with scenic views of the castle
Course suitable for all age groups including children
additional: Registration of competitors takes place at the old cabins building of the sports complex in Černá Hora. Parking is available at the adjacent parking lot right next to the sports complex. The race is part of the Blansko District Running League. It is suitable for beginners and advanced runners, offering relay races and children's courses, and is included in the local sports calendar.

name: Běh Mánesovou stezkou
location: Lutín, Olomouc, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Sigma Lutín a TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc
description: The Mánesova Trail Run is an endurance cross-country and trail race held in Lutín in the Olomouc Region. The course is moderately hilly and mainly runs on district roads, forest and field paths. The race offers two distance options: 23 km for men and 16.5 km for women and men over 60. It is organized by TJ Sigma Lutín and TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc with the aim of offering runners an interesting and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs on district roads, forest and field paths
Moderately hilly terrain suitable for cross-country and trail running
Two course lengths: 23 km and 16.5 km
additional: The race is organized by TJ Sigma Lutín and TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc. The start is at the Sigma Lutín stadium. The course is designed for men, women, and men over 60 with different distances. The race is part of the Czech Running Club. It is suitable for runners seeking a moderately challenging course with diverse terrain, registration and further information are available on the official website.

name: Vltava Run 2026
location: Zadov, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Základní startovné 29.700 Kč / 1.215 € včetně DPH pro jeden tým. Předregistrace do 30. 9. 2025.

description: Vltava Run is a relay running race over 375 km long, leading from Šumava to Prague. The route passes through the Šumava National Park, along the Vltava River, through forests, around dams, beautiful valleys, hills, historic towns, and villages of South Bohemia and Central Bohemia regions. The race is designed for teams of 6 to 12 runners of any gender and offers a unique running experience along the most beautiful path to the finish line. The race starts at the Zadov - Churáňov cross-country skiing stadium at dawn and the finish is in Prague in the afternoon.
course_highlights: 375 km long route from Šumava to Prague
Guided along hiking trails, roads of class II and III
Passage through Šumava National Park, around Vltava dams, and historic towns
additional: The race is a relay with fixed transfer points. Teams can have 6 to 12 runners of any gender. The expected time for a runner to complete 10 km in the last year must not exceed 60 minutes. Runners must be at least 18 years old, 15 years old with written parental consent and a parent’s membership in the same team. Registration includes mandatory information and questions regarding race rules, which must be answered correctly for successful registration. The race is divided into multiple control points, with teams of 6-12 runners participating, offering a unique experience of running in nature with the opportunity to explore the beauty of South Bohemia and Central Bohemia regions.

name: Kros Merklín-Plešivec
location: Sjezdovka v Merklíně, Merklín, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: The Merklín-Plešivec Cross is a mountain running race over 6.5 km, which takes place on forest paths and initially on a ski slope in the Ore Mountains. This race is part of the Karlovy Vary Region Runners League and offers runners challenging terrain with beautiful natural scenery. The race is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts who want to test their endurance and strength in a hilly environment.
course_highlights: 6.5 km course with elevation in the Ore Mountains
Forest paths and initial section on a ski slope
Part of the Karlovy Vary Region Runners League
additional: The course includes mountain terrain, registration details are not specified, the race is suitable for runners seeking an outdoor challenge.

name: Memoriál Jana Janovského
location: Blatná, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Jana Janovský Memorial is a traditional sporting event organized by TJ Sokol Blatná, held in Blatná in the area under Sokolovna and the castle park. The races are primarily intended for children and youth, with categories from the youngest children to adults, and take place on asphalt and forest paths. The first race starts at 9:00 AM, and registration is conducted in person no later than 15 minutes before the start of the respective category. The event is supported by the South Bohemian Region and offers technical facilities including toilets, changing rooms, and baggage storage.
course_highlights: Surface of the course: asphalt and forest trail
Start and finish in the area under Sokolovna and the castle park
Categories for children from 3 years old to adults
additional: Registration is conducted in person no later than 15 minutes before the start of the respective category. Toilets, changing rooms, baggage storage, and washrooms are available. The race is supported by grant programs from the South Bohemian Region focused on sports activities for children and youth. The event is part of the local sports tradition, with registration possible in person before the race, and is supported by regional grants.

name: Novojičínský půlmaratón
location: Náměstí v Novém Jičíně, Nový Jičín, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 400,- Kč v rámci on-line registrace do 31.3.2026 i jeden člen štafety

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 500,- Kč v rámci on-line registrace od 1.4.2026 do 30.4. 2026 i jeden člen štafety

description: The Nový Jičín Half Marathon is an open race with a maximum capacity of 400 participants over 18 years old, taking place on May 9, 2026, in Nový Jičín. The route runs through scenic countryside along the award-winning KOLEJE cycle path from Nový Jičín through Hodslavice, Mořkov, and Hostašovice back, mostly on asphalt. The race also offers a relay for 2x10.5 km and is suitable for runners seeking a quality half marathon experience with refreshments on the course and at the finish line. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square in Nový Jičín, with the race starting at 9:00 AM.
course_highlights: The route runs along the award-winning KOLEJE cycle path
95% asphalt surface, 5% paving
Refreshments on the course at kilometers 6.5; 11; 17 and at the finish
additional: Race packets are distributed on the day of the race from 07:00 to 08:30. Participants have access to a changing room at the start area. Two pacers are available on the course for times of 2:00 and 1:45 hours. Medical services are provided at the start, refreshment stations, and at the finish. The race takes place in all weather conditions with a maximum time limit of 2:45 hours. The route passes through Nový Jičín, Hodslavice, Mořkov, and Hostašovice; the race is held regardless of weather, with refreshments on the course and after the race, and medals for participants. Registration is open until April 30, 2026.

name: Přísnotický kros
location: Přísnotice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Prísnotice Cross Country is a traditional running race held in Prísnotice in the South Moravian Region, which is part of the Zajíc League as its second round. The race offers a wide range of categories for men, women, youth, and children of all ages, with distances from 110 meters for the youngest to 7,500 meters for adult men. Bib numbers are issued from 8:30 AM, and the race is also open to very young children without league scoring, who can register on the spot. Prísnotice Cross Country is suitable for all runners who want to test their strength in a pleasant environment with quality organization.
course_highlights: Various distances from 110 m for the youngest to 7500 m for adult men
Categories for all age groups including veterans
Part of the Zajíc League, second round of the series
additional: Registration and bib distribution start at 8:30 AM, at least 30 minutes before the start of each category. It is possible to register the youngest children and categories of adults and youth on the spot up to 30 minutes after the start of the respective category. The race takes place in Prísnotice, registration costs 50 CZK, the course is mainly forested with pleasant nature and minimal elevation gain.

name: Závadská desítka
location: Přírodní rezervace Dařanec u Závady, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: od 01.04.2026 do 12.04.2026 - 1. vlna registrace: 250,- Kč, (startovní číslo se jménem v ceně)

description: Závadská desítka is a cross-country run over 10 km held on forest paths around the Daranec nature reserve. This race is very attractive and has become a traditional part of the Prazsko-Opava Running League (POBL), where it is considered the most attractive short-distance race. The route is secured by event staff, and a refreshment station is prepared at the 6th kilometer. The race is divided into several men's, women's, and youth categories, including categories for local residents and natives of Závada, who compete for a traveling trophy.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on forest paths in the Daranec nature reserve
Refreshment station at the 6th kilometer
Safety secured by event staff
additional: The race is part of the Prazsko-Opava Running League (POBL). In addition to the main 10 km race, there are also children's races over 100 m, 500 m, and 1000 m, as well as a 4 km and 10 km walk. A start number with a name is included in the first wave registration. Terrain: 90% forest path, 10% asphalt; registration in waves, refreshments, start package; race categories based on age and gender.

name: 50 mil železnohorských
location: Náměstí míru, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The 50-mile Iron Mountains Ultramarathon is a race held in the beautiful environment of the Iron Mountains in Heřmanův Městec. The course passes through historic fortresses, castles, hillforts, and oppida, offering a unique opportunity to explore the region up close. The race is open to both individuals and relay teams and is part of the Vládce Mrdic series. The event takes place on May 9, 2026, and welcomes all running enthusiasts seeking a challenge and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: The course passes through historic fortresses, castles, and oppida in the Iron Mountains
Participants can compete as individuals or relay teams
Part of the Vládce Mrdic series with beautiful trail sections
additional: The race offers a course approximately 81 km long, with the possibility of participation on bicycles or scooters as a secondary category. Registration is recommended in advance.

name: Barvám neutečeš – Olomouc
location: Výstaviště Flora, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Color Run in Olomouc is a colorful race full of joy, friendship, and fun, taking place on May 9, 2026, at Výstaviště Flora. It offers two routes - 5 km with five color zones and 1.5 km with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. The event is not about speed but about shared experience, music, and entertainment for all ages, families, and individuals. The start package includes a T-shirt, colors, a medal, and other accessories that enhance the colorful experience.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 color zones
1.5 km route with 3 color zones and an interactive sports zone
Color zones shower runners with colors from head to toe
additional: Online registration ends on May 7, 2026, at 20:00; after this date, registration is only possible on-site until capacity is reached. The start package includes a T-shirt, a sackpack, Holi color, a sheet of limited-edition tattoos, a bubble blower, a start number, and a medal. The event is suitable for individuals and teams (team = 4 or more people). Various registration packages are available, including options for teams, and it is also suitable for children. There is a charitable component and an interactive sports zone.

name: Vrchlabí - Strážné
location: Vrchlabí, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Vrchlabí - Strážné is a traditional cross-country mountain running race that takes you from Vrchlabí to Strážné over three hills and two descents. The route is varied and offers challenging climbs, technical descents, and fast flat sections, making it ideal for mountain running enthusiasts. The race is part of the Czech Cup in mountain running and the regional championship of the Hradec Králové Region. The start is at the Střelnice cultural house in Vrchlabí, and the finish is at the parking lot in Strážné. The race is a tribute to Jan "Pída" Herbs, the spiritual father of the event.
course_highlights: The route mainly runs through terrain on forest and meadow paths
Challenging ascent to Jankův hill and technical descent around Jankův grove
The finish features almost 1.5 km of fast flat running and a sprint on asphalt
additional: Transport of competitors from the finish to the start is not provided; it is recommended to use the yellow tourist trail. Refreshments are available at the finish. Recommended footwear includes cross-country or trail shoes. The race is part of the regional championship of the Hradec Králové Region, with refreshments and a friendly atmosphere at the finish.

name: Na dvě rozhledny s Nadačním fondem Bernard
location: Humpolec, Vysočina, Czech Republic
price_range: 300 Kč za jednotlivce, 500 Kč za rodinu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné činí 500 Kč za rodinu (rodiče a děti do 15 let)

description: Charity Run 'To Two Lookouts' with the Bernard Foundation is a sports and social event organized by the Bernard Family Brewery in Humpolec. The race starts in intervals with gaps and passes through two control points - the Bernard Lookout and the castle lookout at Orlík. The route is conducted on both paved and unpaved paths, allowing participants to choose their own strategy and navigation. After the race, refreshments including beer and medals for the first 100 registered participants are provided at the finish line. The event is intended for persons over 15 years old; younger participants must have the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: The route passes through two lookouts - Bernard and Orlík Castle
Participants must pass through two control points marked on the race card
The route is a combination of paved and unpaved paths with free navigation
additional: Start is interval-based with 30-second gaps for racers and 5-minute gaps for groups of up to 15 hikers. At Orlík Castle, water is available for racers. Each participant is entitled to refreshments at the finish line, including alcoholic/non-alcoholic beer. Medals are provided for the first 100 registered participants. Participants must have both control points marked on their race card; the time limit is 2 hours from the start. Persons under 15 may participate only accompanied by a guardian or with written consent. The route is approximately 5 km long, with the start scheduled at 12:30, and the race duration is up to 2 hours. Start intervals are 30 seconds and 5 minutes. The event is supported by the Bernard Foundation for Help.

name: FREEDOM RUN
location: Harrachov, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: FREEDOM RUN is a cross-border mountain run in the Krkonoše Mountains, offering two route options. The shorter Classic route, 9 km long, runs from Harrachov through Nový Svět and the Mýtiny area to Polish Orle, ending in Jakuszyce, a well-known sports center. The longer Mega route, 16 km long, is more technically and physically demanding, with greater elevation gain and beautiful mountain scenery, ideal for more experienced runners. Both routes start in Harrachov and pass through picturesque mountain nature and forest trails with open plains of the Krkonoše Mountains.
course_highlights: Cross-border route from Czechia to Poland
Beautiful mountain nature and forest trails in the Krkonoše Mountains
Finish line in the sports center Jakuszyce
additional: The registration fee includes a start number and a chip for timing. The race features mountain terrains, forest trails, and cross-border sections; registration is required, safety rules and race regulations apply.

name: Charitativní běh pro Emmičku
location: Kramolna u hasičské zbrojnice, Kramolna, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Charity run for Emmička takes place on Saturday, May 9, 2026, in Kramolna near the fire station. The event offers two routes - 3 km and 7 km, as well as a children's route of 200 meters. The routes run along paved forest paths, suitable for sports strollers and wheelchairs. The run is dog-friendly, and dogs must be on a leash or harness at all times. Participants can complete the course by running or walking at their own pace.
course_highlights: Routes run along paved forest paths
Option to complete the course with sports strollers and wheelchairs
Event is DOG friendly, dogs must be on a leash or harness
additional: The routes are suitable for sports strollers and wheelchairs. The run is dog-friendly, and dogs must be on a leash or harness. The course can be completed by running or walking. The event is traditionally held at the fire station in Kramolna. It is DOG friendly, participants can run or walk, registration is via sport-reg.cz, date May 9, 2026.

name: Běh Mánesovou stezkou
location: Sigma Stadion, Lutín, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Mánesova Trail Run is a cross-country race held at Sigma Stadium in Lutín, offering a 23 km course for men and 16.5 km for women. The race is part of the Great Prize of Long-Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region and features challenging terrain suitable for cross-country enthusiasts. Participants can expect beautiful natural scenery and a challenge in the form of a hilly route. The race is suitable for experienced runners seeking a quality sporting experience in the region.
course_highlights: Cross-country race with a length of 23 km for men and 16.5 km for women
Challenging terrain as part of the Great Prize of Long-Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Start and finish at Sigma Stadium in Lutín
additional: The race takes place on the route 'to Kosíř and back'; registration and further details are not explicitly provided.

name: Běh ve Skalce – Memoriál Radomila Večeři
location: Skalka u Prostějova, Olomoucký, Czech Republic
description: The Run in Skalka - Radomil Večeř Memorial is a traditional cross-country race held in the picturesque environment of Skalka near Prostějov. The race offers quality facilities and excellent organizer care, making it a popular event among amateur runners. The course is challenging and attractive, ideal for runners seeking a natural challenge. The organizer is the Marathon Club Prostějov, which takes care of regular running events in the region.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in the natural environment of Skalka near Prostějov
Quality facilities and organizer care
Traditional race with a challenging and attractive course
additional: The race is part of the local running calendar, registrations are available on the organizer's website, the course is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Běh kolem Babího lomu
location: Babí lom, Kuřim, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 100 Kč (zahrnuto občerstvení po závodě, pro děti je startovné dobrovolné)

description: The Babí lom Run is a traditional race as part of the Kuřim Running League, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Kuřim-Podlesí. The race offers a main run of 8.4 km and a children's fun run of 2.6 km. Both start and registration are at the Cultural House in Kuřim-Podlesí, where refreshments are also provided after the race. The event is organized by the athletic club AK Kuřim and is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: Main run of 8.4 km in terrain around Babí lom
Children's fun run of 2.6 km
Start and finish at the Cultural House in Kuřim-Podlesí
additional: Registration takes place from 9:00 to 9:45. Refreshments are provided after the race. The registration fee for children is voluntary. The race is part of the Kuřim Running League and is organized by AK Kuřim. The race is held at the lookout tower on Babí lom, with registration until 9:40, start at 10:00, includes a children's run and refreshments after the race.

name: Běh choceňskými sady
location: Choceň, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Chocen Orchards Run is a traditional running race organized by the Chocen Ski Club o.s., held in a picturesque park near the castle in Chocen. The course is up to 15 km long, with a gently undulating profile and a mixed surface of asphalt and forest paths, offering a pleasant running experience. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including youth. The main race traditionally starts at 10:15 AM, with registration possible on-site from 8:00 AM. The race is popular for its friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Course up to 15 km with a gently undulating profile
Mixed surface of asphalt and forest paths
Start and finish in the park near the castle in Chocen
additional: Registrations are also possible on-site from 8:00 AM. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The course is suitable for youth with shorter races. Organizer: Chocen Ski Club o.s. Contact Jiří Hejzlar, phone 733 609 251. The race offers various categories, including accompanying runs for children and adults, on-site registration from 8:00 AM, main race at 10:15 AM.

name: Modrý Werth
location: Luh nad Svatavou, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: Modrý Werth is a running race held in the picturesque environment of Luh nad Svatavou in the Karlovy Vary Region. The race offers precise timing measurement using chip technology and is suitable for the general public as well as competitors. Organizers provide online registration, live results, and quality service for participants. The event is ideal for running enthusiasts who want to experience a competition in beautiful nature with professional organization.
course_highlights: Precise chip timing with LED finish line
Scenic routes around Luh nad Svatavou
Immediate online results and video recordings from the finish line
additional: Passive or active chip timing with high accuracy is used. Reusable ankle chips and one-time chips for start numbers are available. After the race, diplomas can be downloaded and videos from the finish line are accessible. Registration is conducted online with a confirmation email and the option for prepayment. Live results are available immediately after the runner crosses the finish line. The race is complemented by a rich accompanying program, suitable for the whole family, with options to participate in walking and dog trekking.

name: Wings for Life World Run
location: Praha 7, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Wings for Life World Run is the world's largest running event, taking place on May 10, 2026, at 11:00 AM local time. This unique race unites runners, wheelchair users, and beginners worldwide, all starting at the same time and running against the so-called "Catcher Car" — a moving finish line that gradually catches up. All registration fees and donations are dedicated to spinal cord injury research. Participants can join either on-site or via the Wings for Life World Run app, which allows running anywhere and anytime.
course_highlights: Start at the same time worldwide
There is no fixed finish line; the race ends when you are caught by the "Catcher Car"
Open to runners, wheelchair users, and beginners
additional: Registration is possible through the official website or the Wings for Life World Run app. The race can be run anywhere in the world using the app, which tracks runners and the virtual "Catcher Car". All registration fees and donations go to spinal cord injury research. Official running apparel and accessories are available in the online store. The global event offers the option of virtual running via the app or participating in local events, with proceeds supporting spinal cord injury research. Date of event: May 10, 2026.

name: Polevský běh
location: Polevsko-Jedličná, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Polevský run is a traditional running race organized by the Ski Polevsko association in the picturesque environment of the Lusatian Mountains. The race takes place on May 10, 2026, and offers courses of 5 km and 10 km, which lead through rolling hilly terrain on forest paths, pastures, and winter ski trails. It also includes children's races, all with beautiful views of the surrounding mountains and landscape. The race headquarters is at the ski hut on Jedličná between Polevsko and Kytlice, and the race is part of the District Running League Českolipsko.
course_highlights: Rolling hilly terrain in the Lusatian Mountains
The route runs on winter ski trails, forest paths, and pastures
Beautiful views of Klíč, Ještěd, Jedlová, Ralsko, Czech and Saxon Switzerland, Bezděz, and Českolipsko
additional: Registration is conducted online via the website nazavody.cz with options to choose the race of 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, and children's race. The start and finish are at the ski hut on Jedličná. Parking is available on the adjacent parking lot and, if full, also at the winter parking lot under Jedličná. Registration and bib pickup must be completed at least half an hour before the start; otherwise, the participant will not be allowed to start. The 5 km or 10 km course, children's races, online and on-site registration, parking at the ski hut on Jedličná.

name: Lesní běh Kalichem
location: Koberovy, Liberec District, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kalich Forest Run is a traditional sporting event organized by TJ Sokol Koberovy in the beautiful nature of the Bohemian Paradise, specifically in the area called Kalich. The race is open to all age categories from preschoolers to seniors over 60 who enjoy running in nature. The start is divided into categories based on age, ensuring fair competition among runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, active participation of Sokol members, and excellent refreshments after the race. Several dozen to hundreds of runners participate annually.
course_highlights: Run in the beautiful nature of the Bohemian Paradise in the Kalich area
Categories divided by age from preschoolers to seniors
Presence of active Sokol members with course setup and timing
additional: After the race, refreshments are provided, including baked chicken thighs, sausages, and draft beer. The event is supported by the Liberec Region and is one of the longest-running in the region. Results and photos from previous years are available on Facebook and the website. The run takes place in the nature of the Bohemian Paradise, with start divided by age, and refreshments including chicken thighs, sausages, and beer. The event has a long-standing tradition.

name: Krčský kros
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Czech Republic
description: Krčský cross country is an annual obstacle and terrain running race in Krč Forest in Prague, offering various distances including 4 km, 6 km, and 12 km. The event is suitable for the general public and families, taking place in the natural environment of the park with diverse terrain, including flat sections, descents, and ascents. The organizer is the Sabzo Running Club, which supports sports activities in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series and is ideal for runners of all levels who want to experience a sports day in nature.
course_highlights: Diverse terrain with flat sections, descents, and ascents
Available distances of 4 km, 6 km, and 12 km
Natural environment of Krč Forest in Prague 4
additional: The race is part of the SABZO series, offers various distances, and is suitable for the general public and families. Registration details are not specified.

name: Běh Violky
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Jeseníky, Czech Republic
description: The Violka Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Kouty nad Desnou in Olomouc. This race attracts runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the beautiful nature of the Jeseníky Mountains. Exact details about the length of the course and the organizer are not publicly available, but the race is part of a broader series of running events in the Czech Republic. Registrations and further information are usually published on regional websites and the organizers' social media channels.
course_highlights: Picturesque nature of Jeseníky
Friendly atmosphere for all age groups
Traditional spring running event in Kouty nad Desnou
