name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Mimoň
location: Mimoň, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: rodinný závod 1 km - registrace on-line/na místě od 100 Kč

description: Run for the Nation's Memory in Mimo is a sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place in the park in front of the gymnasium in Mimo and offers a timed 5 km run and an untimed family race of 1 km. The route runs along the river on well-trodden paths and is suitable for all age groups. The entry fee is a donation for a good cause and supports the Nation's Memory.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the parking lot in front of the gymnasium in Mimo
The route runs along the river on well-trodden paths
Timed 5 km run and family race of 1 km
additional: Registration and pickup of race numbers take place from 14:00 to 16:00 on the day of the race. There are changing rooms, a baggage storage, sanitary facilities, and water at the finish line. Students, members of the Memory of the Nation club, and runners over 65 years old receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. The route runs along the river, with start and finish in front of the gymnasium in Mimo. Changing rooms, baggage storage, and sanitary facilities are available. The event supports the Nation's Memory and features an accompanying program for all age groups.

name: Běh na Červenou horu
location: Štěchovice, Praha-východ, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Red Mountain Run is an uphill race covering 3.71 km with an elevation gain of 270 meters, held in Štěchovice in Prague-East. This race is part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and the surrounding area and offers runners a challenging yet attractive route with significant ascent. The race is suitable for mountain running and uphill running enthusiasts who want to test their endurance and strength in a natural environment. Organizers welcome all runners who want to enjoy a sporting challenge in the beautiful landscape of the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: Distance of the route 3.71 km with an elevation gain of 270 m
Challenging uphill run in natural terrain
Part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and surroundings
additional: The race is part of the Hill Runs series, registration and further information will be published on the official website.

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku Jihlava
location: Amfiteátr, Jihlava, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: Night Run for Světluška in Jihlava is a traditional charity run held on May 14, 2026, at the Amphitheatre. Participants can choose between two routes, 3 km and 4.8 km, with the run starting at 9:00 PM. The registration fee is 500 CZK, half of which goes to support the Světluška project, which helps people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program and starter packs with a headlamp or sports headband for those registered in time.
course_highlights: Two routes: 3 km small loop and 4.8 km large loop
Night run starting at 21:00 at the Amphitheatre
Option to choose a starter pack with a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration counters are open from 19:00. An entry ticket with a unique code (printed or on mobile) is required to enter the area. Holders of TP, ZTP, and ZTP/P cards with a companion have free entry but are not entitled to a starter pack, which can be purchased on-site for 250 CZK. The race capacity is limited for safety and participant comfort. The accompanying program includes a concert by Michal Horák from 20:00. Start at 21:00, registration from 19:00, possibility to obtain a donation receipt, free entry for ZTP and ZTP/P cardholders.

name: 3. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park B. Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: The Health Run is a charitable series of seven races held in the beautiful environment of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each race offers a 3 km route that participants can run at their own pace. The proceeds from the entry fees are donated to help those in need, giving the race purpose and added value. Registration begins at 5:00 PM and the start is at 5:45 PM at Lodičky. Everyone is warmly invited to participate and support a good cause.
course_highlights: 3 km route in the beautiful environment of Božena Němcová Park
Surface: cycle path
Charitable run with proceeds supporting those in need
additional: Registration begins at 5:00 PM, with the start at 5:45 PM at Lodičky. A series of seven races in 2026 scheduled from March to September. The proceeds from the entry fees go to help those in need. The race is suitable for the general public and recreational runners, taking place in B. Němcová Park, with an emphasis on charity and health.

name: 3. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Run for Health is a charitable series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run is 3 km long and is intended for everyone who wants to do something for their health and at the same time support those in need, as the proceeds from the entry fee are donated to help those in need. The start is traditionally at Lodičky, registration begins at 17:00, and the race itself starts at 17:45. Everyone is warmly invited to participate and run together with joy.
course_highlights: 3 km route in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná
Terrain along the cycle path
Start at Lodičky
additional: Registration begins at 17:00, the start is at 17:45. The series includes seven runs, with proceeds from the entry fee going to help those in need. The proceeds from the entry fee are donated to help those in need. Registration starts at 17:00, and the race begins at 17:45 at Lodičky. The event is part of a series of seven runs in 2026.

name: KPMG Noc rekordů
location: Praha, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: KPMG Night of Records is a running show held in Prague under the auspices of KPMG partner Eva Bláhová, British Ambassador Matt Field, and Czech 5000-meter record holder Jiří Sýkora. The event offers a unique opportunity to watch top runners in an attractive environment and experience a sports atmosphere full of record-breaking performances. The event is open to the general public and supports the running community in the Czech Republic. Registration and participation are welcome for all who enjoy running and sports competitions.
course_highlights: Running show featuring Czech 5000-meter record holder Jiří Sýkora
Event under the auspices of notable personalities including KPMG partner Eva Bláhová and British Ambassador Matt Field
Attractive sports environment in Prague
additional: The event is associated with registration options, offers prize money and entry fees, and takes place in Prague on May 14, 2026.

name: FyzioRUN
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Charity sports event FYZIORUN invites all runners to a certified 5 km course in the beautiful environment of Prague's Hvězda Park. The event is organized by the Cystic Fibrosis Club and supports patients with this disease. The route is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant experience in the nature of Prague 6. Come to support a good cause and enjoy a sports day in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Beautiful environment of Prague's Hvězda Park
Charity run supporting patients with cystic fibrosis
additional: The event is charitable and organized by the Cystic Fibrosis Club, which provides support to CF patients. Due to health measures, it is necessary to notify the CF Club in advance of your visit. On the website, there is an option to subscribe to the newsletter with news about the Club's events. The event is open to the general public, registration takes place before the race, and the race uses GPS tracking and chip timing.

name: Planderský běh
location: Plandry u Jihlavy, Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kč - muži, junioři, ženy, juniorky přihlášené on-line

description: The Planderský Run is a traditional cross-country race held in the village of Plandry near Jihlava, organized since 1998. The race offers various categories for men, women, juniors, youth, and children with distances ranging from 220 meters to 9 km. The course runs on a 3 km loop that includes forest and field paths with a turnaround at Brandlův Mill, suitable for sports enthusiasts of all ages. After the race, refreshments and prizes are provided for the top competitors in each category. The start is a mass start at 6:00 PM at the municipal office in Plandry.
course_highlights: 3 km loop through forest and field paths with 16% asphalt
Turnaround at Brandlův Mill on Bělokamenský Stream
Various distances for all age groups from 220 m to 9 km
additional: Runners from 3 years old participate. Youth up to 17 years old start for free. After the race, refreshments are available at the local SDH clubhouse, with the option to purchase roasted pig slices. During the race, sports T-shirts of Běžce Vysočiny are sold at a discounted price. A bus connection from Jihlava departs at 4:20 PM, with no return connection. The course is a 3 km loop, starting at 6:00 PM, with categories based on age and gender, and over 100 runners participate in the main 9.4 km race.

name: 250 ČESKÝ RÁJ
location: Turnov, Český ráj, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: 250 Czech Paradise is a unique relay running race in the picturesque environment of Czech Paradise, taking place from May 15 to May 17, 2026. A team of eight members will run a total of 250 kilometers, with each runner completing three segments of approximately 10 kilometers. The route is diverse, including forest and field paths, sometimes roads, and offers a mix of flat and hilly profiles that showcase the beauty of Czech Paradise. The race is known as the most beautiful and is designed for runners who want to experience a team challenge in stunning nature.
course_highlights: Route divided into approximately 10 km segments, each runner runs 3 segments
Combination of forest, field paths, and sometimes roads with flat and hilly profiles
Total length of 250 km for a team of 8 members
additional: TRAILS CUP is a one-time race for three-member teams on the final section of the 250 race, with a length of 13 km and an elevation gain of 356 m. Recommended equipment includes a headlamp and a mobile phone. After the race, there will be an awards ceremony and party at Skalák restaurant in Sedmihorky camp. Participants can enter the camp directly and park at the start. Refreshments are provided. There is an option to order official T-shirts and hoodies by June 13, 2025, on the e-shop. The race includes the possibility to order official merchandise and accompanying trail events.

name: Běh města Nýřany
location: ZŠ Nýřany, Nýřany, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Děti s bydlištěm mimo okolí Nýřan mají start zpoplatněný částkou 30,00 Kč

description: The Nýřany City Run is a traditional sporting event organized by Atletclub Nýřany, z.s. and the Education, Sports, and Culture Committee. The main race over 10 km, including a team run of 2x 5 km, offers an active experience for the general public. There are also supplementary races for children from Nýřany and the surrounding area, which are free or for a symbolic fee. The event takes place at the ZŠ Nýřany athletics stadium and concludes with a disco with free entry.
course_highlights: Main race over 10 km with a team run of 2x 5 km
Supplementary free children's races for local kids
Event concluded with a disco on the asphalt playground
additional: Registration is possible online and on-site with a higher fee. The disco starts at 18:00 with free entry. Starting numbers for children are issued at school facilities or in the white booth next to the gymnasium. The 10 km race, 2x 5 km team runs, children's races, online registration since 2018, results and photos available.

name: Mácháč Run Fest
location: Máchovo jezero, Liberec region, Czech Republic
organizer: Mácháč brothers crew, Jan Venca Francke
description: Mácháč Run Fest is a hilly cross-country race set amidst the beautiful nature of Lake Mácha in the Liberec Region. It offers courses of 160 km, 60 km, 25 km, 10 km, and 5 km, with 90% of the route through terrain. The race is suitable for nature lovers and those seeking a more challenging trail run. Come enjoy running in a picturesque environment with a challenge for every runner.
course_highlights: Hilly cross-country terrain with 90% natural paths
Courses from 5 km to 160 km ultramarathon
Picturesque nature of Lake Mácha in the Liberec Region
additional: Trail race with multiple distances, taking place in May 2026, unsupported race, single loop course.

name: Lesempolem
location: Veselice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Lesempolem is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Veselice in the South Moravian Region. It offers three courses - 14 km, marathon (42 km), and ultramarathon (84 km) - mainly along forest and field paths around the Podvrší lookout tower, which guarantees beautiful views and an experience of running in nature. The race is suitable for all runners from amateurs to experienced athletes, and the marathon is part of the Blansko District Running League. The start and finish are at the sports complex in Veselice, where a rich program, refreshments, and a friendly atmosphere are prepared for competitors and spectators.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs along forest and field paths (90%), only 10% on asphalt
Surroundings of the Podvrší lookout tower with beautiful views
Three courses: 14 km, marathon (42 km), and ultramarathon (84 km)
additional: Start and registration are at the cultural house in Veselice, parking approximately 200 meters from the registration. On site, there is abundant refreshments (water, tea, isotonic drinks, fruit, traditional Loštice spread) and the possibility to store your own refreshments. For spectators, there is a cultural program, a beer tent, and children's runs. Accommodation is available in the cultural house for a symbolic fee in personal sleeping bags. The marathon is part of the Blansko District Running League. The races take place around Veselice, in the Moravian Karst, emphasizing a family atmosphere and social experiences.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Karlovy Vary 2026
location: Karlovy Vary, Karlovy Vary District, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival Karlovy Vary 2026 is a unique race in the heart of the spa town of Karlovy Vary, offering runners the opportunity to experience the joy of running while discovering the city's UNESCO monuments. The course, certified by World Athletics, runs around iconic hotels Thermal and Pupp and through a unique colonnade. This festival is a traditional gathering of runners with a rich atmosphere and beautiful views of world-famous landmarks.
course_highlights: The course runs around the Thermal and Pupp hotels
Passes through the unique colonnade in Karlovy Vary
Surroundings with UNESCO monuments
additional: Registration is only possible using a registration code. The race takes place on May 16, 2026, with the first wave starting at 14:00. The festival includes various running disciplines including a half marathon and relay half marathon. Registration only via registration code; more race categories including 3x5 km and 6.0975 km; races are held in the beautiful environment of UNESCO monuments and hotels.

name: Zručský májový běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: Dětské závody (150 m, 300 m, 600 m, 1100 m)

description: The Zruč May Run is a traditional race held annually in May in the picturesque environment of the castle park and the Sázava River in Zruč nad Sázavou. The race offers courses for all age categories from the youngest children to adults, including the main race of 10 km, which is a fast certified course by ČAS. The event also includes children's races, relays, and a popular 3 km run. The goal of the run is to support the athletic club TJ Jiskra Zruč nad Sázavou and promote sports activities in the region, with the proceeds donated to a good cause in the local area.
course_highlights: The main 10 km race is a fast certified ČAS course running around the castle park and the Sázava River
Four color-coded circuits for children and youth from 150 m to 1100 m in the castle park
The popular 3 km run leads through the castle park, cycle path, and square with the finish at Barončina Stezka
additional: Race numbers can be picked up on Friday from 17:00 for the Friday Popular Run and on Saturday from 8:30 for all categories. On-site registration is only possible on Saturday from 8:30 and closes 30 minutes before each race start. Each registered participant in the main race over 35 years automatically participates in the MČR Masters 2026. The course is marked with colorful wooden directional signs at turns. Results and records of the main race are financially rewarded. The races take place in the castle park and surroundings, with on-site and online registration, various race lengths including children's and relay races, and a certified 10 km course.

name: NN Night Run Brno
location: Hněvkovského sportovně-rekreační areál, Brno, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 km

description: NN Night Run Brno is the largest running event in Brno, held at the Hněvkovského sports and recreation area. Each year, more than 2000 runners of all ages participate, from beginners to experienced competitors. The event offers not only the main 10 km race but also children's races and shorter runs, all in a friendly and lively atmosphere. The program includes accompanying activities, performances, and a rich supporting program for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Sports and recreation area Hněvkovského in Brno
Main race of 10 km with a 90-minute limit
Children's races and runs of 3 km and 5 km with a charitable aspect
additional: The program includes KIDS CUP children's races, FÉNIX RUN 3 km and BELLIS RUN 5 km with a charitable aspect, a 2x5 km relay, accompanying performances and warm-up sessions with Honza Kaňůrek (NUTREND). There is a baggage storage and changing rooms, testing of MIZUNO running shoes, airbrush tattoos, a photo booth, a raffle, and other supporting activities. Registration is available online and on-site. The entry fee can be discounted by 50% for NN clients, and athletes receive a discount on life insurance through the Fit Sport program. The terrain includes an urban park and recreational area; the event features various race categories and supporting activities.

name: Dobřichovický kros půlmaraton a 10 km
location: Nádvoří zámku Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Cross Half Marathon and 10 km is a traditional running race organized by Radost v pohybu in the picturesque courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle. The race offers three variants: a free children's race of 1 km, a 10 km race suitable for beginners and advanced runners with a mostly flat course, and a half marathon for more experienced runners with a challenging second half full of hills. There are refreshment stations along the route, and participants receive a commemorative medal after the race. The atmosphere is friendly and suitable for all age groups.
course_highlights: Half marathon with an initial flat section and a second half full of hills
10 km race mostly flat with one refreshment station
Three refreshment stations on the half marathon (5, 10, and 15 km) with water, isotonic drinks, and fruit
additional: Athletes registered by 1.5.2026 are entitled to a commemorative medal, which is distributed after the results are announced. All participants meet in the courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle. By registering, you confirm participation at your own risk and agree to the use of visual recordings for promotional purposes. The race includes a half marathon and a 10 km race, starting in the courtyard of Dobřichovice Castle, and features a children's race.

name: Rakovnická 100
location: Husovo náměstí, Rakovník, Czech Republic
description: Rakovnická 100 is a traditional ultralong walk and run in the beautiful landscape of Křivoklátsko, offering a challenging but manageable route approximately 107 kilometers long with 2400 meters of elevation gain. The event is known for its excellent organization and pleasant atmosphere, making it ideal for testing physical capabilities. It starts from Husovo Square in Rakovník, and participants can expect a combination of running and walking with various natural obstacles, including fords and wet sections. Rakovnická 100 is suitable for experienced athletes seeking a challenge in a less extreme but still demanding terrain.
course_highlights: Route approximately 107 km long with 2400 m elevation gain
Beautiful nature of Křivoklátsko with rivers, streams, and fords
Well-organized refreshment stations and support along the route
additional: Start at 4 a.m. from Husovo Square in Rakovník. The route is a combination of running and walking, suitable for testing physical condition after the winter season. The event is known for its pleasant atmosphere and quality organization. In the past, the route has been slightly adjusted but still offers a challenge with the possibility of fords and wet sections. The race takes place in May, with the finish at Penzion Šéba, and is part of regional ultramarathons. The route is suitable for experienced runners seeking a challenge in a natural environment.

name: Charitativní Běh Na Špince
location: Tábořiště Špinka, Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Charity Run at Špinka is a sporting event with the motto #KdyžMůžuPomůžu, which combines the joy of movement with helping those in need. The proceeds from the event go to support the NONA 92 Day Care Center in Nové Město nad Metují, which helps people with mental disabilities integrate into society. The race is open to everyone - professional runners, beginners, moms with strollers, and children. The race atmosphere is unique, and 100% of the entry fee goes to charity, with operational costs covered by sponsors.
course_highlights: Routes for all age groups from 100 m for the youngest to 10 km for adults
Children's race starts at 10:00 and 10:15, main routes of 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km start at 10:30 and 11:00
Charity run supporting NONA 92 Day Care Center, which offers meaningful daily activities and preparation for independent living
additional: Registration is possible online via SportChallenge.cz or on-site from 9:00 until 30 minutes before the start. The race is part of the Primátor CUP series. Teams can register (minimum 3 members), with the final time averaged. The program includes children's races, main races of 2, 5, and 10 km, a quiz, and a raffle for a scooter. All entry fees go to charity, with operational costs covered by sponsors. The charity run supports NONA 92 Day Care Center, is open to all age groups, with 100% of the entry fee donated to charity.

name: Májový běh Slapy
location: Sigma Slapy, Slapy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je dobrovolné formou příspěvku v libovolné výši na jednu ze sbírek Blíž domovu

description: The May Run Slapy is a traditional running race organized by the Slapský Cultural Association, held in the picturesque environment of the Slapské forests and hills. The race offers routes for children and adults, emphasizing beautiful nature, forest paths, and interesting elevation changes. The start and facilities are located at the Sigma Slapy area, where participants can change clothes and store belongings. The race is suitable for all age groups and offers a friendly atmosphere with awards for the best and all children.
course_highlights: Forest paths and terrain with minimal elevation change for children
Manageable but hilly profile with an elevation of 225 m for adults
Beautiful view of the dam lake from the middle of the adult race
additional: Children start independently at 9:30, adults start at 10:00 after children finish. Registration is from 9:00 to 9:20 for children and until 9:45 for adults. There is an option to change clothes and store belongings without valuables at the start area. The route is well marked with white arrows on the ground. Children can be accompanied by parents. Children up to 9 years run 1.4 km, older children 2.8 km, adults 7.5 km. Children up to 18 years can run the adult route with parental consent. Start times: children at 9:30, adults at 10:00; race distances: 1.4 km for children up to 9 years, 2.8 km for children 10-18 years, 7.5 km for adults; the race takes place on forest trails with elevation changes.

name: Městecká desítka
location: Náměstí Republiky, Městec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Městec Králové Ten is a traditional running race in Městec Králové, offering courses of 10 km, 5 km, and a children's race of 1 km, including a run for the youngest. The course mainly runs on asphalt roads with slight elevation changes, and the start and finish are at Náměstí Republiky. The race is known for its records and great atmosphere, with participants able to use refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. After the race, runners receive an SMS with their finishing time, and winners receive trophies and material prizes. Organizers emphasize fair play and the safety of all participants.
course_highlights: Course without significant elevation
Surface: 80% asphalt, 20% paving and paths
Start and finish at Náměstí Republiky, Městec Králové
additional: Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. SMS with the finishing time after the race. On-site registration will not be available. Functional T-shirt NO.6 available for purchase at 490 CZK. The children's run is not timed and is free; registration takes place on race day from 8:30 to 9:20. Children can run with an escort; the use of tricycles and scooters is prohibited. The race includes refreshments on the course and at the finish. Registration is only possible online, and results are available via SMS and online. The course runs over asphalt, paving, and sandy areas; start and finish are at Náměstí Republiky.

name: 7 pohoří Orlické hory
location: Deštné v Orlických horách, Orlické hory, Czech Republic
description: The 7 Mountains of the Orlické Hory are part of the largest trail running series in the Czech Republic, which takes you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The race in the Orlické Hory offers technical trails with epic views and an atmosphere you won't experience anywhere else. The route passes through viewpoints, Šerlich, the border with Poland, and the highest peak of the Orlické Hory, Velká Deštná. Prepare for a challenge with an elevation gain of 920 meters and a length of 24 km, which will test your strength and determination.
course_highlights: The route passes through viewpoints and Šerlich
Across the border with Poland to Masarykova Chata
Climb to the highest peak of the Orlické Hory, Velká Deštná (1,115 m)

name: LHUT – Lysohorský Skyrace a Ultratrail, MČR Skyrace a Ultra Sky 2026
location: SKI Malenovice, Lysá hora, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Lysohorský Ultra Trail is a mountain running race in the Lysá hora massif, offering three race routes: Ultra Trail (67 km, +4100 m), Skyrace (31 km, +2100 m), and Supersky (16 km, +875 m). The routes run along marked hiking trails with stunning views of Lysá hora from all sides. The race is organized with the support of Lysá hora hunters, LČR, and CHKO, emphasizing the athlete's ethical code and nature protection. The start and finish are at the KAM hotel complex in Malenovice, where refreshments, recovery zones, and other services for competitors are provided. After the race, there is a ceremonial announcement and afterparty.
course_highlights: Routes run along marked hiking trails in the Lysá hora massif
Challenging elevation gain up to 4100 m on the Ultra Trail route
Refreshment stations at the top of Lysá hora and at the start/finish area
additional: Registration for competitors will take place on Friday, May 15, 2026, from 16:00 to 20:00 at the KAM hotel complex in Malenovice. It offers several routes of varying lengths and difficulty in the beautiful surroundings of Tisá and its vicinity. The races are mainly run off asphalt roads, on forest and field paths and trails, with clear signage. The race facilities are well equipped, with showers, changing rooms, refreshments, and the option to stay overnight in your own tent or car. Organizers emphasize safety and ecology, for example by limiting plastic cups at refreshment stations.
course_highlights: Routes are mainly off asphalt roads, on forest and field paths and trails
Refreshment stations are located every 15 - 20 km with a diverse selection of food and drinks
Race facilities include changing rooms, showers, toilets, and the possibility to stay overnight in your own tent or car
additional: Start and finish are behind the football field in Tisá. Facilities include changing rooms, toilets, showers, seating, and refreshments in a covered tent. Possibility to stay overnight in your own tent or car. Parking is available in the Burg area. Mandatory equipment for the 100 km race includes a start chip and a charged mobile phone. At refreshment stations, water, cola, isotonic drinks, fruit, bread, cheese, cookies, muesli bars, and salt are available. At the finish, there is soup and a main meal; it is recommended to bring your own dishes and cutlery. The 10 km race starts at 12:00, the 100 km race at 5:00. Registration and drop bag handover are the day before the race. Course options range from 25 km to 100 km, with children's races, facilities at the football field and in the Libouchecká hall, the possibility of a tent city, ceramic medals, and T-shirts for participants.

name: Běhej lesy Brdy
location: Obecnice, CHKO Brdy, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

description: Běhej lesy Brdy is a trail run held in the Brdy Protected Landscape Area, near Prague and Příbram. The race offers various routes including a short and a long one, which are part of the international UTMB Index Races. Runners can enjoy beautiful nature, technical sections, and competitions for valuable prizes. The finish line is extended to 500 meters, providing an interesting challenge for all participants. The Běhej lesy series is known for its community atmosphere and respect for nature.
course_highlights: UTMB Index Races with international scoring
Conti Speed Section - a 150-meter speed segment with Continental flags
Generali Investments Finish - extended 500m finish line with a measured section
additional: In Brdy, competitions are held on the Nova 12 km and ČSOB 22 km routes. The winner of the Conti Speed Section receives a voucher for tires and a running jersey. The fastest man and woman across all routes will receive a functional Craft running jersey as the GENERALI INVESTMENTS FINISHER #1 title. The race includes various distances from 4 to 22 km, children's races, accompanying program, and the opportunity for family participation. The event takes place in the natural environment of CHKO Brdy with an emphasis on ecology and community atmosphere.

name: Běh pro hospic Litoměřice
location: Litoměřice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné je darem na podporu hospice
description: Run for the Litoměřice Hospice is a charity sporting event organized to support the St. Stephen Hospice in Litoměřice. Participants run to help those whose life journey is coming to an end, thereby contributing to the funding and support of hospice care. The event takes place in a beautiful setting and is complemented by professional timing. The motto of the race is 'Who runs, helps'.
course_highlights: Charity sporting event supporting the hospice
Beautiful environment of Litoměřice
Professional timing
additional: The event is a charity initiative supporting hospice care. The website mentions volunteers and other beneficent activities, but no specific details are provided about start times, waves, capacities, or runner equipment. The event includes various race distances (0.5 km, 1 km, 3 km, 6 km, 11 km), offers a virtual run option, and promotes care for the sick.

name: Milada Run
location: Hlavní pláž jezera Milada, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Milada Run is part of the popular sports series Milada Tour, which takes place in the unique landscape of the former brown coal mine transformed into the natural Milada Lake. The jubilee 10th edition offers a family-friendly and friendly atmosphere with routes for children and adults. The races run along hilly and flat paths with beautiful views of the lake and surrounding nature. The high level and popularity of the race are confirmed by the participants themselves.
course_highlights: Half marathon route with two loops, including a hilly path by the water and views over the lake
10 km route on paved, flat paths suitable for all runners
Children's races 500 m and 1 km near the main beach with parental supervision
additional: The race capacity is limited to 500 participants. All runners will receive a medal, and a start number with their name upon payment by May 16, 2026. An official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt is available for order during registration, and a free children's T-shirt for the first 100 registered children. The accompanying program includes the Olympia children's corner and childcare. The race includes routes around Lake Milada, children's races, medals for all participants, and an accompanying program.

name: Brdské rokle
location: Lesní divadlo, Řevnice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Brdské rokle is a trail race held in the picturesque environment of the Forest Theatre in Řevnice, offering three routes of varying lengths and difficulty. All routes lead through the forest with diverse terrain, including ascents, descents, and beautiful views of spring nature. The race is known for its technical sections and variable profile, which will test runners and experienced trail enthusiasts alike. Starting numbers can be personalized with a name, and participants can use facilities with refreshments and a children's corner for families with children.
course_highlights: Forest routes with elevation gain of 200 - 360 m depending on the distance
Technical sections with rocky and soft forest paths
Beautiful views and spring nature in full bloom
additional: Starting number with a personal name can be ordered by May 17, 2026. The facilities at the Forest Theatre include toilets, baggage storage, and refreshments at the finish line (Corny bars, bananas, water, Ionilyte sports drink). A children's corner with art activities and supervision by an experienced teacher is available for kids. It is recommended to travel by train due to limited parking in Řevnice. Trail races in nature, technical sections, refreshment stations, routes of 10 km and 15 km, start from the Forest Theatre in Řevnice.

description: NN NIGHT RUN Liberec is the largest running event in Liberec, held in the Vesec area. Every year, more than 2000 runners of all ages, from beginners to experienced competitors, take part in the start. The event offers an unforgettable experience with a rich accompanying program, including races of various lengths and a charity run against breast cancer. The atmosphere is full of energy, music, and fun, making this race a popular sporting event for the general public.
course_highlights: Night run in Vesec area with atmosphere and musical accompaniment
Races for all age groups including children's and relay runs
Charity run BELLIS RUN against breast cancer on 5 km
additional: Limit of 90 minutes for the main race NN Night Run 10 km. Limit of 75 minutes for BELLIS RUN against breast cancer 5 km (manageable by brisk walking). Discounts for students with ISIC cards and clients of NN Životní pojišťovna. Option to purchase a functional MIZUNO T-shirt for an additional fee. The event includes various routes, online or on-site registration, accompanying activities, and races focused on families and health.

name: Salomon Valašský Hrb
location: Horský hotel Čarták, Hutisko-Solanec, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Salomon Valašský Hrb is a mountain run suitable for beginners and endurance runners, taking place in the picturesque environment of the Mountain Hotel Čarták in Hutisko-Soláň. The race offers courses of 50 km, 30 km, 20 km, and 10 km, run along paved ridge paths with stunning views. This race is ideal for mountain running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of nature and enjoy a sporting challenge. Come and enjoy the atmosphere and challenge of mountain terrain in the heart of the Zlín Region.

Beautiful views during the course
Various distances from 10 km to 50 km
additional: race distances, mountain terrain, registration details not specified

description: VolšoHEC RUN is a traditional charity relay race held in the beautiful surroundings by the Olšovec pond in the South Moravian Region. The race is run in two relay variants: 4×5.5 km and 2×11 km, with a total distance of a half marathon 21.1 km. The event supports children in need, with all entry fees and voluntary contributions for original running jerseys going directly to the o.p.s. Život dětem. In addition to the main race, there are free children's runs and a non-competitive ride on kick scooters. The race is suitable for teams who want to combine athletic performance with supporting a good cause.

Four laps of 5.5 km or two laps of 11 km
Ability to monitor the current race status on a large screen

Children's runs are free and take place from 13:30 to 14:45 with results announced afterward. The main race starts at 15:00, covering four laps with a 3-hour time limit. Registration is possible via an online form. The event also includes children's races and a ceremonial award ceremony.

The event offers running races and fun sports activities for all age groups, including a family run and a team relay. The program features accompanying activities such as face painting, a bouncy castle, a magic show, and musical performances. In 2026, the event will take place on May 23rd in Na Pankráci Park in Prague 4 and is organized under the auspices of the mayor of Prague 4. Everyone who helps is a winner, and every participant is entered into a raffle for prizes.
course_highlights: Mayor of Prague 4 Cup 5 km run in Na Pankráci Park
Family run of 1 km for 2 to 5 members, all start and finish together
4 x 1 km team relay with at least one adult in the team
additional: Registration is possible online until May 20, 2026, at a reduced price, later on-site at a higher price up to 30 minutes before the start. Each registered participant is entered into a prize draw and receives an electronic certificate. Daily steps are now counted, not only targeted activity. The event features a rich accompanying program including musical performances and fun activities for children. The event is held under the auspices of the mayor of Prague 4. Registration is possible online, supporting children from children's homes, sponsorship opportunities, and community sports support.

name: SeziRun
location: Sezimovo Ústí, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč pro hlavní závody, 100 Kč za 4 km s kočárkem, 50 Kč pro děti do 16 let, dobrovolný příspěvek pro děti do 12 let
description: SeziRun is a traditional running race held in Sezimovo Ústí, taking place on May 23, 2026. The 10th anniversary offers a wide range of races for children and adults, including a half marathon, 12 km, 6 km, and 4 km courses. The race is suitable for all age groups and running levels, with winners announced in individual categories. Parking is available near the start and finish lines, making it easy for participants to arrive. The race atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with opportunities to share photos and a limited edition headband for participants.
course_highlights: Various courses for adults and children from 200 m to a half marathon
Start and finish in Sezimovo Ústí with accessible parking about 300 meters from the start
Announcement of the top three in all categories except the walking category
additional: Parking is available at designated parking lots in Sezimovo Ústí, ideally as close as possible or directly on K Hájence street, approximately 300 meters from the start. Vehicle entry directly to the forest hut is prohibited. A limited edition headband is being prepared for the 2026 anniversary. A photo gallery is shared for all participants and fans of SeziRun. The race takes place in a natural environment with online registration, refreshments, chip timing, and a raffle with prizes. Temporary changing rooms are available at the haystack, without showers or storage facilities.

name: Zaječický bůr
location: Zaječice u Pyšel, Zaječice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Zaječický běh je tradiční cross-country race with a family atmosphere, offering courses for all age groups from children to adults. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Zaječice near Pyšely and is part of the Ladov Region Cup. It offers material prizes for the top three in each category and prize money for the course record on the longest track. The race is popular for its friendly atmosphere and quality organization, attracting runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Five courses from 55 m to 10,555 m for different age categories
Main prize for the overall winner of the MAXI rabbit category on 5555 m
Part of the Ladov Region Cup with prize money for the course record on 10,555 m
additional: Registration is possible online until May 22nd or on-site on the race day. Starts are divided by categories from 9:00 to 12:50. Parking is available near the start and marked from the entrance to Zaječice. The race is scored for the Ladov Region Cup and the Regional Skiing Association of the Central Bohemian Region. The HOLE category is Nordic walking with style control. The race offers medals, material prizes, diplomas, start packages, refreshments for all participants (cookie, juice or tea, soup), and online registration options. The event is suitable for the whole family and includes a children's program.

name: Krok za Šimonka
location: Skalka, Nový Jičín, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Krok za Šimonka is a sporting event organized to support a collection for Šimonka, a boy suffering from the rare metabolic disease Lesch Nyhan syndrome. The event offers a fun sports day for the whole family in the Skalka area near Nový Jičín. The goal is not only to support treatment and rehabilitation but also to raise awareness about this disease and the strength of the community. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to help a good cause.
course_highlights: Run of 13 km combining asphalt and trail routes
Support for children with serious illnesses, especially Šimonka with Lesch-Nyhan syndrome
Supporting program, raffle, and collection to support healthcare
additional: The event is a fun sports day for the whole family with refreshments. Part of the support includes the sale of T-shirts, with a portion of the proceeds going towards Šimonka's treatment. The event takes place at the Skalka amphitheater, registration is possible online, and the proceeds are allocated to rehabilitation, aids, and medical examinations. There are races for children and adults, a program, and a collection.

location: Pelhřimov náměstí, Pelhřimov, Vysočina, Czech Republic

description: Run for a Smile is a sporting event for the whole family held at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov. This Pelhřimov half marathon is suitable for active and non-active families, seniors, and children from 1 year old, and you do not have to run the race, walking is also fine. Half of the entry fee goes to the Julinka Foundation, which fights against childhood obesity. Races for children and parents are scheduled back-to-back, and while waiting for parents, children can enjoy activities such as face painting, a bouncy castle, riding scooters, or learning first aid.
course_highlights: Routes of 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon are certified
Children's routes without placement evaluation, run for joy and a smile
Start and finish at Masaryk Square in Pelhřimov
additional: Distribution of race bibs and athlete registration on race day from 8:30 AM, bibs must be collected at least 20 minutes before the start. Runners in the 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon are chip-timed with single-use chips attached to their bibs. The registration fee until April 30, 2026, includes a medal, a name-tagged bib, and Rajec water. Parents accompanying children run for free. A baggage storage service is available for runners. The event hosts are Ondřej Havlík (En.dru) and Petr Cerha (Nasty). The races are suitable for all age groups, including children and seniors, with accompanying activities for children and a charitable aspect.

name: Memoriál Ivana Belobrada

The race offers courses up to 9 km, run on village asphalt roads, forest and field paths with varied surfaces. The event is suitable for the general public, including youth and children, with the possibility of individual starts for the youngest. The race takes place in a pleasant sports area and is known for its friendly atmosphere and quality organization.

Varied surface: asphalt, paved, and unpaved terrain
Sports area Dlouhoňovice as start and finish

The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026 series, includes various categories, exact courses are not specified.

The race offers two courses of 8 km and 4 km, which run through nature and forest paths. The main category starts at 11:00, allowing comfortable participation for the general public and competitive runners. The event is organized by the Town of Přibyslav in cooperation with ACO Industries k.s. and David Myslivec, who ensure high-quality organization of the event.

Course lengths of 8 km and 4 km in a natural environment
Forest paths and natural terrain

name: Běh do vrchu Poniklá – Rezek
location: Tuláčkova Návsi, Poniklá, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Poniklá Rezek uphill run is a traditional sporting event held in the village of Poniklá. The race starts at Tuláčková Square and leads uphill to Rezek. The event is suitable for runners who enjoy challenges in natural terrain and want to experience an active sports day in a beautiful environment. The organizer is Petr Holec, who ensures the smooth running of the race.
course_highlights: Start at Tuláčková Square in Poniklá
Uphill run with the finish at Rezek
Natural terrain and scenic views
additional: The race starts at Tuláčková Square, with various distances including 2 km and 9.2 km, and features challenging ascents and a final climb to Rezek. The event is supported by the local community and also offers an evening program.

name: Gočárův běh
location: Hradec Králové and Pardubice, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: The Gočár Run is a unique race connecting two regional cities, Hradec Králové and Pardubice, following in the footsteps of architect Josef Gočár. Runners will face a 33-kilometer route combining road and natural sections with the backdrop of Gočár's buildings, from schools in Hradec to the iconic Automatic Mills in Pardubice. The race is open to individuals, pairs, four-member relay teams, and children, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a cultural and social experience with an accompanying program and musical performances. The Gočár Run is quickly becoming a tradition in the East Bohemia region and attracts hundreds of runners and thousands of fans each year.
course_highlights: 33 km route from Hradec Králové to Pardubice
Combination of road and natural sections
Backdrops of Gočár's buildings including Automatic Mills
additional: The start package includes original Eleven socks, a medal, a Hradecký Klenot beer pack, a race number with logo, an electronic timing chip, refreshments on the course and at the finish line, an electronic diploma, and an accompanying program. There are changing rooms, baggage storage with transfer to the finish, medical services, catering, race photos and videos, testing of Craft footwear, and taping at a discounted price. The VIP experience includes a personalized T-shirt, diploma, and a rooftop experience at the Automatic Mills. The accompanying program features musical performances, children's activities, various race categories, and the opportunity to share the experience with friends.

The route runs along the Svratka River with a surface of paved paths and asphalt. Participants contribute through their entry fee to the filming and preservation of witnesses' stories and educational programs.

name: Jistebnický vodohospodářský půlmaraton
location: Sportovní areál TJ Jistebník, Jistebník, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč (pro mladistvé do 19 let registrované do 17.5.2024), 200 Kč na místě
description: Jistebník Water Management Half Marathon is a traditional running race held for the sixteenth time in the picturesque landscape on the border of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area. The races offer routes from 3.6 km up to a marathon, including relay races and a children's olympiad, starting and ending at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. The running courses lead through nature with beautiful views of the Beskydy Mountains and between the villages of Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou, and Klimkovice. The event is complemented by a rich accompanying program and is suitable for a wide range of runners and families with children.
course_highlights: Routes lead through nature on the edge of the Poodří Protected Landscape Area
Landscape between Jistebník, Polanka nad Odrou, and Klimkovice
Views of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: Start and finish of all runs are at the TJ Jistebník sports complex. Registration begins at 7:00 AM and ends 20 minutes before the start of the respective race. There is refreshment on the course, and at the finish line, one refreshment is available included in the entry fee. It is recommended to try the Marathon Soup at the local pub. Parking is available near the complex and on the main road, with ideal options being train and bus connections. The event also includes a children's olympiad and an accompanying program from 10:00 to 15:00. Blood and plasma donors receive a 50% discount on the entry fee upon presenting proof of their last donation. The course passes through natural areas, the event includes multiple race categories and children's activities, and it takes place in May 2026.

name: Krušnej seběh
location: Nové Hamry, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Krušnej downhill is a traditional running race organized by Bike Team Nejdek, held in the picturesque environment of Nové Hamry in the Karlovy Vary Region. The race offers two courses - the longer FullHD approximately 14 km long and the shorter HD 7 km, which mainly run through forest paths and paved roads with hilly terrain and technical sections. The start and finish are in Nové Hamry, with the start moved to an earlier hour to ensure the race takes only part of the morning. The race is suitable for all runners who want to experience a challenging yet attractive cross-country run in the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Circuit course with a length of 14 km (FullHD) and 7 km (HD)
Forest paths, paved forest roads, and asphalt crossings
Hilly terrain with demanding climbs and technical descents
additional: The race starts in Nové Hamry at the Velká sjezdovka, with a circuit course featuring water stations on the track (for FullHD) and at the finish. Transportation to the start is provided without the need for train transfer. Results are announced before noon, so the race takes only the morning part of the day. Course variants: FullHD (18.9 km) and HD (11 km), hilly profile, bus departure from the registration site, on-site and online registration, changes in the route and schedule compared to previous years.

name: Běšinský běh
location: Běšiny u Klatov, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Běšinský Run is a traditional running race held in Běšiny near Klatovy, offering a course length of 4.8 km. The race is of a mixed type and includes a hill climb prize, adding to its attractiveness and challenge for runners. The start is at a football field, and the race takes place in all weather conditions. The organizer is Sokol Běšiny, ensuring a friendly atmosphere and a safe event.
course_highlights: Course length of 4.8 km in Běšiny near Klatovy
Mixed type race with a hill climb prize
Start at a football field
additional: The race takes place in all weather conditions. Each participant runs at their own risk and is responsible for their health. Children start for free. The course passes through a football field, registration is at your own risk, the race is held in all weather conditions, and there is a hill climb prize.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Olomouc

description: The Run for the Nation's Memory in Olomouc is a sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses. The race takes place on May 23, 2026, in Smetanovy and Čechovy Parks and offers timed runs of 5 km, 10 km, and a 4x2.5 km relay, as well as untimed children's and family runs. The start and finish are near the collection greenhouses in Smetanovy Park. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes remembrance of heroism and freedom.
course_highlights: The route runs through Smetanovy and Čechovy Parks on marked circuits
The 5 km race consists of 2 laps, the 10 km race of 4 laps
The relay is composed of 4 segments of 2.5 km each
additional: Students, minors under 18, members of the Post Bellum Friends Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the registration fee. Changing rooms, a storage area, sanitary facilities, and water at the finish are available. The accompanying program includes stalls with games for children, a relaxation and science zone by Palacký University, workshops, and prize competitions. Race numbers are issued during check-in on the race day. The event includes refreshments, water, a family and children’s program, and promotes memories of the past and the fight for freedom.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Kladno
location: Libčice nad Vltavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Run for the Nation's Memory in Libčice nad Vltavou is a sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race offers timed runs of 5 km and 10 km with mass start, which lead along paved paths and asphalt in the forest park and along the cycle path. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes remembrance of history and the courage of fighters for freedom. Start numbers are issued on the day of the race at the registration site. The event also includes a children's run and the possibility of a symbolic run "Anywhere!" outside the official routes.
course_highlights: Start at the entrance near Sletiště
The route runs through the forest park along the cycle path
Surface of paved paths and asphalt
additional: Students, pupils under 18, members of the Friends of the Nation's Memory Club, and runners over 65 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Registration and pick-up of start numbers take place from 9:00 to 9:30 on the race day. It is recommended to write medications, allergies, and a contact person on the back of the start number for medical emergencies. The terrain includes paved and asphalt paths; registration is available online and on-site; the event is part of a series of runs supporting national memory.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Jihlava
location: Český mlýn, Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic
organizer: Post Bellum, z. ú. a Parlament Gymnázia Jihlava
price_range: on-line registrace od 200 Kč, na místě od 300 Kč
description: Run for the Nation's Memory in Jihlava is a sports and social event organized to support the non-profit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place at the Český mlýn area with start and finish behind the skatepark. Runners can choose from timed runs of 4 km and 10 km, or untimed children's and family races. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant environment on paved cycle paths. The entry fee is a donation for a good cause and supports the Memory of the Nation.
course_highlights: The route runs along paved cycle paths in the Český mlýn area
Start and finish are located behind the skatepark in the area
Offers timed runs of 4 km and 10 km, as well as untimed children's and family races
additional: Students, members of the Memory of the Nation club, and runners over 65 years old receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Hygienic facilities, water at the finish, and refreshments are available. Registration and bib pickup take place on the race day at specified times. Results are announced after the runners finish. Paved paths, registration details, support for various race categories.

description: The Moravská Sázava Valley Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Zábřeh na Moravě. The 21.0975 km course is certified according to IAAF rules and mainly runs on flat terrain with slight inclines between Nemilí and Hněvkov. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Endurance Cup and offers quality facilities including refreshment stations and a children's race. The start and finish are at the Swimming Complex in Zábřeh, where participants receive a symbolic medal and refreshments at the finish line.
course_highlights: Certified 21.0975 km course with predominantly flat profile
Surface: asphalt, with sections of chipseal, cobblestones, and concrete
Four refreshment stations with isotonic drinks, water, and fruit
additional: Participants with an estimated finish time of 2:30 - 3:00 hours can start as early as 9:30 AM. The race has a time limit of 3 hours. After the race, a buffet with drinks (Welzl beer, draft lemonade) and pasta salad is available for participants. A children's race is organized after the start of the adult race. Lockers are available for 10 CZK. Parking is possible at the swimming pool and nearby, following the instructions of marshals. The course is free of restrictions and construction works. The race will take place on May 24, 2026, registration is open, suitable for recreational and competitive runners, with various categories and team competitions.

name: Lesní půlmaraton Říčany

description: The Forest Half Marathon Říčany is a running race held exclusively on beautiful forest roads and trails without asphalt. The surrounding nature in the Říčany area is very picturesque at the end of May, contributing to a pleasant running experience. The race is suitable for lovers of natural terrain and cross-country running who want to experience the forest atmosphere and the challenge of a half marathon distance. Organizers welcome runners of all levels and encourage sharing race experiences.
course_highlights: The course runs exclusively on forest roads and trails
Zero asphalt content on the course
Beautiful surroundings with tall old beech trees
additional: Course distances: 5 km, 10.5 km, and 14.5 km; elevation gain approx. 120-350 m; routes run exclusively on forest roads and trails.

The race is known for its new route and magical atmosphere, especially during the descent to the square. It attracts a wide running community each year and provides quality facilities including refreshments and parking.
course_highlights: New half marathon route
Descent to the square with a magical atmosphere
Relay race with team spirit
additional: The race offers multiple categories: individual half marathon, relay half marathon, fitness run, and children's races. Online registration in advance is recommended. After the race, results are announced and refreshments are provided for participants.

description: Run the Unconventional Path is a running race held in Prague 13, offering courses of 13 km and 5 km. Runners can enjoy refreshments on the course and at the finish line. The event is open to everyone and is conducted in the spirit of fair play, emphasizing adherence to the marked route.

Refreshments at 8 km and at the finish for the 13 km course, refreshments at the finish for the 5 km course
Start and finish near the refreshment area Kuželkárna

The event also includes training runs and safety regulations.

name: Teplýšovický běh
location: Teplýšovice, Benešov, Czech Republic
description: The Teplýšovice Run is a charity race held in the picturesque village of Teplýšovice near Benešov. In 2026, the 6th edition will take place with courses of 5 km, 10 km, 15 km trail, 11 km Nordic Walking, and children's races. The main course passes through the Špulka lookout tower and offers beautiful nature and a challenging route. All courses are measured with chip timing, and each participant will receive a medal. The registration fee partly contributes to the restoration of fruit alleys in the area.
course_highlights: Main trail of 15 km passes through the Špulka lookout tower
Sprint 5 km course across the local pasture with the possibility of meeting cows
Nordic Walking 11 km follows the main trail
additional: Registration is also possible on the day of the race with the risk that medals may not be available for participants. Most routes are measured with IRONTIME chip timing. Children's races are divided into age categories and include a 650 m obstacle race for children. The registration fee contributes to the purchase of mature fruit trees for the restoration of alleys in the area. Course options: 15 km trail, 5 km run, 1300 m children's course, 10 km Nordic Walking, 650 m children's obstacle run; online registration until May 25, 2023, or May 22, 2025; proceeds go to tree planting and landscape restoration.

Race along the cycle path

The course runs along paved field and forest paths with an elevation gain of 96 meters, offering runners a pleasant run on flat terrain and a downhill into the valley, with return via forest paths. The 21.0975 km course is certified according to IAAF rules and mainly runs on flat terrain with slight inclines between Nemilí and Hněvkov. The race is part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region and offers quality facilities including refreshment stations and timing with chip technology. The start is at 10:00 AM from the Swimming Complex in Zábřeh, with runners expected to finish in under 2:30 hours able to start at 9:30 AM. description: Kunětická devítka is a traditional Wednesday cross-country running race around Kunětická Mountain, offering two routes - a short loop of 4.5 km suitable for everyone and a long loop of 9 km for more experienced runners. The race is known for its relaxed atmosphere, where runners with various ambitions meet, and emphasizes the joy of racing and good spirits after finishing. The event takes place at the parking lot near Staročeská hospoda and is the largest sporting running event on a weekday in the Pardubice Region. The organizer invites all runners to enjoy the race and the beautiful surroundings of Kunětická Mountain.

The measurement limit for judges is 35 minutes, after which the runner's time is recorded as 35+. A separate series for young runners, Young BĚKODO, is prepared for younger participants. The race features a multi-phase format with the possibility to track the top 10 performances. Registration is open for runners from 15 years old. The race takes place in a natural environment under Teplická Doubravka.

description: Come run on a pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník, where personal records are often broken! description: Valašské Kilo is a challenging 100 km ultramarathon run through the beautiful and hilly landscape of Wallachia with at least 3,500 meters of elevation gain. The race is a challenge not only for experienced athletes but also for those who want to push their limits and experience an adventure in the terrain. After a mass start at 22:00, participants plan their own route between control points within a 30-hour time limit. The race headquarters is at ZŠ Žerotínova in Valašské Meziříčí, where a gymnasium, showers, and a dining hall are available. Valašské Kilo offers freedom and space for navigation in the terrain and is one of the best ultramarathons in the Czech Republic.

The race facilities are open from approximately 16:00 on Friday to 12:00 on Sunday and include a gymnasium, showers, dining hall, drinking water, and a luggage storage. Each participant must provide their own route map. The race focuses on endurance walking and running, emphasizing resilience and the ability to handle the demanding terrain in the Wallachia region.

description: Dopesace Backyard Ultra is an endurance race held in the Aš Forests, where a loop of nearly 7 kilometers is run every hour. The race continues as long as there is only one runner who can complete more laps than the others. This unique format emphasizes not only speed but primarily endurance and determination. The winner receives a silver coin and the opportunity to represent the Czech Republic at the team world championship in October 2026. The race atmosphere is unforgettable and the event is also connected with a charitable project.
course_highlights: Loop length of 6.71 km with an elevation gain of approximately 80 m

Each lap begins exactly one hour after the previous one, with strict time discipline
additional: Pre-race presentation is possible on the evening before the race between 5 PM and 7 PM or in the morning on the race day from 8 AM to 9:15 AM. Participants must be over 18 years old. Each lap must be completed within 60 minutes, otherwise disqualification follows. No assistance or aids, including trekking poles, are allowed on the route. The race is connected with charity, where runners contribute 1-10 CZK for each completed kilometer to a selected project. The race takes place in the Aš Forests, with a requirement to use a headlamp during night sections. Registration is mandatory. The event has a charitable dimension and emphasizes community atmosphere and endurance.

Registration includes a race bib, diploma, prizes, refreshments, and a children's corner; virtual run option.

name: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
location: Dívčí Hradec, Praha, Czech Republic

Participants can look forward to a friendly environment and the opportunity to compete with runners of all ages. The races are regularly announced and decorated with medals for the best in categories up to 40 years and 40+.

Running in the environment of Modřanských roklí and Zbraslavská pila
Races with the atmosphere of an amateur league and community running

The race is focused on trail runners seeking a challenge in a natural environment and wanting to enjoy beautiful views and technical sections on the course.

Participants will enjoy beautiful panoramic views of Prague and a friendly race atmosphere. The start is easily accessible by metro at Radlická station, and the registration fee includes refreshments, a medal, and results service.

Panoramic views of Prague

Trail race in Prague-Zlíchov, part of a series of running events with various distances.

The race offers the opportunity to experience the picturesque Haná landscape and join a community of sports enthusiasts. The race takes place on June 11, 2026, with on-site registration available, and results are published online.

name: Yellow Ribbon Run
location: Obora Hvězda, Praha 6, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
organizer: Czechia Yellow Ribbon Run (Gabriela Slováková a podporující organizace)
description: Yellow Ribbon Run is a running event held on June 11, 2026, at the Star Park in Prague 6, symbolizing a second chance and supporting the integration of people with a criminal past. The run combines sport, solidarity, and the courage to help those who want to start a new life and become valuable members of society. The event offers various race categories including the main relay, easy relay, and children's run, and also contributes to awareness and reducing recidivism. Join the largest community in the Czech Republic that breaks stereotypes and supports second chances.
course_highlights: Run in the beautiful environment of Star Park in Prague 6
Various race categories: main relay 5 km, easy relay 2.5 km, children's run
Symbolism of a second chance and support for the reintegration of people with a criminal past
additional: The event includes the main relay 5 km, easy relay 2.5 km, Connecting Hearts Race for Children, and VOL FANWALK. The project promotes awareness about people with a criminal past and offers institutions and companies the opportunity to participate in the run as a CSR project. Organizers welcome volunteers to assist with the preparation and execution of the event. The event aims to increase awareness of the issues related to the reintegration of ex-offenders and support their social inclusion. Registration is available through Stopnito.cz.

The event is open to a wide age range and emphasizes sporting experiences and support for the running community in the region.

Various distances from 210 m to 8.8 km for different age categories
Part of the Vysočina Runner Cup series

City atmosphere and rich history during the race

Natural environment around Postřekov in Chospíl

Colorful zones shower runners with colors from head to toe

name: JEŠTĚD SUMMER RUNNING WEEKEND

The routes lead through picturesque mountain terrain with significant elevation changes and stunning views of the Ještěd Ridge. The event is part of the prestigious Ještěd Skyrace series and provides quality facilities and atmosphere for all participants.

The registration fee includes a public transport ticket, supports local charity, and promotes historical awareness.

name: Hradecký koloběh

Surface of the course combines asphalt, forest paths, and meadows

name: Barvám Neutečeš Praha
location: Park u Čeňku, Sokolský ostrov, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Color Run Neutečeš is a colorful run and all-day entertainment for all age groups, families, and friends. There are two routes to choose from: 5 km with five color zones and 1.5 km with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. The event is not about speed but about joy, friendship, and unforgettable experiences filled with music, laughter, and colorful explosions. The run takes place in Prague in the Park u Čeňku and on Sokolský Island and is part of a year-round colorful tour across several cities.

1.5 km route with 3 color zones and Urban Challenge zone
Color zones shower runners with colors from head to toe

The festival features various color zones, music, activities, and is suitable for all age groups. The event takes place in Park u Čeňku and on Sokolský Island, emphasizing fun and community experiences.

Natural scenery and diverse terrain around Karvinská Lake

name: Běh okolo Vraní skály
location: Černín u Zdic, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Vraní Skála Run is a traditional running race held in Černín u Zdic, offering a challenging course approximately 9 km long. The race combines steep road ascents, forest paths, and narrow trails leading to the summit around Vraní Skála, followed by a rolling and mostly descending section with a steep downhill to the finish. The start is at the square in Černín u Zdic, and the main race begins at 10:30 AM. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár series and is suitable for runners who enjoy a combination of road and terrain with significant elevation changes.

Moderate ascent along forest paths and narrow trails to the summit around Vraní Skála
Rolling mostly descending section and steep road downhill to the finish
additional: The registration fee is 200 CZK on-site, including a sausage. The course runs on both road and terrain. The race does not have children's races during the main event. Results are available in the system and as a PDF. The organizer is Instalatérství Ivan Raboch. The course is 9 km, start at 10:30 AM, no children's races, registration on-site, with a sausage included. The race is part of the Brdský běžecký pohár series with various distances and categories throughout May and June.

The 5.2 km course with an elevation gain of 230 meters runs on asphalt surface and is considered one of the more challenging races in the regional ISCAREX Cup series and the Czech Uphill Running Cup. Race facilities are located in the school building, where registration, changing rooms, and toilets are available. Entries can be submitted in advance online at a discounted fee or on the race day.

Road uphill run with finish at Max Švabinský Cottage
The entire course runs on asphalt surface

Picturesque views and natural scenery of the Hradec Králové Region

name: ROZKOŠný 1/2 Maraton
location: Česká Skalice, Česká Skalice, Czech Republic
description: The Rozkoš Half Marathon is a half marathon held in Česká Skalice, running along a new cycle path around the Rozkoš water reservoir. The race offers a main run of 21.1 km and a supporting run of 2 km designed for children and mothers with strollers. The event is complemented by entertainment, refreshments, and the possibility of accommodation in a camp, creating a pleasant atmosphere for all participants and companions. The start of the main category is at 12:30, the first category starts at 10:00.
course_highlights: Half marathon along the new cycle path around the Rozkoš water reservoir
Supporting 2 km run for children and mothers with strollers
Possibility of camping accommodation and refreshments on site
additional: Start of the first category at 10:00, start of the main category at 12:30. The race takes place on the cycle path near the Autocamp Rozkoš in Česká Skalice. The supporting run is intended for children and mothers with strollers. There is entertainment, refreshments, and camping accommodation available. Terrain: road, Registration: not specified, Additional notes: entertainment, refreshments, camping accommodation

name: Záblatská osmička
location: Bohumín-Záblatí, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Záblatská osmička is a running race in Bohumín-Záblatí that offers a local atmosphere and a friendly pace. The race route passes through various terrains, including asphalt roads, forest sections, and gravel-sand paths, engaging runners from start to finish. The event is open to everyone who wants to enjoy running and a great atmosphere. Registration is open until June 24, 2026, and the start is at 10:00 AM at the football field in Záblatí.
course_highlights: The route passes through asphalt roads, forest sections, and gravel-sand paths
Local atmosphere and friendly pace
Refreshments at the 4th kilometer and at the finish
additional: Registration takes place from 9:00 to 9:45. Results announcement and raffle are scheduled for 11:30. Toilets are available at the event site, but it is not possible to securely store belongings at the start and finish areas. The race is held on June 27, 2026, with the start planned for 10:00 AM, and registration closes on June 24, 2026. The event includes refreshments at the 4 km mark and at the finish. The route is similar to that of 2025 and includes categories for men and women, including local runners from Bohumín.
