description: Lužany Forest Run is a traditional running race held in the recreational area of the village of Lužany near Jičín, specifically at the campsite by Marešák Pond. The jubilee 50th edition will take place on June 27, 2026, and offers various categories and distances suitable for a wide range of runners, including children. The race is supported by the Hradec Králové Region and organized by the Municipality of Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., and TJ Sokol Lužany. Participants can expect medals, material prizes, and monetary rewards for the best competitors in each category.
course_highlights: Routes up to 1000 m run within the campsite area, shorter distances are almost straight
Longer routes consist of loops of 300, 400, and 500 meters
The race takes place in a picturesque recreational area by Marešák Pond
additional: Prizes for the best competitors in categories, perpetual trophies, monetary rewards for record-breaking performances, free start for residents of Lužany upon registration by April 30, 2026, medals and material prizes for the top three in each category. The race offers multiple categories including children and recreational runs. Registration is possible on the official website. The event is held at the campsite by Marešák Pond and is supported by regional partners.

name: Žhavé běhy Slováckého léta
location: Uherské Hradiště, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The fiery runs of Slovácké léto are traditional running races held in the historic center of Uherské Hradiště. Participants can choose from three routes of 5, 10, and 21 kilometers, which lead through scenic countryside along the Morava River, through Kunovský les forest park, and the Novoveská lakes. The races are suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offer a unique experience of movement in the beautiful environment of Slovácko. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, adding to the race's atmosphere of the city's historic heart.
course_highlights: Route runs through the historic center of Uherské Hradiště
Running along the Morava River and its confluence with Olšava
Connection with Kunovský les forest park and Novoveská lakes
additional: The start and finish of the races are at Masaryk Square in Uherské Hradiště. The routes are laid out on city and natural paths, including cycle paths. The races are part of the sports-cultural festival Slovácké léto, which also offers other sports and cultural activities. The festival is suitable for all age groups, including families with children. The course includes the city center, the river, parks, and cycle paths; registration conditions are not specified.

name: Sloupský lesní běh
location: Sloup v Moravském krasu, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Sloup Forest Run is a traditional road race held in the picturesque environment of Sloup in the Moravian Karst. The course measures 11.5 kilometers and is characterized by significant elevation gain, making it a challenging and attractive race for runners. The event has a long-standing history and attracts runners from the surrounding area who enjoy the beauty of nature and the sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course length of 11.5 km
Significant elevation gain on the course
Road race in the natural environment of the Moravian Karst
additional: The race takes place in June 2026, with a history of events since 2016, and is designed for runners of all levels who want to experience running in nature with technical challenges.

name: Lochovice - Plešivec
location: Lochovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Lochovice - Plešivec is a running race as part of the Brdský Running Cup, held on June 28, 2026, in Lochovice. The course is approximately 5.5 km long with an elevation gain of 350 meters, starting with 2 km on asphalt and continuing through forest paths with a steeper incline around the 3rd kilometer. The finish is at the top of Plešivec, offering a beautiful view. The event also includes children's races and a family run to support the local hospice Mezi břehy.
course_highlights: Approximate course length of 5.5 km with 350 m elevation gain
2 km on asphalt, the rest through forest paths with steep ascent at 3 km
Finish at the top of Plešivec with a beautiful view
additional: Transport of marked luggage (clothing for changing) by off-road vehicle to the top of Plešivec at 10:20. Fabián's Run - children's competitions from 11:10. Family run to support the hospice Mezi břehy starts at 10:30. The course includes asphalt and forest sections; transportation to the top of Plešivec is provided at 10:20; the event features children's races and activities supporting outdoor activities.

name: Půlmaratón okolo Nového Veselí
location: Nové Veselí, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Hlavní závod 21,1 km – on-line přihlášení startovné 100,- Kč + 20 Kč fond BV

description: The half marathon around Nové Veselí is a traditional running race organized by AO TJ Sokol Nové Veselí, which has been held for 25 years. The main race of 21.1 km takes place on a loop course repeated three times, along asphalt roads and third-class roads with minimal elevation gain. In addition to the main race, shorter courses are available for youth, pupils, and preschool children, making the event attractive to a wide age range of runners. After the race, refreshments are provided, and the winner of the main race receives a monetary prize. The start is traditionally at the square in Nové Veselí.
course_highlights: Main race 21.1 km on a loop course repeated three times
Course runs on asphalt roads and third-class roads with minimal elevation gain
Loops for youth and preschool children on local roads and the square
additional: Refreshment stations are located at both turns of the main race. After the race, refreshments are provided for all participants, with additional refreshments available at the volleyball club's buffet. The winner of the main race receives a monetary prize of 2000 CZK plus 1000 CZK for breaking the course record. Each runner can request a diploma with their placement and time achieved. The race will take place on June 28, 2026, with the main race starting at 9:45 AM. The event is open to the general public, including youth, veterans, and children.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Potůčky
location: Potůčky, Krušné hory, Czech Republic
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Running in the Ore Mountains is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful scenery of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various locations, including Potůček, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and an experiential trail of 20 to 30 km. In addition to running, there are also routes for walking and children's races. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross enthusiasts, children, and walkers, offering an opportunity to enjoy the stunning nature of the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Main race 6 - 9 km in the nature of the Ore Mountains
Experiential trail 20 - 30 km according to the map
Children's races from 200 m to 1600 m
additional: The series includes 6 races in different locations of the Ore Mountains. Besides the main running races, there are also routes for walking with point finding according to the map and children's races. The organizer is Živé Sokolovsko z.s. in cooperation with the Destination Agency Ore Mountains z.s. and the involved municipalities. Registration is done via the website, and the event includes multiple categories and routes suitable for all levels of runners and walkers.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Lomnická etapa
location: Lomnice u Tišnova, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage running race held over seven consecutive days, with the Lomnická stage being one of its parts. This race is among the most demanding ultramarathons in the Czech Republic and offers runners a challenge in the form of long distances and difficult terrain in the South Moravian Region. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathon runners who want to test their endurance and strength in beautiful nature. The Lomnická stage takes place around Olešnice and Lomnice u Tišnova and is part of the entire ultramarathon series.
course_highlights: Stage race over 7 marathons in 7 days
Challenging terrain of the South Moravian Region
Beautiful natural scenery around Olešnice and Lomnice u Tišnova
additional: The race passes through various parts of Moravia, with start and finish in Olešnice or Lomnice u Tišnova, and is designed for experienced ultramarathoners. Registration is possible through the contact details provided on the official website.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Boskovická etapa
location: Boskovice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage running race held in Boskovice and is part of a seven-day ultramarathon consisting of seven marathons. This race is known for its difficulty and long tradition, attracting runners seeking a challenge in the form of stage running. The Boskovice stage offers runners the opportunity to experience the beauty of Moravian nature while testing their endurance in challenging terrain. The race is suitable for experienced ultramarathoners who want to measure their strength against others in a prestigious international event.
course_highlights: Stage race of 7 marathons in 7 days
Challenging terrain around Boskovice
Beautiful Moravian natural scenery
additional: Stage ultramarathon, part of ČAU ULTRA CUP 2019, Czech Championship in stage ultramarathon, various routes and terrain difficulty

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červen
location: Plzeň, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Tempo Makers Osmicka is a running race in Pilsen offering an 8 km course. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and above. The start and finish are at the same location, with registration and bib pickup from 17:00 to 17:45. After the race, the best runners are awarded and a raffle is held. The race capacity is limited to 75 participants, and each participant runs at their own risk.
course_highlights: 8 km course in Pilsen
Start and finish at the same location with available parking
Evening start time with registration from 17:00 to 17:45
additional: Registration and bib pickup are from 17:00 to 17:45. The awards ceremony for the best runners is at 19:05 and the raffle drawing at 19:15. The race capacity is limited to 75 runners. Categories are divided by age from 16 years and above. Parking for participants is available on the provided map. The race takes place on June 30, 2026. Registration is possible online or on-site. The course is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Lachtan
location: Praha 6, Praha, Czech Republic
price_range: 190 Kč do 80 dětí, 150 Kč do 80 dětí (dle počtu dětí)
description: Lachtan is located in Prague 6, Prague, and is primarily associated with the breeding and protection of the South African fur seal at Prague Zoo. In addition, a theater performance titled 'White Seal' is held here, mainly aimed at children and school groups, offering interactive experiences with ecological themes. This program is suitable for families and schools who want to combine education with entertainment and raise awareness about nature conservation.
course_highlights: Breeding and protection of the South African fur seal at Prague Zoo
Theater performance 'White Seal' with ecological themes
Interactive programs for children and schools
additional: Seal breeding at Prague Zoo, ecological theater performances for schools and children, methodological materials for teachers

name: Kolem Libotína
location: Štramberk, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Libotín Run is a traditional race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice, held around Štramberk. The race offers a 6.5 km long circuit with a challenging profile, which has been modified in recent years and brought new course records. The event is part of the Lašská Running League and attracts runners of various categories who enjoy the beautiful natural environment and sporting atmosphere. After the race, winners are announced in their categories, and a raffle is prepared for all participants. The organizer is the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice, which ensures smooth proceedings and supports the running community.
course_highlights: 6.5 km long circuit with a challenging profile
Surroundings of the local swimming pool in Štramberk
A route with a new direction that has brought course records
additional: The race is part of the Lašská Running League. After the race, a raffle is prepared for participants. Registrations are conducted electronically via the EOS application, where a medical examination must be provided. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all categories, with the opportunity to achieve personal records and enjoy the atmosphere of a regional running gathering.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Bystřická etapa
location: Bystřice nad Pernštejnem, Morava, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage running race held over seven marathons in seven consecutive days. The Bystřice stage is one of its parts, offering a challenging and long run in the picturesque environment of Moravia. The race is designed for experienced ultramarathoners seeking a challenge in the form of long stages and beautiful nature. Come test your strength in this prestigious ultramarathon and experience the unique atmosphere of a stage race.
course_highlights: Stage race over 7 marathons in 7 days
Challenging Moravian terrain with beautiful views
International participation and prestigious running event
additional: The race is part of the ultramarathon series, with a length of 42.2 km in the Bystřice stage, and is part of the ČAU ULTRA CUP 2019.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - červenec
location: Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of nearly two laps around a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of each month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. Each participant will be rewarded at the finish line with a warm cinnamon flatbread as a token of appreciation.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt circuit of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
Children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years (boys and girls). Time is measured for each runner, and the top three places in adult and children categories are awarded small prizes. The recommended access to the start is by bicycle, on foot, by car, rollerblades, or trolleybus No. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). Registration is held on the first Saturday of each month from 8:15 to 8:55, with the start at 9:00 AM. The race can be completed on foot, by bike, rollerblades, or car. The route is on the road, 3.2 km long, and suitable for all age groups.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - červenec
location: Stromovka Park, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, including children up to 12 years old who run 1.6 km. The race is ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park environment. After the race, each participant is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake. The course runs along the asphalt paths of Stromovka Park, with adults running two laps and children one lap. Timing is recorded for each runner, and results are published online.
course_highlights: The course runs along the asphalt paths of Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km), children 1 lap (1.6 km + 70 m)
The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Královská obora - Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (under the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of pre-registration online for faster check-in. It is recommended to arrive by bike, on foot, roller skates, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is available near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are changing tents and a non-guarded storage area for belongings, as well as mobile lockers for valuables. WC cabins are available on site. The race time, adjusted by age coefficient, counts towards the annual Pancake Cup. The race takes place in Stromovka Park, registration is voluntary, with a start at 9:07 AM. There are changing rooms and toilets, and parking is available at the bridge to Císařský Island.

name: Třtická punčocha
location: Třtice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Třtická Punčocha is a traditional summer running race held since 1980 in the village of Třtice, always on the first Sunday of July. The race is 8.8 km long and attracts runners from all over Bohemia. Originally intended for children, today it offers categories for adults based on age and gender. In addition to the summer run, a Christmas run of 4.8 km is also held in the village on December 26. The races are popular and have a long-standing tradition with results and photos archived on the village's website.
course_highlights: Distance of 8.8 km in the summer run
Categories based on age and gender (A, B, C, D, E)
Traditional race organized since 1980 in the pleasant environment of Třtice
additional: The race is divided into categories based on age and gender: Category A up to 39 years, B 40-49 years, C 50-59 years, D over 60 years, E women. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website. In addition to the run, there is a children's playground and sports facilities, a tennis court, and a community hall, which was renovated in 2024/2025. The race offers various age categories, including children and adults, and is part of the local sports calendar. Results and photos are regularly published on the official website.

name: Náchod - Dobrošov
location: Náchod, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Military Fortress Dobrošov is located near the town of Náchod in the Kladské Pomezí area in the Orlické Mountains. The fortress is an important part of Czechoslovakia's border fortifications and offers visitors tours of the main bunkers, ammunition depot, barracks, and infirmary. An educational trail runs through the entire fortress, guiding visitors along the line of fortifications to Běloves Spa. The surrounding area is rich in hiking and cycling trails, allowing visitors to explore the beauty of the Orlické Mountains and nearby historic towns.
course_highlights: Tour of artillery bunkers and fortifications from the Czechoslovak border defense period
Educational trail Fortress Dobrošov running along the line of fortifications to Běloves Spa
Hiking and cycling trails in the area with views and access to other military fortresses
additional: Parking at the fortress is free. The visitor center, including restrooms, closes 60 minutes before the end of opening hours. There are 171 steps leading to the underground, with a constant temperature of 6°C. Group size is limited to a maximum of 28 people. The last tour begins 90 minutes before closing. Accommodation options in family pensions and mountain hotels are available in Deštná in the Orlické Mountains. The race is part of the regional sports calendar, with participants able to use the surrounding hiking and cycling trails. Exact registration details and race length have not yet been published.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Cimrmanova etapa
location: Lomnice u Tišnova, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon / Cimrmanova stage is the final seventh stage of the international stage race held in Lomnice u Tišnova. The race offers a challenging and diverse terrain with an elevation gain of 740 meters, presenting a challenge for experienced ultramarathon runners. The start is interval-based according to the order from the previous six races, which increases competitiveness and tension. This race is ideal for runners seeking a combination of technical difficulty and stage racing in the beautiful nature of South Moravia.
course_highlights: Challenging and diverse terrain
Elevation gain of 740 meters
Interval start based on the order from previous stages
additional: The race is the final stage of the international stage race with an interval start based on the order from the previous six races. The start location is at the elementary school in Lomnice u Tišnova. Challenging terrain, interval start, part of a stage race.

name: Širokodolská časovka
location: Široký Důl, Polička, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Wide Dole Time Trial is a short interval running race held in Široký Dole near Polička, which is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026. The race is run on an asphalt course 800 meters long with an elevation gain of 80 meters. The start is interval-based every minute from 10:00 AM, with registration taking place on-site from 8:45 to 9:45. After the run, there is a cycling discipline, which is not part of the running cup. The entry fee is a symbolic 50 CZK, making the race accessible to the general public.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 800 meters
Elevation gain of 80 meters
100% asphalt surface
additional: Interval start every 1 minute. On-site registration from 8:45 to 9:45. After the run, there is a cycling discipline, which is not part of the running cup. The start is at 10:00, registration from 8:45 to 9:45 on-site, the event is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026 series.

name: Běh pod Slunečnou
location: Moravský Beroun, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Run under the Sun is cross-country race over 8.3 km, held in Moravský Beroun in the Olomouc region. This race is part of the Great Prize of the Runners of the Olomouc Region and offers runners the opportunity to test their strength in natural terrain. The course is suitable for cross-country enthusiasts and features interesting natural scenery. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and challenge in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in natural terrain
Distance of the course 8.3 km
Part of the Great Prize of the Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: The race is open to the general public, offers participation at various levels, and provides sporting experiences in the beautiful environment of Moravský Beroun.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - červenec
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race focuses on the joy of running and competition primarily with oneself. It takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, except for some races in June and August, which are held by the river. There is also a trophy competition where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.2 km) in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc
Race suitable for all age groups and running levels
Start location at the fountain, except for June and August races by the river
additional: Registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The top three places in each category are awarded. Results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated for the trophy competition for the period September 2025 - August 2026. The race is held on July 5, 2026, with registration from 9:30 to 10:00 AM, and includes a children's race over 600 meters.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Hlásná Třebaň
location: Hlásná Třebaň, Beroun, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů), 316 Kč (v rámci voucheru na 6 závodů)

description: The Berounka Running Series in Hlásná Třebaň is part of community trail races held in the beautiful natural environment of the Central Bohemian Region. The route passes through the Karlštejn National Nature Park with views of the Karlštejn Castle and offers runners a varied terrain with forest paths and hilly sections. The race is suitable for all runners, whether beginners or experienced, and is part of a series of 12 races that motivate regular movement and sporting activity. Refreshments, baggage storage, and diplomas for the best in each category are provided on site.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Karlštejn National Nature Park
View of Karlštejn Castle from Císařská Louka
Forest paths and hilly terrain marked with red and white flags
additional: Each participant receives a starting number. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. The top three places in each category will receive diplomas. The route is marked with red and white flags and red ground arrows. It is recommended to start by 17:45. The route is marked with red and white flags, includes a start number, refreshments on site, baggage storage options, and diplomas for the top three in each category.

name: 5. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park B. Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Health Run is a charity running series organized by the athletic club TJ Jäkl Karviná, held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run is 3 km long and is intended for everyone who wants to support their health while helping those in need, as the proceeds from the entry fees are donated to charitable causes. The start is traditionally at 17:45 at Lodiček, with registration beginning at 17:00. Everyone is warmly invited to participate in this friendly and health-promoting run.
course_highlights: 3 km route in the beautiful environment of Božena Němcová Park
Surface of the route is a cycle path
Charity run with proceeds supporting those in need
additional: Registration begins at 17:00, start at Lodiček. A series of seven runs in 2026, with proceeds from entry fees going to help those in need. The race has a charitable aspect and is open to the general public and recreational runners, taking place in the beautiful park environment in Karviná.

name: 5. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park B. Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Health Run is a charitable series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that anyone can run at their own pace. The proceeds from the entry fees are donated to help those in need, giving the race purpose and added value. The event is suitable for everyone who wants to do something for their health and support a good cause. The start is traditionally at 17:45 at Lodiček, with registration beginning at 17:00.

Surface: cycle path
Charitable run with proceeds supporting those in need

Men and women run three laps, totaling 5.1 km, while children can compete on a distance adapted to their age. The race takes place in the pleasant environment of Bílá Hora near the playground and is suitable for all age groups. The start is in the late afternoon at 6:00 PM, and participants can enjoy the community atmosphere with refreshments and a place to store belongings.
course_highlights: 1.7 km circuit in the natural environment of Bílá Hora
Men and women run 3 laps (5.1 km), children race on a distance adapted to their age
Start and finish at the playground with refreshments and baggage storage

After the race, water and a tent for storing belongings are available. Recommended transportation is tram line 8 to the Bílá Hora stop. Parking is limited on nearby streets. Participants run at their own risk. The course is 1.7 km and 5.1 km, registration before the race, refreshments after the race, baggage storage, access by public transport and car at the race location.

name: Běhej lesy Klínovec
location: Vrcholek Klínovec, Krušné hory, Czech Republic
description: Run Forests Klínovec is a trail race in the Ore Mountains, taking place on July 11, 2026. The race offers various routes including short and long distances, as well as a charity race. The start is at the top of Klínovec with the option to take the cable car up and run down to the Klínovec Ski Area. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races and features special speed sections Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Start at the top of Klínovec with a run down to the Ski Area
Speed section Conti Speed Section over 150 meters
500m finish straight Generali Investments Finish with timed segment
additional: The race is included in the UTMB Index Races with international points. The course features special speed sections Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish with rewards for the fastest runners. The start is at the top of Klínovec with the possibility of taking the cable car up. The finish straight is extended to 500 meters and is timed for performance analysis. Routes include various lengths from 3 to 50 km, suitable for the general public including children, registration is possible on-site, and the event takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Libečovská 14
location: Podkozí, Libečov, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Libečovská 14 is a race of 14.2 km with an elevation gain of approximately 170 meters, which runs on asphalt and terrain. This race is part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Runners' Cup and offers runners an interesting combination of asphalt and trail sections. The course is suitable for runners seeking a challenge with gentle inclines and varied surfaces. The race takes place in the picturesque area of Podkozí in the Central Bohemian Region and attracts runners from the wider surroundings.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 14.2 km
Elevation gain approx. 170 m
Course runs on asphalt and terrain
additional: The race is part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Runners' Cup, offers a diverse course suitable for runners seeking a challenge, and takes place in the picturesque environment of Podkozí.

name: Králický Sněžník Beze stopy
location: Heřmanice u Králík, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Králický Sněžník BEZE STOPY is a challenging mountain run with a length of 14 km and an elevation gain of 1050 meters, taking place from Heřmanice through Klepáč and Malý Sněžník to the top of Králický Sněžník. The course offers beautiful ridge runs with views into the Polish Kladská Basin and the Dolnomoravský Valley, including short and demanding descents. The race is intended for mountain terrain enthusiasts and is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and the Iscarex Cup. For younger runners, a shorter course of 5 km with an elevation gain of 440 meters is prepared. The main race starts at 9:30, and the junior race begins at 11:00.
course_highlights: Mountain trails with an elevation gain of 1050 m over 14 km
Ridge run with views into the Polish Kladská Basin and the Dolnomoravský Valley
Challenging descents and goat trail terrain
additional: The junior race starts at 11:00 with transportation to the start at 10:15 from the accreditation site. The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and the Iscarex Cup. The event takes place on July 11, 2026, with online registration available from January 1, 2025. The start and finish are in Heřmanice u Králík, and the course includes border roads and goat trails, with a short asphalt section after the start.

name: Hvězdonice - Ondřejov
location: Hvězdonice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Hvězdonice - Ondřejov is an uphill race 5.75 km long with an elevation gain of 255 meters, starting in Hvězdonicích. This running race offers challenging terrain and beautiful views in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in the form of ascent and wanting to test their strength in mountain running. The race is part of the Svět běhu running series and attracts runners from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 5.75 km
Elevation gain 255 m
Start in Hvězdonicích
additional: The race is held regularly in July, registration and further information are not explicitly provided, but the event is well known among the running community in the region.

name: MiniTMMTR - TransMoravský Masochistický Terénní Běh
location: Lomnice, Jihomorava, Czech Republic
organizer: Česká atletická unie (ČAU) ve spolupráci s Tomášem Ruskem
description: MiniTMMTR is a challenging trail run of 100 km starting in Lomnice in the South Moravian Region. The route passes through beautiful areas of the Blansko District to Luleč, where there is a turnaround point, and then runs back along the same path. The race is part of the TransMoravian Masochistic Trail Run, known for its length, demanding profile, and usually warm weather in the summer. The run offers the opportunity to experience some of the most beautiful places in Moravia and enjoy running in the forest and on deserted roads. The race was founded by Czech ultramarathon runner Tomáš Rusek and humorously bears the name masochistic, reflecting its difficulty.
course_highlights: The route passes through beautiful areas of the Blansko District
Turnaround point in Luleč, run there and back
Running in the forest and on deserted roads
additional: Trail race, marked route, refreshment stations, online tracking option, registration and accommodation nearby

name: S-Race
location: Kolonáda Ferdinandova pramene, Mariánské Lázně, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: S-Race is an OCR run in Mariánské Lázně, held in front of the Ferdinand Spring colonnade. The race offers courses of 6 km, 12 km, and 18 km, mainly along paved forest paths with more than 20 obstacles on one lap. There are races tailored for children according to age categories. The start and finish are located directly at the colonnade, where facilities such as changing rooms, toilets, a storage area, and refreshments are available. The race is suitable for a wide age range and features interval starts with a program for children during the main race.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs along paved forest paths
More than 20 obstacles on the 6 km loop, 40+ on the 12 km, 60+ on the 18 km
Start and finish in front of the Ferdinand Spring colonnade in Mariánské Lázně
additional: Interval start of the main race every 120 seconds for 5 runners, starting with the 18K course, then 12K and 6K. Registration and chip pickup on race day from 8:00 to 9:15 for the main race, from 12:30 to 13:45 for the children's race. Participants under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. Male and female changing rooms, toilets, storage, and refreshments are available. During the main race, a program for children is prepared. The terrain includes paved forest paths and obstacles; the race is open to the general public, including younger participants born in 2011 or later who need parental consent; the race takes place on July 12, 2026.

name: Koblížkový pasecký běh
location: Paseka u Olomouce, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: The Koblížkový Pasecký Run is a traditional road race in Paseka near Olomouc, offering a course length of 8.2 km. The race takes place on asphalt, cobblestones, and park paths, passing through the village, along a cycle path to the sanatorium, and through the Odborný léčebný ústav park, returning to the start at the municipal office. The first categories start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators. The event is organized by Ivan Elischer, who ensures smooth proceedings and support for the runners.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt, cobblestones, and park paths
Passes through the village of Paseka and along a cycle path to the sanatorium
Includes the Odborný léčebný ústav park
additional: The race starts at the municipal office in Paseka. The course is suitable for running on asphalt, cobblestones, and park paths. The organizer is Ivan Elischer, who is available for contact and information. The event takes place on July 12, 2026, with registration and further details available on the official website. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Halda Trail Run
location: Kuřimská Nová Ves, Brno-Country District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road adventure running race in Kuřimská Nová Ves, which takes you through the picturesque landscape of the Haldy stream valley and the Libochovka river. The longest route measures approximately 24 km and includes 23 water crossings that are runnable and pleasantly refreshing in summer. The race offers three route length options (4 km, 14 km, and 24 km), which connect and allow changing the distance even during the race. The course mainly runs through forests and meadows away from main tourist trails, with panoramic views, two short steep ascents, and varied terrain, appreciated by both casual runners and ambitious trail runners.
course_highlights: 23 water crossings up to ankle-deep, runnable and refreshing in summer
Panoramic views, two short steep ascents with more than 30% incline
Course mainly runs through forests and meadows away from main tourist trails
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. When entering the second lap (14.5 km), the time gate closes at 12:00, slower runners will be stopped and scored on the intermediate route. Routes of 4 km, 14 km, and 24 km connect and it is possible to change the route length during the race. The terrain is a combination of difficult terrain (stones, roots), light terrain, and asphalt. The course will be thoroughly marked with arrows and ribbons. Trail, water crossings, scenery, challenging terrain, registration details are not specified.

description: Summer morning run is a trail running race held in Štítná nad Vláří - Popov, offering two routes approximately 7 km and 15 km long. The race takes place on varied terrain including asphalt, forest paths, and hills, with beautiful views and challenging sections that test runners' physical fitness. The start and finish are located at the pub in Popov, and the atmosphere of the race is friendly and family-oriented, emphasizing safety and participant responsibility. The race is part of the Zlín Runs series and is organized by the Martinát family and their friends.
course_highlights: Trail race with a mix of asphalt and forest paths
Challenging ascent to the saddle below Hložecká Chapel
Beautiful views of Popov and the surrounding landscape
additional: Registration is possible online up to 2 working days before the race and also on-site until 9:30 AM. Timing is measured using Race Result chip technology. Refreshments (water, Kofola) are provided on the course, and at the finish line, there are sweets, fruit, and for pre-registered participants, goulash. The start and finish are at the pub in Popov, parking is available at the bus stop according to organizer instructions. Children under 15 must be accompanied by a person over 18, and youth aged 15-18 start with written consent from legal guardians. The race takes place on July 12, 2026, starting at 10:00 AM, registration closes 2 days before the race, with chip timing. Suitable for runners aged 15 and above.

name: Běh o Ludgerův meč
location: Hořičky, Náchod, Czech Republic
description: The Ludger's Sword Run is the third edition of a running race organized by the Náchod Running Club in cooperation with the municipality of Hořičky. The race is part of the Primátor CUP running series and the Velká cena východních Čech cup. The routes lead around Hořičky with beautiful views of Kladské pomezí, in gently rolling terrain with surfaces of gravel, forest paths, and minimal asphalt. There are courses for children, a main race of 8 km, and a FIT route of 4 km. The start and registration take place at the area near the football field in Hořičky.
course_highlights: Main race 8 km in gently rolling terrain with gravel and forest paths
FIT route 4 km with minimal asphalt
Beautiful views of Kladské pomezí
additional: Registration from 8:00 at the area near the football field in Hořičky. Registration closes 30 minutes before the start for children categories, and at 10:00 for adults. Children's races start from 9:00 to 9:35 depending on age categories. The main race and the FIT route start at 10:30. The registration fee includes timing with chip technology, homemade buns, cakes, juice, and tea at the finish. Parking is provided at the football field with instructions from organizers. Prizes for the fastest children, medals and material prizes in adult categories, and monetary prizes for the top three men and women overall in the main race (600 CZK, 400 CZK, 200 CZK). Terrain: gently rolling with surfaces of gravel, forest paths, and minimal asphalt; online registration via sportchallange.cz; the race includes medals and prizes; held at the area near the football field in Hořičky.

After the race, participants can enjoy a raffle and substantial refreshments.

The main men's course is 7.8 km long with a total elevation gain of approximately 120 meters

The start and finish are in Hvězda Park at the main entrance from Vypich. There is substantial refreshments including non-alcoholic drinks, beer, and bread with English bacon. After the race, a raffle with material prizes takes place. Mobile toilets are available. The race offers refreshments, electronic timing, a raffle with material prizes, and various age categories including children.

The course mainly runs through forests and meadows away from main tourist trails, featuring 23 stream crossings, two short steep ascents, and panoramic views. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is supported by the South Bohemian Region budget. The event offers a sporting experience in the beautiful regional environment and attracts runners from the surrounding area. Organizers warmly invite all runners to participate in this popular event.

name: Kružberský Tesák
location: Kružberský přehradní areál, u přehrady Kružberk, Kružberk, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kružberský Tesák is a sporting event held at the Kružberk Dam area, offering routes and categories for experienced racers, semi-advanced runners, and complete beginners. The race is suitable for solo runners, hikers, and families with children. The event also features Pejskiáda, an entertaining exhibition and competitions for dogs of all sizes and breeds. Organizers Kateřina and Lucie, nature and sports enthusiasts with dogs, aim to create a friendly atmosphere and ensure enjoyable experiences for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes suitable for runners of various levels from beginners to experienced
Surroundings of Kružberk Dam with beautiful nature and views
Pejskiáda with exhibition and competitions for dogs of all breeds and sizes
additional: Registration opens in May 2026. After submitting the application, a variable symbol for payment of the start fee will be sent to the participant's account. Payment must be made as soon as possible after registration. The event includes dog competitions and exhibitions, suitable for families with children and dog lovers. A two-day event with the option to camp in tents, competitions, and a traveling trophy for the winners.

name: Zkus Noční Kuks
location: Kuks, Trutnov District, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: Try Noční Kuks is a night running race set in the picturesque baroque environment of Kuks. It offers two routes - 10 km and 5 km - which pass by historic landmarks such as Braun's Nativity Scene and Hospital Kuks. Running in the darkness illuminated only by headlamps provides a unique experience and atmosphere that participants will remember for a long time. The 10 km route includes the pilgrimage route of the 21st-century Cross Path, while the shorter 5 km route runs along the night-time Elbe River and the Count's Avenue with 222 trees.
course_highlights: 10 km route runs through the magical heart of baroque landscape with Braun's Nativity Scene and the 21st-century Cross Path
5 km route starts at the hospital and passes along the night Elbe River and the Count's Avenue with 222 trees
Night run illuminated by headlamps with an unforgettable atmosphere under the glowing facade of Hospital Kuks
additional: The registration fee includes a start number and chip. It is possible to purchase the registration as a gift voucher with a unique code. Registration is done online via myresult.cz, and a contractual relationship is established upon payment of the registration fee. The race is organized by TURN ON EVENTS s.r.o. from Hradec Králové. The race offers routes of 5 km and 10 km, the option to start with a headlamp, refreshments during and after the race, participation with dogs is allowed, registration is possible through the website, and the registration fee is payable within 14 days of registration.

name: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Olomouc District, Czech Republic
description: CEZ RunTour Olomouc is a family running event offering courses for amateurs and elite runners in lengths of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km, including children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy sady and is part of a nationwide series with unique routes. Organizers emphasize excellent service, safety, and fun for the whole family, including an accompanying program and a charitable aspect. Each participant receives a start package and can look forward to refreshments and support from a guiding team. CEZ RunTour is not only a sporting event but also a full-day experience for all age groups.
course_highlights: Courses of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km including children's runs of 500 and 1000 m

Accompanying program and charitable aspect of the race

A special emergency phone line is available during the race. The event includes various routes, family activities, charitable support, medals, photographs, and facilities for runners. The start and finish are in Smetanovy sady, with a capacity of approximately 1700 runners.

description: Night Run Rusava is an unforgettable night race in the Hostýn Hills, offering a 12-hour run on a single loop as well as a 5 km race. The event is suitable for individuals and relay teams, and it is not mandatory to run the entire 12 hours. The race facilities include a gym for rest, a all-night buffet, and refreshment stations. The event takes place in a picturesque environment with a ski slope and forests around Rusava, providing a unique sporting experience under the starry sky.
course_highlights: Night run on a ski slope and in the forests of the Hostýn Hills
One loop 5 km long with the possibility of repeating for 12 hours
All-night refreshment stations and facilities at the local school
additional: The race facilities include a gym at the local school for rest, with the option to bring sleeping bags and mats. Throughout the night, a buffet and refreshment stations with drinks, fruit, and food are open. Parking is available at designated spots in the village. It is not necessary to run the full 12 hours; walking with poles is also allowed. Starting numbers can be supplemented with a band for 150 CZK. Terrain: forests and ski slope, registration, relay system, ecological requirements for cups, all-night catering.

name: 7 pohoří Krušné Hory
location: Abertamy, Krušné hory, Czech Republic
description: The Krušné hory 2026 race is a technical trail run that takes you through the beautiful Krušné hory mountains and the former mining landscape listed as UNESCO World Heritage. The route starts in Abertamy and passes through the former Eva mine, Jelení, Swiss Cottage on Plešivec, Merklín, the former Kaff settlement, Pstruží, and a ski resort to the finish line. It offers three courses of different lengths and elevation gains, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The race takes place in all weather conditions, and participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments on the route and at the finish.
course_highlights: Natural route with the beauty of Krušné hory and UNESCO mining landscape
Main course 22 km with 1000 m elevation gain
Alternative routes 13 km and 8 km with 510 m and 220 m elevation gain
additional: The race has a time limit of 4 hours, after which the runner is marked as DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration stand. Recommended equipment includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The registration fee includes a professionally marked route, a start number, chip timing, a commemorative medal, and refreshments on the route and at the finish. The event takes place in all weather conditions and participation is at your own risk. The registration fee covers the course, medal, refreshments, facilities, and recommended gear including a windbreaker and a mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The race is organized by the local mountain rescue team.

name: Rokytnice nad Jizerou - Dvoračky
location: Dvorská bouda, Rokytnice nad Jizerou, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The route from Rokytnice nad Jizerou to Dvoračky is a popular hiking trail in the western Krkonoše Mountains, starting at the Upper Square in Rokytnice. The blue-marked trail leads around the Hutský Stream to the picturesque Hutský Waterfall and further to the mountain lodge Dvoračky, which is known for its history and traditional cheese production. The path offers beautiful natural scenery, especially in the autumn season when the surrounding beech forests display all the colors. The route is suitable for hikers, ski mountaineers, and cross-country skiers, who can enjoy the snowy landscape and refreshments at the Štumpovka restaurant at Dvoračky.
course_highlights: Blue-marked trail leading around Hutský Stream
Hutský Waterfall surrounded by beech forests with beautiful autumn colors
Historical mountain lodge Dvoračky with traditional cheese production
additional: Parking is available at the parking lot by Tesco on the Lower Square in Rokytnice. Refreshments are available at the Štumpovka restaurant at Dvoračky and at the U Vocta pub in Rokytnice. The route is also suitable for winter hiking, ski mountaineering, and cross-country skiing, with the need to respect groomed ski tracks and not enter them. The race is part of the local sports calendar, with options to participate in various distances, including an ascent race to Dvoračky. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers beautiful views and sporting experiences.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Fojtovice

Over six races in various destinations, you can choose from main races of 6 to 9 km, experience trails of 20 to 30 km, point search walks, and children's races. The series is suitable for runners, canicrossers, children, and walkers, offering a diverse range of routes in the picturesque nature of the Ore Mountains. The race in Fojtovice takes place on July 19, 2026, and features a main race, experience trail, walking, and children's races.
course_highlights: Main race 6 - 9 km in the picturesque landscape of the Ore Mountains
Experience trail 20 - 30 km according to the map
Children's races from 300 m to 1,600 m

Children's races are divided by age and distance. The organizer is Živé Sokolovsko z.s. in cooperation with the Destination Agency Ore Mountains z.s. The races include various distances and categories, including walking and children's races, and the series takes place at several sites in the Ore Mountains region.

name: Šachty - Štěpánka
location: Vysoké nad Jizerou-Sklenařice, Vysoké nad Jizerou, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Český Ski klub Vysoké nad Jizerou
description: Šachty - Štěpánka Run is a traditional race organized by the Czech Ski Club in Vysoké nad Jizerou. The race is part of the Maratonstavu of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers runners a challenging course in the beautiful Krkonoše environment. The event attracts athletes and fans of uphill running who will enjoy the challenge and the atmosphere of a mountain race. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test their strength on this traditional route.
course_highlights: Challenging course in the Krkonoše Mountains
Uphill run with beautiful views
Part of the Maratonstavu of the Czech Cup
additional: The race is part of a series of uphill running events with a tradition dating back in history, and offers a demanding terrain suitable for experienced runners and mountain sports enthusiasts.

name: Běh za Sliveneckou saní
location: Praha 5-Velká Chuchle, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Slivenecká Sáně Run is a uphill race in Prague 5-Velká Chuchle, measuring 2.54 km with an elevation gain of 130 meters. This race is part of the series of uphill runs in Prague and the surrounding area and offers runners a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent. The race is suitable for all who want to test their strength and endurance in hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2.54 km
Elevation gain 130 m
Uphill race in Prague 5-Velká Chuchle
additional: The race takes place as part of the series of hilly runs, starting in three waves, with results published in categories. The event is suitable for runners of all levels who want to conquer a hilly course in a pleasant environment.

name: 402. Malá cena Monaka
location: Slatiňany, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Small Monaka Run is a traditional running race organized by the KRB Chrudim club, held in the picturesque environment of Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race offers athletes the opportunity to test their strength on various courses and enjoy the atmosphere of the running community. The event is part of a long-standing tradition and attracts runners of all ages. Organizers emphasize quality organization and a friendly race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Traditional running race in the picturesque environment of Slatiňany
Various courses suitable for a wide range of runners
Part of the long-standing running tradition of the KRB Chrudim club
additional: The race takes place in July 2026, specific courses and registration information are not specified

name: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák
location: Kazín, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák is part of the KOPEC series, which features uphill runs in Prague and the surrounding area. This traditional race offers runners the opportunity to test their strength on challenging hilly courses in the picturesque environment of Kazín. The KOPEC series is known for its community atmosphere and support for runners of all categories, who are automatically included in the overall ranking. The race is suitable for everyone who enjoys running in nature and the challenges associated with hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Uphill run in Prague and surrounding terrain
Challenging hilly courses in the natural environment of Kazín
Part of the traditional KOPEC series with scoring and league
additional: Participation in any KOPEC series race automatically qualifies runners for the overall league ranking. The series ranking is determined by the total points from up to the 10 best races. Runners must follow start rules according to categories and run with a visibly attached start number. In case of health threats, the race director may interrupt or terminate the race. The event is part of a series of hilly runs in Prague, with no specific course lengths provided. The race has a long tradition and is popular among local runners.

name: Smilovice pomáhají - Běh pro Theu
location: Sportcentrum Smilovice, Smilovice, Česká republika

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dobrovolné startovné při online registraci + zdarma zařazení do tomboly

description: The Run for Thea is a charity race organized by the Smilovice Helping Foundation, taking place on July 25, 2026, at the Smilovice Sports Center. This race supports the treatment and rehabilitation of little Thea, who is facing serious health complications. Participants can choose from several routes of different lengths and age categories, whether they want to compete or just walk. The event is open to everyone who wants to support a good cause and experience the joy of movement in a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes run on asphalt and paved paths, suitable for strollers and wheelchair users (accessible route).
Available routes: 600 m children's race (ages 0-5 and 6-10), 2 km junior race, 4 km hobby race, and 12 km main race.
Start and finish are at the Smilovice Sports Center with parking available.
additional: Registration and distribution of start numbers begin at 8:00 AM. Starts are divided by categories from 9:30 to 11:11. The proceeds from the entry fees are fully dedicated to supporting the treatment and rehabilitation of Thea. There is an option to purchase a lottery ticket for the tombola. Routes are marked with colors according to length (green for 4 km, red for 12 km).

name: Běh na Lysou horu
location: restaurace Zlatník, Krásná-Nižní Mohelnice, Czech Republic
description: The Lysá hora Run is a traditional race held every last Saturday of July in Krásná - Nižní Mohelno. This 41st edition will welcome runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, who aim to conquer Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains. The race starts near the Zlatník restaurant at the intersection to Lysá hora, where registration and the award ceremony also take place. The course runs along an asphalt road on a forest road managed by the Czech Forests Authority up to the summit of Lysá hora.
course_highlights: Start near the Zlatník restaurant at the intersection to Lysá hora
The entire course runs along an asphalt road on a forest road managed by the Czech Forests Authority
Finish at the summit of Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: The race is open to runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, takes place in the Beskydy Mountains, and is part of regional and national running competitions.

name: Borovská desítka
location: Havlíčkova Borová, Vysočina, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kč při přihlášení na webu do 30.6.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 150 Kč při přihlášení na místě v den startu

description: The Borovská Ten is a traditional running race held in the picturesque village of Havlíčkova Borová in the Vysočina region. The race offers a 10 km course with a gentle elevation gain, mainly through forest and asphalt roads, ensuring a pleasant running experience even in sunny weather thanks to the shade of trees. The start and finish are located in the center of the village, with refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. After the race, there is abundant refreshments and a ceremonial announcement of winners in various categories.
course_highlights: 10 km course with a total elevation gain of 139 m
The first third of the course runs along a forest path, the rest on asphalt roads
Refreshment stations at 5 km and at the finish, course runs through a forest with pleasant shade
additional: Registration for the main category takes place from 14:30 to 16:15, the main race starts at 17:00. Showers, changing rooms, toilets, and baggage storage are available. Throughout the race, there is abundant refreshments at the finish including drinks, grilled delicacies, draft beer, and ice cream. Timing is provided by chip timing integrated into the start number, with a timing mat only at the finish. The race is part of the local running tradition, with results available on the website and the possibility to participate in children's categories.

name: Běh na Kozubovou
location: Dolní Lomná, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Elektronické přihlášení do 24.7.2026 ráno, bez nároku na tričko

description: The Kozubová Run is a traditional mountain race held in Dolní Lomná, run along marked tourist trails with challenging elevation gain. The race starts at the bakery in Dolní Lomná and passes through Polana, the Pod Kykula saddle, up to the tourist hut on Kozubová. The course is approximately 5 km long with an elevation gain of around 500 meters, offering runners a challenge with steep ascents and beautiful mountain views. The race is open to a wide range of categories from juniors to veterans and is known for its friendly atmosphere and a rich raffle for participants.
course_highlights: The entire course runs along marked tourist trails - blue and green markers
Challenging ascent with an elevation gain of about 500 meters
Start at the bakery in Dolní Lomná, finish at the tourist hut on Kozubová
additional: Registration of competitors takes place at the museum located 300 meters from the start at the bakery. Pre-registered runners will receive a start number with their name and a T-shirt. After the race, there is a rich raffle with prizes from local sponsors. The start is mass for all categories at 10:00 AM. Prizes and monetary awards are announced in individual categories as well as overall for men and women. The race starts at 10:00 AM at the bakery in Dolní Lomná, registration is open until July 21, 2026, with a rich accompanying program, prizes for the top three in each category, accommodation options, and a photo gallery from previous editions.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka
location: Plzeň, Plzeň-město, Czech Republic
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon is part of the Zátopek Golden Week, a series of running races held in Plzeň in honor of Olympic champion Emil Zátopek. The main marathon takes place on July 27 and also features accompanying races such as a half marathon, marathon and half marathon relay races, and a 10.5 km road run. The start is in the afternoon in Štruncovy Sady and the surrounding area, with a rich program and categories for men, women, and youth. The race is known for its tradition, quality organization, and friendly atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Plzeň, Štruncovy Sady and surroundings
Opportunity to participate in the marathon, half marathon, relays, and shorter runs
Categories for all age groups including youth
additional: The start for marathon runners with an expected time over 5 hours is at 13:00. Registration begins at 12:00, with check-in and bib number distribution in Plzeň, Pallova 19. The entry fee includes a bib number, chip usage fee, refreshments, a commemorative medal, and a T-shirt for marathoners. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. The race offers various course lengths, online registration, technical and medical support, and has a capacity of approximately 1000 participants.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červenec
location: Řeka Úslava, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Tempo Makers Osmička is a regular running race in Pilsen, held along the Úslava River. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and older and offers a friendly atmosphere for all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The capacity is limited to 75 participants, ensuring an intimate and relaxed event. The start and finish are at the same location with parking available nearby. After the race, the best runners are announced and a raffle draw takes place.
course_highlights: 8 km course along the Úslava River
Start and finish at the same place in Pytle, Pilsen
Friendly atmosphere with a limited capacity of 75 runners
additional: Registration and bib distribution are from 17:00 to 17:45. After the race at 19:05, the top runners are announced and at 19:15, a post-race raffle is held. Parking for participants is available near the start and finish. The course is flat, registration is possible in advance or on-site. The race takes place on July 28, 2026.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (8) – červencový
location: Praha 4-Braník, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Race of 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGA 2026 in Prague Braník offers a pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River, where personal records are often broken. This race is part of the 16th edition of regular runs held every month, allowing participants to compare their performances with other runners. The course is certified, and for the 10 km distance, it is possible to achieve the limit for the Czech Championships. After the race, a relaxed atmosphere is guaranteed with refreshments and the announcement of the best runners.
course_highlights: Pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník
Course measured with a certified measuring device
Opportunity to meet the limit for the Czech Championships at 10 km
additional: Registration is from 18:00, the 10 km race starts at 19:00, the 5 km race starts at 19:05. After the race, refreshments are available at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is possible at the organizer’s tent. After the race, a raffle with prizes such as free entry to the next race, massage vouchers, and more will be held. The course is suitable for all levels of runners from beginners to professionals. First place in categories is awarded prizes worth 103,000 CZK. The races are part of a series of running events in Prague.

name: Krkonošská 50
location: Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonošský národní park, Czech Republic
description: Krkonošská 50 is a traditional trail run held in the picturesque environment of the Krkonoše National Park, starting in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race offers a challenging route of 50 km with an elevation gain of 1784 meters, passing along marked trails and mountain paths. The event is limited to 300 participants and is divided into several age categories for men and women. Organizers emphasize ecology and safety, including mandatory mobile phone equipment and a ban on littering outside refreshment stations.
course_highlights: 50 km course with an elevation gain of 1784 m
Route runs along marked trails in Krkonoše National Park
Refreshment stations at 13, 18, 27, 33, 39 km and at the finish
additional: Limited to 300 participants. Start and finish at the Svatý Petr area, Špindlerův Mlýn. Parking available at the central parking lot in Špindlerův Mlýn. Possibility to change the route from long to short after reporting to the control at Svatý Petr - hotel Horal. Trail marked with black arrows on a yellow background only at intersections and turns. Mobile phone is mandatory for all participants. Trail race with marked paths, online registration, limited to 300 participants, categories for men and women, possibility of route changes.

name: Běhej lesy Bílá
location: Bílá, Beskydy, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Bílá is a mountain trail race held in the beautiful environment of the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area (CHKO Beskydy). The race offers various routes including a short and a long one, with the long route ČSOB 20 km included in the international UTMB Index. Runners can use the cable car to the top and look forward to special speed sections Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which bring additional competitive elements and rewards. The race is suitable for all mountain trail running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of the Beskydy and compete on well-marked trails.
course_highlights: Trails run within the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area (CHKO Beskydy) with respect to nature and a ban on entry outside marked paths
Conti Speed Section - a 200-meter speed segment on the Nova 11 km and ČSOB 20 km routes
Generali Investments Finish - an extended 500m finish straight with a measured section and performance analysis
additional: The race is part of the UTMB Index Races with international points. The cable car to the top of the Bílá ski resort is available. At the finish line, there is an extended 500m straight with a measured section called Generali Investments Finish, where the fastest men and women are announced and rewarded with a functional running jersey from the brand Craft. Trail routes of various lengths, cable car ascent, speed sections, charity race, respect for the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area, GPX routes available for download.

name: Zlatá stezka
location: Stožec, Šumava, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Golden Trail is a historic and international tourist route connecting the Czech Republic with the Danube region, passing through the beautiful nature of the Šumava and Bavarian Forest. The route, 631 km long, offers a unique experience through its connection with the German Golden Trail and crossing several national parks and natural reserves. Tourists can explore historic towns, castles, lookouts, and cultural monuments along the trail, which is equipped with informational boards and rest areas. The Golden Trail is ideal for hiking and discovering the natural and historical beauty of the South Bohemian and Pilsen regions.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Šumava National Park and Bavarian Forest, the largest forested areas in Central Europe
Historic towns of Prachatice, Vimperk, and Kašperské Hory with cultural monuments and museums
Cross-border connection with the German Golden Trail with 13 border crossings
additional: The route features the Golden Trail logo, informational boards, and rest areas. There are various stages with different difficulty levels and lengths. Nearby attractions include the Volary Museum, Libín Lookout Tower, and historic sites such as Hus Castle and Vimperk Castle. The route offers different lengths and levels, including ultra challenges and sports challenges, with the possibility of pre-registration. The event is suitable for runners, cyclists, and tourists who want to explore the region actively and respectfully of nature.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - srpen
location: Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of nearly two laps on a precisely measured asphalt track. The race also features a children's course of 800 meters. Each participant can enjoy a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish line. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month with registration from 8:15 to 8:55 and a start at 9:00.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt track of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
Children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building. Categories are divided into men and women from 13 to 127 years old and children up to 12 years old. Time is measured for each runner, and the top three in each category receive small prizes. Recommended arrival methods include cycling, walking, driving, rollerblading, or taking trolleybus no. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course length is 3.2 km with an asphalt surface, and the children's course is 800 meters. The run is open to all age groups, including children up to 12 years old. The race starts every first Saturday from 8:15 to 8:55, with the gunshot start at 9:00.

name: Běh na Kamenný stůl
location: Rataje nad Sázavou, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Kamenný stůl Run is a traditional running race held in Rataje nad Sázavou, celebrating its 10th anniversary this year. The race offers a challenging and beautiful route from the castle courtyard to the Kamenný stůl monument, with varied surfaces and hilly terrain. The event is suitable for both professional runners and amateurs, as well as families with children, for whom shorter routes are prepared. The race is part of the Běhej zámky series, which connects running races in attractive castle locations.
course_highlights: The course leads to the Kamenný stůl monument with various surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt, paved and unpaved forest paths
Hilly terrain with parts of the route passing through the forest and field roads
Start and finish directly on the castle courtyard in Rataje nad Sázavou
additional: Start numbers with chip and name, water, cookie, promotional materials, castle entrance ticket. For children, a voucher for ice cream and for adults, a sausage. The facilities include fruit, buns, and a drinking regime. Parking is available at the playground on Zámecká Street and other nearby locations. Results are announced after completing each route. Registration includes a running package, refreshments, and castle entry; races take place under normal traffic conditions.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - srpen
location: Stromovka Park, Praha 7, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, including children up to 12 years old running 1.6 km. The race is friendly and focused on the joy of running, whether you want to improve your personal best or just enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful environment. The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park, with adults running two laps and children one lap. At the finish line, everyone is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their effort.
course_highlights: The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km), children up to 12 years run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Královská obora - Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of pre-registration online for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age and gender, results are measured with an age coefficient and count towards the annual Lívancový Cup. Recommended transportation includes cycling, walking, rollerblading, or tram (stop Výstaviště). There are tents for changing clothes and storing belongings, a mobile valuables locker, and portable toilet cabins. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. The race is held in Stromovka Park, starting at 9:07 AM, with registration from 8:15 to 8:45 AM, online registration available. Categories for different age groups, parking at the bridge to Císařský Island, changing rooms and toilets available. The race is regularly held on the first Saturday of each month.

name: Mšecká sedmička
location: Mšec, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Městys Mšec a TJ Sokol Mšec
description: Mšecká sedmička is a traditional running race held in Mšec in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 7 km long and runs through forest and field paths, offering runners a pleasant natural terrain. The start is at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field, and the race is suitable for the general public. The event is organized by the Městys Mšec and TJ Sokol Mšec, who ensure a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Race length of 7 km
Surface of forest and field paths
Start and finish at TJ Sokol Mšec football field
additional: The organizer is Městys Mšec and TJ Sokol Mšec. The race is of a mixed type with a course through forest and field paths. The race starts at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field. The course includes forest and field paths; registration conditions are not specified.

name: Libeř - Radlík
location: Libeř, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Libeř - Radlík is an uphill race 2.47 km long with an elevation gain of 170 meters, which is part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and the surrounding area. The route is not purely uphill; it includes several flat sections and one downhill, adding interest and dynamism to the race. The atmosphere is pleasant, and the entry fee is symbolic, with generous prizes for winners from the company Botanicus. The race is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in hilly terrain near Prague.
course_highlights: Length of the route 2.47 km with an elevation gain of 170 m
The route includes flat sections and one downhill
Part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and surroundings
additional: Entry fee is symbolic, winners receive generous prizes from the company Botanicus. The route runs on wide, partly gravel paths, which some runners mention in comments as a disadvantage compared to forest trails. The race has a pleasant atmosphere despite slightly punk conditions. The route is not purely uphill; it includes a few flat sections and one downhill; runs on wide, partly gravel paths; part of the Hill Runs series.

name: Trail Running Cup - Krkonošská padesátka
location: Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The Krkonošská Fifty is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque environment of Špindlerův Mlýn in the Krkonoše Mountains. The race offers a challenging route of 50 km with an elevation gain of 1784 meters, running on marked trails and mountain paths. The start is at the Svatý Petr area, and participants can use the central parking lot in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race is limited to 300 starters and announces an absolute male and female winner, as well as ten age categories for men and women.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1784 m elevation gain
Route runs on marked trails and mountain paths in the Krkonoše Mountains
Checkpoints at 13 km, 18 km, 27 km, 33 km, 39 km, and at the finish line
additional: The race starts at the Svatý Petr area in Špindlerův Mlýn. Parking is available at the central parking lot in Špindlerův Mlýn. Mobile phones are mandatory equipment for all participants, must be functional and charged. The race strictly prohibits littering outside refreshment stations. Route changes from longer to shorter are possible after notifying the control at Svatý Petr - Hotel Horal. The route is marked with black arrows on a yellow background only at intersections and turns. The participant limit is 300 runners, the race is open to men and women, registration is online, and the race day is August 1, 2026.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - srpen
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race focuses on the joy of running and self-improvement, where each participant competes primarily against themselves. The event is usually held in Smetanovy Sady near the fountain, except for the June and August races, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova street. It also includes a trophy competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2 miles (3.2 km), children's course 600 m
The course mostly runs in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, near the fountain
June and August races are held by the river on U Dětského domova street
additional: Registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The top three places in each category are awarded. Results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated for the trophy competition for the period September 2025 - August 2026.
