The race includes an asphalt track of 3.2 km and a children's race of 600 m; registration is from 9:30 to 10:00; the event is scheduled for August 2, 2026.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Moldava
location: Moldava, Krušné hory, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Running in the Ore Mountains is a cross-country and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various locations, including Moldava, with routes for runners, canicrossers, children, and walkers. Each race offers a main running event of 6 to 9 km, an experiential route of 20 to 30 km according to the map, a walking route of 5 to 8 km with point finding, and children's races from 200 to 1600 meters. The series is suitable for the general public who want to actively and sportingly explore the beauty of the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Main race 6 - 9 km in the nature of the Ore Mountains
Experiential route 20 - 30 km according to the map with orienteering elements
Children's races and walking with point finding 5 - 8 km
additional: The series includes 6 races in various locations of the Ore Mountains. The routes are suitable for runners, canicrossers, children, and walkers. Children's races range from 200 to 1600 meters in length. Experiential routes are guided by a map and include point finding for walking. The races are part of a series with overall scoring and winners announced at the final race in Stříbrná; the event also features races with dogs and children's categories.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Karlštejn
location: Autokemp Karlštejn, Karlštejn, Středočeský, Czech Republic
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka Running Series in Karlštejn is a community trail race held in the beautiful natural environment of Autokemp Karlštejn. The route passes through fields, meadows, and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry, continues along the red St. James path to Karlštejn Castle, and ends with a downhill run to the finish line. The race offers a friendly atmosphere, marked trail, and options for refreshments and baggage storage. Each participant receives a bib number, and the top finishers in each category will receive diplomas and medals.
course_highlights: The route passes through fields, meadows, and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry
Continues along the red St. James path to Karlštejn Castle
The final part of the route is downhill towards the finish line
additional: The route is marked with red and white flags and red ground markers. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. The top three places in each category will receive diplomas and medals. The recommended arrival time is no later than 17:45. Bib numbers, refreshments, baggage storage, and registration are available on the day of the race. Registration can be done online or on-site. The race starts by 17:45, and the trail is marked.

name: Rozdělovský čtvrtmaratón
location: Kladno-Rozdělov, Kladno, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Rozdělov Quarter Marathon is a running race organized by the Marathon Club Kladno, held in Kladno-Rozdělov. The club focuses on endurance running and organizing running events in the region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to test their strength on a quarter marathon course in the pleasant environment of the Central Bohemian Region. The event is part of the club's running calendar and supports the running community around Kladno.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon course in Kladno-Rozdělov
Organized by Marathon Club Kladno focusing on endurance running
Part of the regional running calendar
additional: The race takes place on a Wednesday or Thursday in the first half of August from 18:00, with a route through forest paths. The event has an intimate character and the number of participants is growing.

name: Krčský lomcovák
location: Krčský les, Praha 4, Czech Republic
description: Krčský lomcovák is a traditional running race held in Krčský Forest in Prague 4. The race offers a 5 km route starting at the Great Pavilion, suitable for both men and women, with different start times. The event is part of a sports and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and families with children can try various activities such as slackline, sack jumping, or disc golf. The race is organized by the magazine Krčák žije, which focuses on activities and news related to Krčský Forest and its surroundings.
course_highlights: 5 km route in Krčský Forest
Start at the Great Pavilion
Mostly forest terrain with natural features
additional: Men start at 18:30, women half an hour earlier. The start is at the Great Pavilion. The event is part of a sports and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park with accompanying activities for families with children. The race is open to all age groups, offers various running disciplines, and is part of a community sports day in Prague 4.

name: Měřínský kros
location: Měřín, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Měřínský cross-country is a traditional cross-country race set in the beautiful nature of the Vysočina region, offering a main race of 13 km across Dědkovská Mountain and a relaxed 8 km course suitable for recreational runners. For children aged 5 to 12, there is a obstacle run called Junior Kros with a giant jumping castle. The race is timed with chip timing, and after the run, an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments takes place. The start and finish are at the playground behind the elementary school in Měřín, where parking, a storage room, toilets, changing rooms, and showers are available.
course_highlights: Main course of 13 km mainly runs on field and forest paths and trails (about 70%), with the rest consisting of asphalt sections in the village
Route over Dědkovská Mountain with new viewpoints thanks to bark beetle damage
Small refreshment station along the route
additional: Junior Kros is a free obstacle run for children aged 5-12 with distances of 700 m and 1400 m. After the race, a giant jumping castle is available. Parking is possible at the Měřín elementary school. On-site registration closes 20 minutes before the start. The registration fee includes a sausage and a drink. The race limit is 100 runners. The race is run at your own risk, without insurance. After the race, an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments takes place. The course is mainly on field and forest paths, marked route, limit of 100 runners, free children's obstacle runs, evening volleyball tournament after the race.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Pardubice
location: Pardubice, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Color Run You Can't Escape is a colorful run in Pardubice offering two routes - 5 km and 1.5 km. The event is not about speed but about joy, friendship, and fun, where participants pass through colorful zones, being splashed with colors. The run is suitable for all age groups and is ideal for families, friends, and individuals who want to experience a day full of colors, music, and great atmosphere. In addition to the run, there is a music program and various entertainment activities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colorful zones
1.5 km route with 3 colorful zones and an interactive sports zone
Colorful zones, music, and entertainment activities along the route
additional: The event takes place from 9:00 to 16:00 in Pardubice, Park Na Špici. It features a music program with Pavel Calta and others. The event is charitable, with the option to contribute by purchasing a symbolic heart. Participants can join a prize draw from partner STANLEY on Instagram. The event offers BASIC and WOW start packages, with registration available online and on-site. It is suitable for team-building and charitable activities, with rules including paid entry fee and a visible participant T-shirt.

name: Mořice Run
location: Mořice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Mořice Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque village of Mořice near Olomouc. The race is part of a series of running events focused on fitness and performance running, organized by the club in Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for supporting regular running and endurance races, and Mořice Run offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy a quality race atmosphere. The club also provides support and advice to runners who want to start or improve their training.
course_highlights: 8 km course on asphalt roads around the castle in Mořice
Children's run of 1.5 km as part of the event
Friendly atmosphere and facilities for competitors in the local area
additional: The race takes place on August 8, 2026, as part of the Great Prize of endurance runners of the Olomouc region, start at 9:00 AM, registration and details are not specified

name: Slatinická sedmička
location: Slatinice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Slatinická Sedmička is a charity run covering 7 km, primarily through terrain around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc. The race is dedicated to the memory of Šárka Krčková and offers runners a pleasant route with a natural character. The event is suitable for all runners who want to combine sport with supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: 7 km mainly off-road route
Surroundings of the village of Slatinice near Olomouc
Charity run in memory of Šárka Krčková
additional: The run is part of charitable activities supporting oncology care, and the event is associated with fundraising and support for local sports.

name: Vnorovská desítka
location: Vnorov, Vnorovy, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: platba přes bankovní účet, ceny nejsou explicitně uvedeny
description: Vnorovská desítka is a popular 10 km running race held annually in August in the village of Vnorovy. The race is part of the Moravian-Slovak Running Cup and attracts over 200 runners from various countries, including Czech elites and African runners. The course runs on a closed asphalt circuit with minimal elevation gain, with start and finish at the elementary school. The race atmosphere is very lively due to a large audience and numerous participants, with nearly 700 runners competing in all categories.
course_highlights: Course 4 x 2.5 km on asphalt road with minimal elevation gain
Closed circuit with traffic exclusion
Start and finish at the elementary school in Vnorovy
additional: Registration is open online until August 6th; same-day registration is not possible. The main race is timed with AMB chip technology. Women and men over 70 years run a shorter course of 2 x 2.5 km. Results of the main race will be announced at the Ajax pub area in Lidéřovice. Starting numbers for participants starting at 17:00 are entered into a raffle for running prizes. The race is 4 x 2.5 km on a closed circuit, with online registration until August 6th, start at 17:00, start and finish at the elementary school, with an atmosphere of spectators and a raffle.

name: Dačického 12
location: GASK Kutná Hora, Kutná Hora, Czech Republic
description: Dačického 12 is a traditional cross-country running race in Kutná Hora, which is already in its 18th edition. The race offers courses of 12 km and 6.7 km, as well as children's races with shorter distances. The route runs through the picturesque Vrchlice and Bylanka valleys, passing by historical landmarks such as the Church of St. Barbara and the Sedlec Cathedral. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant sporting experience in the beautiful environment of Kutná Hora.
course_highlights: The route runs through the Vrchlice and Bylanka valleys
Passes between the Church of St. Barbara and Sedlec Cathedral
Refreshment station at the Holy Trinity
additional: Children's races are divided into categories based on year of birth with distances ranging from 300 m to 1000 m. The start is at the Jesuit College / GASK on Barborská Street. The route includes running through the streets of Pod Hrádkem, Na Podskalí, around the Šafrán guesthouse and the Great Pond. After the race, participants can order custom plaques for clubs or events. The race includes the main 12 km course, 6 km course, children's races in four categories, online registration, start and finish at GASK Kutná Hora, and the event is complemented by music and support for the charity collection Světluška.

name: Černovírský kros
location: Černovír u Ústí nad Orlicí, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Černovírský kros is a traditional running race held in Černovír near Ústí nad Orlicí, offering courses in hilly terrain with a combination of paved and unpaved forest and field paths as well as asphalt. The race is part of the ISCAREX cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. Registration and start are at the Sokol hall in Černovír, with the main race covering a distance up to 5 km. The race atmosphere is friendly and it is popular among local and visiting runners.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with a combination of paved and unpaved forest and field paths
Mixed surface including asphalt
Course up to 5 km suitable for children and adults
additional: Registration on site from 9:00 AM. Children's race at 10:00 AM, main race at 11:30 AM. Entry fee 100 CZK for adults, 20 CZK for children. The race is part of the ISCAREX cup. The course is up to 5 km with diverse surfaces. The race offers various distances, from 0.08 km to the main 4.85 km, and is part of a sports series supporting running activities in the region.

name: Běh na Krušnou horu
location: Hudlice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Krušná Hora Run is a traditional uphill race held in the village of Hudlice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race starts at the end of Dolejší Street by the forest and leads along a wide forest gravel path to the Máminka lookout tower at the top of Krušná Hora. The course is 2.7 km long with an elevation gain of 190 meters, offering runners a challenging yet beautiful trail running experience in nature. The organizer is TOBI Sport s.r.o. and the race is part of the Czech Running Club.
course_highlights: Course length of 2.7 km
Running on a wide forest gravel path
Finish at the Máminka lookout tower at the top of Krušná Hora with a 190 m elevation gain
additional: The race start is near the village of Hudlice, 9 km from Beroun, at the forest crossroads. The race is organized by TOBI Sport s.r.o., contact person Pavel Kundrát. The course is certified and the race is part of the Czech Running Club. The race includes trail running in the forest, with registrations available on the KOPEC website. The race is suitable for runners of various levels.

name: Stezka mužů
location: Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Men's Trail is a 3 km road race that is part of the SABZO series and will take place on August 12, 2026, in Prague 4. This race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to spend active time in a friendly atmosphere. Although the main focus is on running, the event is part of a larger sports and social program in the region. Come race and enjoy a day full of movement and fun.
course_highlights: 3 km road course
part of the SABZO series
friendly atmosphere and suitable for the general public

name: 6. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park B. Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Run for Health is a charitable series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that anyone can run at their own pace. The proceeds from the entry fees are donated to help those in need, giving the event purpose and added value. Registration begins at 17:00 and the start is at 17:45 at Lodičky. Everyone is warmly invited to participate and support a good cause.
course_highlights: 3 km route in the beautiful environment of Božena Němcová Park
Surface: cycle path
Charitable run with proceeds supporting those in need
additional: Registration begins at 17:00, start at 17:45 at Lodičky. A series of seven runs, each 3 km long. The proceeds from the entry fees go to help those in need. Terrain: cycle path; Registration: registration from 17:00, start at 17:45; Series of seven runs from March to August 2026

name: Reuter Run Boršov nad Vltavou
location: Kemp Poslední štace, Boršov nad Vltavou, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Reuter Run in Boršov nad Vltavou is a running race of 12.5 km, taking place on August 15, 2026, starting at 11:00 at Kemp Poslední štace. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and offers runners the opportunity to compete on an interesting course in the South Bohemian region. The organizer is Zdeněk Richtr, and the race is suitable for the general running public, including registered members of the cup and other runners. The surface of the course is not specified in detail, but the race is part of a series with a long-standing tradition and clear rules.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 12.5 km
Start at Kemp Poslední štace, Boršov nad Vltavou
Part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
additional: Registration for the South Bohemian Running Cup requires a membership fee of 250 CZK, which covers the entire season of the cup. Registration is possible via the website, and payment is made by bank transfer with the name and year of birth specified. When registering during the year, points from races up to 3 months retroactively are counted. The race includes trail and cross-country terrains, with start and finish at Kemp Poslední štace. On-site registration is available until 10:00. There is also a children's race of 800 meters as part of the event.

name: Běžecký mítink Bohuňovice
location: Bohuňovice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The running meet in Bohuňovice near Olomouc is a cross-country race offering a 12.2 km course for men and a 6.1 km course for women. The race is part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region and attracts runners who enjoy more challenging terrain. The meet is suitable for everyone who wants to test their strength in a natural environment with variable terrain. The event is a traditional gathering of the running community in the region.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain with variable surface
Course length of 12.2 km for men and 6.1 km for women
Part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: The race is part of a series of running events in the region, offers registration and rental of running equipment, and attracts runners from the wider area.

name: 7 pohoří Šumava
location: Železná Ruda, Šumava, Czech Republic
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races offer technical trails, epic views, and a unique atmosphere that will test the strength, willpower, and determination of every runner. Whether you are an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 Mountains challenges you to conquer all routes and become a legend. The Šumava race features routes passing over the peaks of Špičák and Pacíř, around glacial lakes and deep forests with elevation gains of up to 900 meters.
course_highlights: The route passes over the peaks of Špičák and Pacíř with views of the glacial lakes Černé and Čertovo
Mostly natural terrain with an elevation gain of 900 meters on the main 23.5 km track
Atmosphere and technical trails prepared by mountain rescue members
additional: The race has a time limit of 4 hours, after which the participant is marked as DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration tent. Recommended equipment includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Rescue app. The entry fee includes a professionally marked route, start number, chip timing, commemorative medal, refreshments on the route and at the finish, and access to facilities at the start and finish areas. The races include registration with chip timing, medals, refreshments, and the opportunity to participate in various routes in the beautiful Šumava environment.

name: Jablonská osmička
location: Jablonné nad Orlicí, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Jablonská osmička is a running race in Jablonné nad Orlicí, taking place on August 15, 2026. This fifth edition offers a main race of 8 km, children's races, and a fun beer relay for teams of four. After the race, the program continues with a Food Festival and Jabloffest featuring music and children's activities at the swimming pool area. The race is suitable for both athletes and hobby runners, and is accompanied by a rich raffle and gift bags for registered participants.
course_highlights: Road course 8 km long with slight elevation
Beer relay with 100 m sprint and consumption of beer or soft drink
Children's races divided into three age categories
additional: Registration for the main race is from 9:00 to 10:30, children's races start at 10:15, the main 8 km run begins at 11:00, and the beer relay at 12:15. T-shirts and gift bags are available only for registered participants until July 31, 2026. The race commentator is biathlete Vlastimil Vávra. After the race, there is a rich raffle and accompanying program including the Food Festival and Jabloffest. Registration is open until July 31, 2026. Start and finish are at the athletic oval. T-shirts are for registered participants, with a rich raffle and gift bags.

name: Křivinský kros
location: Křivice, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Křivinský cross-country is a running race held in Křivice, offering a main course of 7.5 km with an elevation gain of 275 meters and a children's course of 800 meters. The race mainly runs through forest roads and trails in hilly terrain, ensuring a challenging and interesting run. The start is gradually from 9:30 AM, first children, then juniors, and finally the main categories. The race is part of the Eastern Bohemia Grand Prix and is open to the general public with voluntary registration fee. After the race, results are announced and a short raffle for participants takes place.
course_highlights: Main course 7.5 km with 275 m elevation gain
90% of the route runs through forest roads and trails
Hilly terrain at Křivina
additional: Registrations are possible on-site before the race or in advance via email. The registration fee is voluntary. The start of all categories is approximately 150 meters from the registration site. The route is marked with red-white plastic ribbons and white arrows on trees or posts, or with white spray paint on the ground. After the race, results are announced around 11:30 AM followed by a raffle. Before the race, participants can join a group training and run through the main route. The race includes hilly terrain, forest roads, and trails, and is part of the Eastern Bohemia Grand Prix series.

name: Žebrácká pětadvacítka
location: Žebrák, Křivoklátsko, Czech Republic
description: The Beggar's 25K is a traditional August road race through the roads and forest paths of Křivoklátsko, held annually in Žebrák. It offers several distances including the main race of 25 km, a 10 km run, a 10 km walk, and a family run for children. The main race starts at 10:00 AM at the Elementary School in Žebrák, with the senior categories starting at 9:00 AM. The race is associated with the celebrations of the Vavřinecká pilgrimage and offers beautiful sporting experiences in the picturesque environment of Křivoklátsko.
course_highlights: Road and forest paths of Křivoklátsko
Two loops around the housing estate in Žebrák at the beginning of the race
Family run with attractions for children on a 1.1 km loop
additional: The family run with Točníček and Žebráček starts on race day at 9:30 AM in front of the Elementary School in Žebrák, with a length of 1.1 km, no age restrictions, with a reward for children at the finish. The main 25 km race starts at 10:00 AM, with senior categories starting at 9:00 AM. After the start of the main race, a non-competitive 10 km run and a 10 km walk with poles (Nordic walking) are also launched. Online registration with the option to order a T-shirt ends on July 20, 2025. On-site registration is available on race day from 7:30 to 9:15 AM at the Cultural Club. The race is suitable for all age groups, including children and families, with participation possible in any weather, with dogs, and barrier-free access.

name: MFB MarathOn LABE
location: Kolín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: MarathOn LABE is a traditional international running festival held in Kolín and Poděbrady, offering a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, and other running disciplines. The marathon course is a loop and runs on forest, paved, and asphalt roads with ČAS certification. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and features a rich program including children's races and entertainment for families. The organizer is the Kolínská 14 association, which has been promoting an active and healthy lifestyle in the region since 2011.
course_highlights: Marathon course is a loop with ČAS certification
Terrain: forest roads, paved roads, asphalt
Marathon start at Kmoch's Island in Kolín
additional: The marathon starts at 8:00 AM on Kmoch's Island in Kolín, the half marathon and 10 km races start at 9:00 AM (half marathon from Poděbrady, 10 km from Kolín). There is an option to camp overnight for free in a tent at the amphitheater. Bus transportation from Kolín to the half marathon start in Poděbrady is arranged with reservation. Registration and bib pickup are on Saturday and Sunday morning. Parking and changing rooms are available in Kolín. The event takes place on August 16, 2026, offering various race categories, a festival atmosphere, and online registration.

name: Tyršův běh na Sokol
location: Malá Skála, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Tyršův běh na Sokol is a traditional forest run in Malá Skála, offering a challenging course of 2 km with an elevation gain of 300 meters. The run is intended for outdoor running enthusiasts who do not mind hills and technical terrain full of roots, holes, and stones. Races start at one-minute intervals, and the event has a long-standing tradition, with the 36th edition held in 2021. All interested in this type of run are warmly welcome.
course_highlights: Forest course with technical terrain full of roots, holes, and stones
Length of 2 km with an elevation gain of 300 m
Start at one-minute intervals
additional: The course includes forest and gravel paths, stairs, and only the first 100 meters are asphalt. Registration and further information are available on the event's website or Facebook page.

name: Žvahov - Ivův běh
location: Děvín, Praha 5, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Žvahov - Ivův běh is a cross-country race 3.7 km long, held in the Děvín area in Prague 5. The race is part of the SABZO series and offers runners the opportunity to enjoy running in a natural environment with gentle hills and interesting views. This race is suitable for everyone who enjoys short but more challenging terrain courses. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test your strength against other runners in the beautiful Děvín Hills.
course_highlights: Cross-country course 3.7 km long
Natural environment of the Děvín Hills
Part of the SABZO series
additional: The race starts on the road below the TJ Zlíchov football pitch; the race is also suitable for beginners and families with children.

name: ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival
location: Lipno nad Vltavou, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 200-400 Kč (dle věkové kategorie a místa registrace)

price_tiers.distance: Cyklozávod ČEZ Kolem Lipna (60 km a 20 km)

description: The CEZ Lipno Sport Festival is a traditional sporting event in Lipno nad Vltavou, offering a wide range of races for all age groups and sports enthusiasts. The festival includes running races such as the Lipno Half Marathon, 10 km COOP RUN, and a family run, as well as cycling races including 60 km and 20 km gravel and MTB routes. The event is complemented by children's races and evening runs along the scenic cycle path Čertovy proudy. Participants can enjoy the beautiful nature of Šumava and a rich accompanying program with cultural activities.
course_highlights: Running routes along the Čertovy proudy cycle path
Cycling races on the peaceful side of Lipno with 60 km and 20 km routes
Children's off-road cycling races on a cyclocross track in six categories
additional: Children's runs of 400 m and 800 m start at 9:00 and 9:20 from the lower station of the cable cars above the Stodola restaurant. The start and finish of the main running races are in the CEZ Lipno Sport Festival area and at the lower station of the cable cars. Registration for children's races is also possible on the race day. The race kit can be picked up in advance from August 17 at the festival's Active point. The race office opens on race day at 7:30. The races include cycling routes, running tracks, cultural program, sports activities, and registration probably on the website. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a diverse program for families and sports enthusiasts.

name: Běh okolo Olympie
location: Olympie, Chrlice, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je 150 Kč. Platba startovného probíhá před závodem při registraci závodníků.

description: The Olympie Run is a running race in Brno, taking place on August 20, 2026, in the Chrlice area. The race features a 5.3 km loop, which is run by both men and women in a single category, starting together. There is a separate race for children with a loop length determined before the start. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments and the possibility of storing belongings directly at the race site.
course_highlights: 5.3 km loop in the Chrlice area
Joint start for men and women
Children's race with loop length determined before the start
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 17:15. The children's race starts at 17:45, and the main race at 18:00. After finishing, water and a storage tent are available. Recommended transportation: bus line 78, stop Zámecká, limited parking on the street near the race or at the Decathlon parking lot. Terrain: urban, registration on-site or online, timing with MYLAPS chip technology, availability of public transport and parking, refreshments after the race, baggage storage, start and finish near Olympie in Brno.

name: Šárecká 5
location: Divoká Šárka, Praha 6, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Šárecká 5 is a cross-country race of 5.3 km held in the picturesque natural area of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. This varied race offers runners the opportunity to enjoy running in one of the most beautiful parts of Prague with more challenging terrain. Organized by SABZO Prague under the leadership of Michal Procházka, it is part of the running activities of the Czech Athletic Federation. The race is suitable for all who enjoy trail running and natural scenery.
course_highlights: Distance of 5.3 km on varied terrain
Cross-country/trail race character
Picturesque natural area of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6
additional: The organizer is SABZO Prague, contact person Michal Procházka (tel. 724 845 241). The race is part of the services of the Czech Athletic Federation for runners and running. The race takes place in the late afternoon, with the first category starting at 18:00. It is held in the beautiful environment of the Divoká Šárka nature reserve, registration is possible online, and the course is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Morava Run - proti proudu
location: Pohansko, Břeclav, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné na VI. MORAVA RUN (2026) je stanoveno na 11.000,- Kč / A tým (7-9 členů)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné na VI. MORAVA RUN (2026) je stanoveno na 15.000,- Kč / B tým (10-12 členů)

description: Morava Run - Against the current is a relay running race across Moravia along the Morava River. It takes place in teams of 7 to 12 members. The approximately 280 km route is divided into 30 segments of about 9 km each, which teams divide according to their strength and strategy. The race starts in the south of Moravia in the CHKO Soutok and runs against the river's flow through Slovácko, Haná, CHKO Litovelské Pomoraví, up to the source of the Morava River at Králický Sněžník. The event is aimed at amateur runners and emphasizes team cooperation and teambuilding, with no set pace limit.
course_highlights: The route runs against the flow of the Morava River from Břeclav to Dolní Morava
A total of 30 segments, each about 9 km long
Passes through CHKO Soutok, Slovácko, Haná, CHKO Litovelské Pomoraví, and Jeseníky
additional: The race starts in Břeclav at Pohansko Castle, and the finish is at the Dolní Morava camp, where camping is available until the next day. The race begins in waves, with no pace limit. Each team plans logistics and schedules their effort over 30 segments. The organizer provides an emergency line for unforeseen events and a WhatsApp group for team leaders. The race is designed for teams of 7-12 members, including logistics, support along the route, and camping facilities. It is intended for athletes and teambuilding groups, focusing on experiences and cooperation in nature.

name: Běh městem Strakonice
location: Letní kino, Strakonice, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
organizer: Město Strakonice, Okresní sdružení Česká unie sportu Strakonice
description: The 23rd Strakonice City Run is a traditional running race held on August 21st at the Summer Cinema in Strakonice. Participants of all ages can test their strength on routes of 3.3 km and 6.6 km, which run through the city. The start is shared for both routes and takes place at 6:00 PM. All participants have the chance to win in a generous raffle, which is drawn from start numbers. Applications can be sent via email or submitted on the day of the race.
course_highlights: Two city routes of 3.3 km and 6.6 km
Start and finish at the Summer Cinema premises
Shared start for all runners at 6:00 PM
additional: Applications can be sent by email until August 20th or submitted on race day no later than 60 minutes before the start. All start numbers will be entered into a raffle for a generous prize pool. The race offers an accompanying program with military equipment and is part of the city's traditional sports calendar.

name: Brdský půlmaraton
location: Kytín, Kladno District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Brdský Half Marathon is a traditional trail running race held in the picturesque environment of Kytín in the Central Bohemian Region. The race offers two routes - a more challenging 21 km with an elevation gain of 430 meters and a shorter 9 km with an elevation gain of 158 meters, both with refreshment stations. On the longer course, absolute winners and categories by age and gender are announced, while the shorter course recognizes the overall fastest men and women. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup series and is suitable for nature lovers with beautiful views and diverse terrain.
course_highlights: 21 km course with 430 m elevation gain
9 km course with 158 m elevation gain
Refreshment stations on the course with water and isotonic drinks
additional: On the 21 km course, refreshment stations are located at 3.7 km, 9 km, and 17 km with water and isotonic drinks. On the 9 km course, refreshments are available at 3.7 km and at the finish line, including water, isotonic drinks, and light snacks. Children's courses are free of charge. Categories by age and gender are announced for the 21 km course, and overall winners are recognized for the 9 km course. The race offers routes of 21 km and 9 km, suitable for trail runners and families with children, with registration available through the official website.

name: Hrabovský 1/2 a 1/4 maraton
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Czech Republic
description: The Hrabovský 1/2 and 1/4 Marathon is a traditional running race held in Ostrava-Hrabová, offering a half marathon and quarter marathon course. The race is part of the Hrabovský Cup and the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup, with participants receiving medals and having access to refreshments, changing rooms, and an accompanying program. The start and registration take place at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports field. The course runs through an urban environment with a pleasant atmosphere and is suitable for a wide range of runners.
course_highlights: Half marathon course 21.1 km
Quarter marathon course 10.5 km
Start and finish at TJ Sokol Hrabová sports field
additional: The starting number is refundable and contains a chip. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish line, along with changing rooms and toilets. An accompanying program is part of the event. Registration is possible online with payment by bank transfer within 5 days of registration. The registration and check-in location is at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports field, Paskovská 209, Ostrava. The event includes not only runs but also children's races, Nordic Walking, a raffle, and other fun activities. The event will take place on August 22, 2026.

name: Jesenický maraton
location: Jeseníky mountains, Czech Republic
description: The Jesenický Marathon is a legendary and challenging mountain marathon in the Czech Republic, held in the Jeseníky Mountains since 2009. The race offers the same course for both the marathon and half-marathon each year, which varies due to changing weather and mountain terrain. Runners traverse the ridges of forested mountains, passing springs, rainforests, stone seas, and peat bogs, creating a unique atmosphere and challenge. The Jesenický Marathon is intended for experienced endurance athletes who want to conquer the highest mountains of Moravia and Silesia.
course_highlights: Ridge of forested mountains with rounded crests
Springs of fresh water and deep valleys
Ancient rainforests, mountain tundra, and stone seas
additional: The race limit is 700 runners. The time limit for completing the marathon is 6 hours and 30 minutes. Refreshments are provided at several stations with water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and energy foods. At the finish line, there is an option to purchase hot meals and drinks. Runners with valid registration by June 30, 2026, will receive a T-shirt unless they choose otherwise. The organizer may cancel the race in case of adverse weather conditions without compensation. The course is mountain terrain with refreshments at two stations, free parking, free bus transportation from the start, a time limit, and an age limit of 18+.

name: Panevropský půlmaraton
location: Stadlern, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Pan-European Half Marathon is an international running race from Stadlern in Bavaria to Poběžovice. The course passes through scenic nature of the Bavarian-Czech border region, including the former 'Iron Curtain' and the low saddle of the Bohemian Forest near the source of the Radbuza River. The race is accompanied by a rich cultural program at the start and finish, with activities for children. The start is traditionally at 10:00 AM and the finish is at the Míru Square in Poběžovice. Organizers warmly invite athletes and spectators to support the runners.
course_highlights: International course from Germany to Czechia
Passes through the former Iron Curtain at the Schwarzava border crossing
Hilly profile with two ascents into the low saddles of the Bohemian Forest
additional: Refreshment stations on the course at 6, 9, 12, 15, and 18 km with water and isotonic drinks. After the race, hot food, drinks, fruit, muesli, and chocolate. Registration on race day possible on-site at the start (Stadlern) for 600 CZK in cash. Bus transportation to the start and back after the race. Winners announced and awards presented immediately after the race. Each participant receives a commemorative medal and a race-themed T-shirt. Buses depart from Poběžovice and Domažlice. The race takes place in August 2026. The course is mostly asphalt with varied terrain. Part of the Běžec Chodska series.

name: Běh na Svatý Hostýn
location: Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Svatý Hostýn Run is a mountain race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem in the Zlín Region. This event is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers a challenging race of 5 km with an elevation gain of 422 meters, most of the route being on asphalt. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and the general public, attracting running enthusiasts from across the country. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.
course_highlights: Length of the route 5 km with an elevation gain of 422 m
Mostly on asphalt with a challenging ascent
Part of the Czech Cup in uphill running
additional: Registration is also possible on-site, the race uses chip timing, and it takes place in August 2026.

name: Běh k Božímu hrobu
location: Svatý Hostýn, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to the Holy Tomb is a traditional running event held at Svatý Hostýn in the Zlín Region, which is part of broader pilgrimage and sporting activities at the site. This event offers a uphill run with the finish at the Holy Tomb, and is an important part of the regional sports calendar. Prepare for the atmosphere of a pilgrimage site and enjoy a sporting experience in the beautiful environment of Svatý Hostýn.
course_highlights: Uphill run at Svatý Hostýn
Part of the Czech Cup in uphill running
Pilgrimage and sporting atmosphere with participation options during pilgrimages
additional: The event includes a run to Svatý Hostýn and the Holy Tomb, part of pilgrimage activities, registration and results available on the website.

name: Běh na Čupek
location: Metylovice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Čupek Run is a newly introduced running race in Metylovice, which has already attracted two hundred runners. The course is beautiful and challenging, providing an interesting experience for participants. The race is part of the calendar of the Slezan Frýdek-Místek Physical Education Union, and its future in the schedule is being watched with anticipation.
course_highlights: Challenging course in Metylovice
Beautiful running environment
Race has already attracted two hundred runners
additional: Entry fee is 50 CZK for youth and 150 CZK for adults; the race takes place on a football field in Metylovice; facilities include changing rooms, showers, toilets, stadium amenities, a restaurant, and parking.

name: Vavřinecký běh Moravským krasem
location: Vavřinec, Moravský kras, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Vavřinec Run through Moravian Karst is a sporting event held in the village of Vavřinec in the South Moravian Region, which is part of the District Running League. The event takes place on August 22, 2026, and offers various running categories suitable for the general public. This event is an ideal opportunity for running enthusiasts who want to explore the beauty of Moravian Karst and enjoy a sporting experience in nature.
course_highlights: Held in the picturesque environment of Moravian Karst
Part of the District Running League
Various age categories and race lengths
additional: The race is suitable for all age groups, with participation available for a symbolic fee of 200 CZK for adults and 50 CZK for children. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the discovery of the natural beauty of the region.

name: Slopenská desítka
location: Slopné, Luhačovice, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: pro běžce ze Slopného na místě

description: Slopenská desítka is a traditional cross-country running race held in the picturesque village of Slopné near Luhačovice. The race offers a challenging course with a varied profile, including asphalt roads, steep climbs, and descents through forest terrain. The start is located under the church and the finish line is at the sports field, where spectators cheer enthusiastically. The event is suitable for the general public, including junior categories and family relays. The race is part of the year-round competitions Běhy Zlín and the Czech Cup in uphill running KRAKONOŠ.
course_highlights: Start on an asphalt road under the church with ample space for runners
Long ascent of 1500 m on asphalt and steep climb through the forest up to 2.5 km
Last three kilometers are downhill only, with a flat finish at the sports field
additional: The family relay consists of three members running in three sections, with members being relatives and a minimum age difference of 18 years between two members. Registration closes 5 minutes before the start of the category. The overall winner receives a monetary reward for each second under the set time. The main race starts approximately 100 m from the sports field on an asphalt road under the church. The race is part of the local sports calendar, offering family relays and prizes in various categories.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Stříbrná
location: Stříbrná, Krušné hory, Czech Republic
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Running in the Ore Mountains is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various destinations, including Stříbrná, where the main race is held over 6 to 9 km and an experiential route of 20 to 30 km. In addition to the main races, there are also children's races and walking routes with point finding according to a map. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicrossers, children, and walkers, and offers a beautiful natural environment of the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Main race 6 - 9 km in the nature of the Ore Mountains
Experiential route 20 - 30 km according to the map
Children's races from 200 m to 1,100 m
additional: The series includes 6 races in different locations of the Ore Mountains. In addition to running routes, there are also routes for walking with point finding according to a map and children's races. The organizer is Živé Sokolovsko z.s. in cooperation with Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s. The races include various categories including dog trekking and walking, the routes are not marked, with control stations on the route, no overtaking allowed, the series includes multiple locations and races in the Ore Mountains.

name: Běh pro Střížák
location: Střížovický vrch, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Run for Střížák is a traditional race held on Střížovický Hill in Ústí nad Labem, now in its 16th edition. The course consists of a loop run three times, with one significant ascent and descent, otherwise it is gently undulating. The race also includes shorter children's and pupils' runs, allowing broad public participation. The race has an interesting story because the course passes through an area that was previously threatened by planned construction, which was canceled due to residents' opposition.
course_highlights: Loop run three times
One noticeable ascent (220 m, elevation gain 25 m)
Gently undulating terrain with one descent of about 20 m over a 400 m segment
additional: Shorter children's (700 m) and pupils' (2.7 km) runs are available. The course passes through an area that was previously threatened by planned construction of a cooled hall for year-round downhill skiing, which was canceled due to residents' opposition. The race includes a raffle, refreshments, and is part of the local cross-country cup, with participation options for children and youth.

name: Běh Smetánkou
location: Praha 9, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Smetánka Run is a cross-country race 3.5 km long, held in Prague 9 and part of the SABZO series. This race offers runners the opportunity to enjoy running in a natural environment with diverse terrain. It is suitable for everyone looking for a short but dynamic race in a pleasant atmosphere. The race is a traditional part of the running season in Prague and attracts runners from the wider area.
course_highlights: Cross-country course 3.5 km long
Part of the SABZO series
Natural environment in Prague 9
additional: The race is intended for runners of all levels, registration and exact details are not explicitly provided.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (9) – srpnový
location: Praha 4-Braník, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The 5 km and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGA is a regular running series in Prague Braník, offering a pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River. The races are suitable for runners of all levels from beginners to professionals and personal bests are often achieved here. The course is certified and for the 10 km race, it is possible to meet the limit for the Czech Championships. After the race, there is an opportunity for socializing and refueling at the local restaurant. The series is part of the 16th edition and rewards not only the best runners but also loyal participants.
course_highlights: Pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník
Course measured with a certified measuring device
Opportunity to meet the limit for the Czech Championships at 10 km
additional: Registration from 18:00, 10 km start at 19:00, 5 km start at 19:05. Post-race refreshments (food, beer, isotonic drink) at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage in the organizer's tent. WC facilities at Hamr Braník. Cancellation possible up to 24 hours before the start with a refund of the entry fee. Recommended public transport and P+R parking at Nádraží Braník. Prizes for the best and loyal runners, raffle after the race. Registration includes options for early registration with possible discounts. The races are open to all levels of runners, from beginners to professional competitors.

name: Běh Modřanskou roklí - Memoriál Zdeňka Buriana
location: Modřanská rokle, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Modřanská Gorge Run - Zdeněk Burian Memorial is a 4 km race run along a gently undulating course in the Modřanská Gorge Nature Reserve in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series and features an interval start, allowing for a smooth race flow. The course is suitable for runners who want to enjoy running in nature with slight elevation changes. It is ideal for those seeking a short but technically interesting run in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: 4 km course in the Modřanská Gorge Nature Reserve
Gently undulating terrain with natural features
Interval start for a smooth race flow
additional: The race has an interval start. It is part of the SABZO series. The course is gently undulating and runs through the Modřanská Gorge Nature Reserve in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series, which supports the running community in Prague. Exact information about registration and entry fee has not yet been published.

name: Beskydská sedmička
location: Třinec, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: IMOS Beskydská sedmička is an extreme mountain marathon across the entire Beskydy Mountains, running from Třinec to Frenštát pod Radhoštěm. This demanding race, approximately 101 km long with an elevation gain of 5500 meters+, is the Czech Republic Championship in mountain marathon for individuals and pairs. The race starts at night at 23:00 from the athletics stadium in Třinec, and the finish line closes after 28 hours on Sunday morning. The race offers a unique experience of the Beskydy mountain nature and quality refreshment stations along the route.
course_highlights: Route approximately 101 km long with an elevation gain of 5500 meters+ across the main massif of Beskydy
Start in Třinec at 23:00, finish in Frenštát pod Radhoštěm with a 28-hour time limit
Refreshment stations along the route in locations such as Ostravice, Pustevny, Morávka, and others
additional: Accreditation takes place on Friday, August 28, 2026, from 13:00 to 22:00 at the STARS sports hall in Třinec. Free shuttle transport is provided for competitors from Frenštát pod Radhoštěm to the start in Třinec. At the refreshment stations, soup and sausages are available, with soup only at designated stations. Participants can use baggage storage marked with their start number. The athletics stadium grandstands will be open for companions and fans, making the start a great experience for them as well. The race includes refreshment stations, route changes compared to previous years, the option to download a GPX file, a 28-hour finish limit, start at 23:00, and finish at 3:00 the following day.

name: Kácovský běh
location: Náměstí kněžny Toskánské, Kácov, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kácov Run is a traditional running race held on the last Saturday of August in the picturesque Posázaví region. It offers three main routes - Nineteen, Ten, and Loop - with varied terrain and elevation gain, challenging both experienced runners and beginners. The start and finish are located in the center of Kácov, with refreshment stations on the longer routes. The race is timed with chip timing and accompanied by a rich program including children's races and a raffle.
course_highlights: Nineteen: 18.8 km with an elevation gain of 380 m, mixed surfaces including forest paths and asphalt
Ten: 10.4 km with an elevation gain of 160 m, similarly varied terrain as Nineteen
Loop: 2.9 km with an elevation gain of 20 m, suitable for children and beginners
additional: The race is timed with chip timing with instructions for proper chip placement. Refreshment stations are available on the Nineteen and Ten routes both on the course and at the finish. For permanent residents of Kácov, a bonus competition for the fastest local runner is prepared. Children's races have voluntary entry fees and are divided by age. The race includes various categories, with surfaces combining road and trail. Registration is possible online and on-site, and the event is supported by local tourism.

name: Cross Parkmaraton
location: Krásná Lípa, Česká Švýcarsko, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Cross Parkmarathon in Krásná Lípa is a traditional race set in the picturesque environment of the Czech Switzerland National Park. It takes place on hilly terrain mainly along forest paths with beautiful views of the Lusatian Mountains. The event offers various disciplines including marathon, half marathon, shorter runs, Nordic walking, canicross, and relay races. The event is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages. In 2019, it received the Czech-Saxon Switzerland Regional Product certificate as a certified experience.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain mainly along forest paths
Picturesque landscape of the Czech Switzerland National Park
Views of the Lusatian Mountains
additional: Start times: Canicross and marathon at 8:00 AM, other races at 10:00 AM. Relays are teams of 4 members, each runner runs approximately 5 km. Each team arranges transportation for relay handovers themselves. Categories are announced based on age and gender. The time limit for completing the marathon is until 3:00 PM. Participants who do not finish within the marathon limit can switch to the half marathon. The registration fee includes a start number. The race is part of the Czech Switzerland Day, attracting regional and international runners, with refreshment stations along the route and support from local sponsors and artisans.

description: The Chomutov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque city of Chomutov in the Ústí Region. The race offers a fast and attractive route through the historic city center, around the unique Kamencové Lake, and through beautiful natural areas such as Bezručovo Valley. The event also includes children's categories and relays, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. Participants in the main race can look forward to refreshments on the course and at the finish line, as well as a finisher medal.
course_highlights: Historic city center with the Town Tower and diverse architecture
World-unique Kamencové Lake and extensive recreational area
Romantic Bezručovo Valley with the Chomutovka River
additional: Registration for adults and the Kamencové Circuit is conducted online from 8:00 to 10:30 AM, children up to 15 years old can register on-site from 11:00 AM to 1:30 PM. The registration fee includes refreshments on the course and at the finish line (fruit, water, isotonic drink) and a finisher medal. When registering online and paying in advance, participants receive free headbands and have the option to purchase T-shirts with headbands. The children's race starts at 2:00 PM. The organizer reserves the right to change the schedule of individual runs. The terrain is a trail course, with online and on-site registration, refreshments at the finish and on the course, medals, T-shirts, and headbands available free of charge with registration.

name: Běhej lesy Jizerská
location: Bedřichov, Jizerské hory, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Forests Jizerská is a trail race held on August 29, 2026, in the picturesque environment of the Jizerské Mountains in Bedřichov. It offers various routes including short, long, and ultramarathon distances, which pass through beautiful natural locations such as Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka, and Olivetská hora. The race is part of the Run Forests series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, ensuring international point scoring. For competitors, there are also the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which bring additional competitive elements and rewards.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka, and Olivetská hora
Conti Speed Section - a 150-meter speed segment on the Nova 11 km and ČSOB 23 km routes
Generali Investments Finish - a 500m straight finish with measured segment and rewards for the fastest men and women
additional: The race is part of the UTMB Index Races with international point scoring. The Conti Speed Section is a speed segment with a prize worth 5000 CZK. The Generali Investments Finish is a 500m measured straight finish with special jerseys for winners. There is an option for online and on-site registration and change of entry fee. The race includes a charitable component, offers fast and scenic routes in the Jizerské Mountains, and starts at the ski stadium in Bedřichov.

name: Mizuno Neon Run Praha
location: Bohnice, Praha 8, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Mizuno Neon Run Prague is a night running event full of glowing neon lights and colorful zones, offering a unique experience rather than a speed competition. The run takes place in Bohnice, and participants receive a starter pack with a neon light baton and a beautiful Unicorn medal at the finish line. The event is under the auspices of the mayor of Prague 6 and the proceeds from registrations are donated to non-profit organizations. After the race, there is an after-party with DJ René, which enhances the overall atmosphere of the evening.
course_highlights: Night run with neon lights and colorful zones
Start and finish in Prague 8 - Bohnice
Bright neon experience with a neon light baton in the starter pack
additional: The race is divided into waves for 5 km run and walk, including a charity 2 km Fénix Run. After the race, there is an after-party NEON NIGHT RUN with DJ René. Option to purchase the SUPER package for 300 CZK until 20.08.2026. The starter pack includes a neon light baton. Registration and check-in are from 17:00 to 20:00, with baggage storage open until 21:45. Neon batons, medals, evening festive atmosphere, online and on-site registration, support for charity projects FénixRun.

name: Proběhni si Zoo Ústí nad Labem
location: Zoo Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Run through Ústí nad Labem Zoo is a running event held in the premises of the zoo in Ústí nad Labem. The run offers a unique opportunity to combine sports activity with a visit to the zoo and observing animals in their natural environment. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes active leisure time in nature. We look forward to your participation and shared experiences in the beautiful zoo environment.
course_highlights: Run in the zoo premises with a view of the animals
The route passes through diverse terrain of the zoo with natural scenery
Opportunity to combine athletic performance with a family visit to the zoo
additional: The zoo is open 365 days a year, admission is charged according to standard zoo rates. Discounts are available for visitors with disabilities. The event is part of the zoo's event calendar, which may be updated throughout the year. The event is primarily aimed at supporting animal protection and conservation, with an emphasis on ecological education and community engagement.

name: Běh teplickými skalami
location: Teplicích nad Metují, Náchod District, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
price_range: Základní 200 Kč, zvýšené 300 Kč, dodatečné 400 Kč (La Sportiva Cross); 100 Kč, 150 Kč, 200 Kč (Bufo Cross)
description: The Teplice Rocks Run is a public trail race held annually on the last Sunday of August in Teplice nad Metují. The race has been a tradition since 1994 and is part of the sports program of the International Mountaineering Film Festival. The 9 km course runs along the Metuje River to the rock city, includes sandy sections and stairs, and returns along the same route. Since 2011, a children's race by age categories has also been part of the event. The start and finish are at the TJ Slavoj football field.
course_highlights: 9 km course along the Metuje River and Teplice rock city
Sandy sections and stairs on the sightseeing circuit
Start and finish at the TJ Slavoj football field
additional: Online registration until August 26, 2026, at the basic entry fee; from August 27 to 29, 2026, at an increased fee; additional registration on race day at double the entry fee. The children's race starts by age categories on circuits. The race office is located at the start and finish area at the football field. The race is part of the Primátor Cup 2026 series. The 9 km trail is a terrain course with sandy sections and stairs, for various age categories, with online registration. The race takes place at the TJ Slavoj football field and is part of the Primátor Cup 2026 series.

name: Běh zámeckou zahradou
location: Zámecký park, Lysá nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: The castle garden run is a traditional running race held in the castle park in Lysá nad Labem. This 62nd edition takes place on August 30, 2025, and is intended for a wide range of participants from preschoolers to seniors. The race offers a pleasant environment of the historic park and promotes sports activity for all age groups. The organizer is T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem, which has long supported sports for everyone.
course_highlights: Lysá nad Labem castle park
Course suitable for all age groups
Pleasant environment of the historic garden
additional: The race is part of a long-standing Sokol tradition and is open to the general public, including children and seniors. The organizer is T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem. Information about the race is available on the Sokol website in the events section. The race takes place in the castle park, is part of a long tradition, and offers various categories for all age groups.

name: Běh Bezděkovem
location: Bezděkov pod Třemšínem, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Bezděkov Cross Country Race is a traditional trail running event approximately 9 km long, held in the picturesque surroundings of Bezděkov under Třemšín. The course mainly follows forest paths through varied terrain with gentle elevation changes, offering a combination of asphalt and rocky sections. The race starts at the hunting lodge and includes a challenging uphill section with up to 7% incline, testing runners' performance. After this demanding segment, there is a final downhill and flat finish, allowing runners to showcase their pace. The event also features children's races, making it attractive to a wide audience.
course_highlights: 90% forest trail in varied terrain, 10% asphalt
Loop run clockwise with gentle descents and ascents
360-meter uphill section with up to 7% incline as a performance test
additional: Children's races are part of the event. Start and finish at the hunting lodge in Bezděkov under Třemšín. The course is mainly through forest paths with varied terrain. Results are available in PDF format from the organizers. The race length is approximately 9 km, with options for children's races, registration in advance or on-site, and the event takes place in the Brdy nature area with various categories and distances.

name: Kolínská desítka
location: Sportovní stadion Mirka Tučka, Kolín, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Kolínská desítka is a turnaround race over 10 km, running on asphalt and a modified forest trail around the Mirka Tučka sports stadium in Kolín. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Kolín and offers runners a pleasant combination of an asphalt surface and natural environment. This race is suitable for all runners looking for a fast and scenic run in nature. Come enjoy the race atmosphere and test your strength against other runners in the beautiful surroundings of Kolín.
course_highlights: A 10 km course with a turnaround character
Surface combining asphalt and modified forest trails
Start and finish at the Mirka Tučka sports stadium in Kolín
additional: The course is slightly hilly with an edge around Veltruby, registration is conducted online, the race is suitable for the general running public

name: Rakovnická 15
location: Rakovník, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Rakovnická Patnáctka is a road race of 15 km, which alternates annually between starting in Rakovník and Křivoklát. The race is part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Running Cup and offers runners the opportunity to compete on an attractive course in the beautiful environment of the Central Bohemian Region. This race is suitable for all runners seeking a quality road run with tradition and the atmosphere of a regional running cup.
course_highlights: Road course 15 km long
Start alternates annually between Rakovník and Křivoklát
Part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Running Cup
additional: The race takes place in 2026, with the start planned for August 30 in Křivoklát. The course includes ascents and descents and is part of the regional running cup.

name: Sázava - Lázek
location: Sázava u Lanškrouna, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Sázava-Lázek is a hill running race with a length of 7.9 km and an elevation gain of 375 meters. The course starts on asphalt and continues through field and forest paths, with the steepest climb at the end. This race offers a challenging and varied terrain for runners seeking a challenge in the natural environment of the Pardubice region.
course_highlights: Length of the course 7.9 km with an elevation gain of 375 m
The route goes on asphalt, field, and forest paths
The steepest climb is in the final part of the race
additional: Registration is possible on-site until 9:00 AM, the race starts at 9:30 AM, the race is intended for runners of all levels, the course offers technical challenges and beautiful natural scenery.

name: Běh okolo Hříšné Milady
location: okolí České Lípy, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hříšná Milady Run is a cross-country race around Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region, offering two courses of 12 km and 6 km. The route mainly follows forest roads and hiking trails that are open to regular traffic. The race is part of the District Running League and is suitable for trail running enthusiasts seeking natural and technically interesting terrain. The main category starts traditionally at 11:45 AM, allowing comfortable participation for a wide range of runners.
course_highlights: The route mainly follows forest roads and hiking trails
Cross-country/trail race character
Surroundings of Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region
additional: The race is part of the District Running League (www.oblcl.cz). The organizer is Pavel Souhrada, contact: 736 138 052. The race offers courses for children and adults, with various loop lengths, and takes place around Česká Lípa at a water reservoir. Registration and further details are not specified.

name: 3 x 1 km
location: Atletický stadion v Novém Jičíně, Kopřivnice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Atletika Nový Jičín, SVČ Fokus Nový Jičín
description: Athletics Nový Jičín and SVČ Fokus Nový Jičín organize a running race of 3 x 1.5 km, which will take place at the athletics stadium in Nový Jičín. The race is part of the Novojičín Running League and takes place on a varied surface including terrain, asphalt, and tartan. The race is intended for adult runners divided into age categories based on year of birth. Registration is conducted online and the start is scheduled for 17:00. The race offers an opportunity for sports activity and competition in a friendly atmosphere at the athletic complex.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the athletics stadium, in the Bocheta complex, and on the asphalt surface of the former gardens of the Nový Jičín Gymnasium
The course surface includes terrain, asphalt, and tartan
The race distance is 3 x 1.5 km
additional: Registration for adults is online with the schedule: 16:00 - 16:45 registration, 17:00 start, followed by results announcement. Categories are divided by age and gender, from men and women born in 1987 and earlier to older age groups. The race will be held on September 2, 2026, registration is online, the event is open to the general public, including children and adults.

name: Běh Anny-Marie
location: Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Anna-Marie Run is a race held in Prague 4, offering a 6.6 km course through mixed terrain across Milíčov Forest and an artificial hill. The event is organized by SABZO Prague and is part of their series of runs, attracting runners of all levels. The course includes forest paths as well as asphalt sections, making the race attractive to various types of runners. The race takes place on September 2, 2026, and provides a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and the sporting atmosphere in Prague.
course_highlights: 6.6 km course through Milíčov Forest
Mixed terrain including forest paths and asphalt sections
Organized by SABZO Prague
additional: The race is part of the SABZO series and is designed for runners of all levels, offering an opportunity to enjoy nature in Prague 4.

name: SOKOLOVSKÁ 12/24 RUN
location: Koupaliště Michal, Sokolov, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
price_range: plné startovné, sleva do 15.6.2026 (-50%), do 31.7.2026 (-20%), na místě +200 Kč
description: Sokolovská 12/24 RUN is an endurance running race lasting 6, 12, or 24 hours, intended for individuals, pairs, and teams of four. The race takes place on an easy undulating loop around the Michal Natural Swimming Pool in Sokolov. The start is on Saturday, September 5, 2026, at 11:15 AM, and the race offers accommodation in a campsite with full facilities. The event is suitable for a wide range of sports enthusiasts and offers various age and team categories with the possibility of relay exchanges at the relay area near the buffet.
course_highlights: Easy undulating loop around Michal Natural Swimming Pool
Participation in categories for individuals, pairs, and teams of four
Facilities with a buffet and relay exchange options
additional: Registration takes place on September 4, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM and on September 5, 2026, from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Results are announced on Sunday, September 6, 2026, at 9:00 AM for the 6H and 12H categories, and at 12:30 PM for the 24H category. The registration fee includes accommodation in the campsite (own tents, caravans, shelters) and participation porcelain or medals. There are toilets, showers, electrical power, and catering options available in the campsite. The race is part of a larger multisport weekend that also includes MTB races and kick scooter events. Registration occurs on September 4, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM and on September 5, 2026, from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM.

name: Běh kolem Světa
location: Třeboň, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around the World is a traditional running event held in Třeboň, which takes place around the Svět Pond. Since its inception in 2012, the race has gained loyal supporters and offers an attractive route of 11.7 km, following the Educational Trail around the World. The event is regularly held in September and is popular for its natural scenery and diverse surface, including dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden bridges, and sections of asphalt. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners and offers the possibility to purchase an entry fee in the form of a Christmas voucher.
course_highlights: The route runs around Svět Pond with beautiful nature
The length of the course is 11.7 km, suitable for recreational and competitive runners
Surface includes dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden bridges, and sections of asphalt
additional: The course is 11.7 km long, held in September, electronic chip timing, possibility to purchase a voucher for the entry fee

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - září
location: Průmyslová zóna Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín in Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of nearly two laps on a precisely measured asphalt track. The race also features a children's course of 800 meters. Each participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their performance at the finish line. The race takes place every first Saturday of the month with registration before the start and timing for all runners.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt track of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
Children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women from 13 to 127 years old and children up to 12 years old, with age categories valid throughout the calendar year. The top three places in the men's, women's, and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended access to the start is by bike, on foot, by car, roller skates, or trolleybus no. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). Regular monthly registration is on the first Saturday of each month from 8:15 to 8:55, with the start at 9:00. The 800-meter children's course is part of the event. Location: Příluky Industrial Zone, Zlín, start in front of Madal Bal.

name: Kosiřské žiganec
location: Drahanovice, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic

description: Kosiřské žiganec is a traditional running race held in Drahanovice on Velký Kosíř, which is part of the Great Prize of endurance runners of the Olomouc Region. The race offers courses of 10 km and 5 km running through fields and forest paths with mild to moderate elevation gain. There are shorter runs for children of 400 and 1500 meters. The event is open to the general public and, besides the sporting experience, offers refreshments and entertainment after the race. The start and registration take place at the football field, with results announcement and prizes for the best runners in individual categories.
course_highlights: The 10 km route runs through fields and forest paths with an elevation gain of 180 meters
The 5 km route also runs through fields and forest paths with an elevation gain of 50 meters
Children's races of 400 and 1500 meters with the route specified on site
additional: Registration for the main race is only possible via www.liga100.cz, children's categories register on site. The capacity for the 10 km race is limited to 150 participants. The race is accompanied by medical services and each participant runs at their own risk. Refreshments and entertainment are provided after the race. Special prizes are awarded for the best runners in categories as well as for the fastest medical personnel and local residents. Registration takes place on site, races are open to all age groups, race day includes registration, start times, and winners announcement.
