description: Vorkloster Run is a stage race held in the picturesque environment of the foothills of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands and in the atmosphere of the medieval Porta Coeli Monastery. The race offers three stages of varying length and profile, from a fast flat stage to more challenging hilly sections. It is organized by the experienced team DálRunDál in cooperation with the Porta Coeli Monastery Brewery, which contributes to an authentic experience. The routes are carefully marked and mostly run off-road, with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape and historical monuments.
course_highlights: 1st stage: 5 km, a fast flat course on quality asphalt and cycle paths along the Svratka River with views of Květnice Hill
2nd stage: 11.4 km, a hilly course on paved forest and field roads with panoramic views of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands foothills
3rd stage: 14.7 km, a moderately demanding course with one hill and a flat finish, passing under unique railway viaducts
additional: The start of the 1st stage is at 10:00 on Saturday. The route is mainly run off-road, on cycle paths and quality asphalt. Bus transportation is available approximately 10 minutes before the start from the parking lot near the start. Accommodation is possible at the Porta Coeli Monastery premises in Předklášteří near Tišnov. The routes are carefully marked with arrows and flags. Starting numbers must not be torn on the bridge over the Svratka River, where the intermediate time is measured. The race includes multiple stages of different lengths and terrains, including team relay options. The event takes place in the beautiful environment of the historic monastery and surrounding nature, with various start times and routes.

name: Podhostýnská 10
location: Zámecký park, Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Podhostýnská 10k is a running race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem, offering courses of 10 and 5 kilometers, including children's races. The event takes place in the castle park and is part of the Zlín Running Series. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all ages who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a beautiful environment. Organizers emphasize tradition and high-quality organization of the race.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the castle park area in Bystřice pod Hostýnem
Two main routes: 10 km and 5 km
Includes children's races
additional: Registration of participants takes place at the castle in the stables area. The race is part of the year-round Zlín Running Series, which includes 13 races from 5 km to half marathon. Organizers emphasize ecology and environmental friendliness. The races are held in the castle park in Bystřice pod Hostýnem, registration is possible online and on-site, the race course is mainly on roads and park paths, and the event also includes children's races and medals for participants.

name: Běh Plzeňské teplárenské kolem Boleveckých rybníků
location: Bolevecké rybníky, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Plzeňská teplárenská Run around Bolevecké Ponds is a traditional running event organized by Pro Sport Activities agency, offering routes for children and adults in the picturesque surroundings of Bolevecké Ponds in Plzeň. The race is part of the Youth Running Cup of the Plzeň Region and is suitable for the general public, including the youngest runners. The registration fee is free, and the first 300 registered participants will receive a voucher for refreshments. In addition to the races, there is an accompanying program for children and an autograph session with athletes.
course_highlights: Routes from 300 m for the youngest children up to 5.5 km with hills for adults
Scenic surroundings of Bolevecké Ponds with flat and hilly sections
Time measurement using chips and results service by APACHI s.r.o.
additional: The registration fee is free for all participants. The first 300 registered participants will receive a voucher for refreshments (a sausage with bread and mustard, 0.33 l beer or non-alcoholic drink). Chip rental, bibs, and pins are available, along with an original finisher medal. The accompanying program includes face painting, a bouncy castle, and an autograph session with athletes. Parking is available in the parking lots around Bolevecké Ponds; entry by car to the start and finish area is not permitted without permission. Routes range from 300 m to 5.5 km, registration is through APACHI company, race office is located at Ostende near Velký Rybník, parking is available around Bolevecké Ponds, and the program includes face painting and a bouncy castle.

name: Birell Večerní Běh na 10 km Praha
location: Praha 1, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Birell Evening Run in Prague 10 km is a traditional night run that offers a unique atmosphere of illuminated Prague streets. The race starts at dusk and allows runners to experience the city's beauty in an unconventional light. You can participate as an individual or in a team and enjoy the magical night atmosphere under the starry sky. This race is part of the RunCzech running series and attracts thousands of runners every year.
course_highlights: Night run through illuminated Prague streets
Start at dusk with a magical atmosphere
10 km course in the center of Prague
additional: The race is open to individuals and team runs (women, men, mixed teams). A mobile app from RunCzech provides all information about the race, accompanying program, and virtual package. The 2026 edition will be the 29th race with up to 8,500 participants. The race takes place on September 5, 2026, starting at 19:30, with a length of 10 km, team running options, refreshments along the route, medical support, online results, and diplomas.

name: adidas Běh pro ženy 5 km Praha
location: Praha 1, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Come run at the adidas Women’s Run 5 km in Prague, the largest race created specifically for women. The 5 km course is suitable even for runners without prior training, with a time limit of 50 minutes. Enjoy the unique atmosphere and support of thousands of women at this exclusive race without men on the track. Register with your friends and experience the joy of running and solidarity together.
course_highlights: 5 km course in the center of Prague
50-minute limit suitable for beginners
Exclusive race only for women
additional: The race is exclusively for women; men are not on the track. The start number can be picked up at the pre-race EXPO, with the option to authorize another person to collect it. A mobile app, RunCzech, provides information about the race and accompanying program. The race is suitable for beginners, with team participation options, registration via the website, and a virtual version of the event.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - září
location: Stromovka Park, Praha 7, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and skill levels, including children up to 12 years old running 1.6 km. The race is ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park environment. After the race, each participant is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake. The time is measured for everyone, and results are published online, counting towards the annual Pancake Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km), children run 1 lap (1 mile + 70 m)
Beautiful surroundings of Královská obora - Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of prior online registration for faster check-in. Recommended arrival by bike, on foot, rollerblades, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is available at the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are tents for changing clothes and storing belongings (unattended), a mobile valuables storage, and portable toilet cabins. Categories are divided by age and gender, time is measured for each runner, and results are published online. The race is on a road course, 3.2 km, run without bib numbers, voluntary registration, start at 9:07, registration from 8:15 to 8:45, parking at the bridge to Císařský Island, refreshments at the finish line, categories for adults and children, open to all age groups.

name: Barokomaraton
location: Plasy, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Barokomaraton is the 19th edition of a cross country run held in the picturesque environment of the town of Plasy and the valley of the Střela River. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and those who run for fun and want to enjoy the beautiful autumn nature. Participants can expect courses passing through forest and field paths with regular refreshment stations. The organizers also prepare a cultural program, entertainment for children, and refreshments, making the Barokomaraton a pleasant day full of sport and relaxation for the whole family.
course_highlights: Forest and field paths in the Střela River valley
Regular refreshment stations with water, isotonic drinks, and fruit
Start and finish at the Velká Louka area in Plasy
additional: Registration of competitors takes place at the Velká Louka area in Plasy on September 4th from 18:00 to 20:30 (ultra until 23:30) and on September 5th from 7:30 to 9:20. The time limit is 6 hours for the marathon and 16 hours for the ultra 100 km. Dogs are not allowed to run (canicross). It is recommended to use your own foldable cup at refreshment stations; a limited number of cups are available for purchase on site. There is an option for team relay for groups of three runners on the 10 km, half marathon, and marathon courses. The races include various distances, including ultra 100 km, and are suitable for runners of all levels. The event also offers cultural and accompanying activities, including an expo and entertainment for children.

name: Strážný nahoru a dolů
location: Dolní Dobrouč, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Strážný nahoru a dolů is part of the ISCAREX Cup, a traditional series of running races in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a challenging uphill and downhill run in the picturesque environment of Dolní Dobrouč. Organizers ensure a quality sporting atmosphere and facilities for all participants. The event is suitable for experienced runners and hobby athletes who want to try running in hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Uphill and downhill run in the terrain of Dolní Dobrouč
Technically interesting profile with elevation gain
Picturesque natural environment of the Pardubice Region
additional: The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2025 series, registration from 8:00, start at 10:00, the race takes place in nature on hilly terrain, finish station at the top of Strážný.

name: Lupenická dvanáctka
location: Lupenice, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Lupenická Twelve is a traditional running race in Lupenice, held for the 33rd time. The race offers a 12 km course with an elevation gain of 98 meters, entirely on asphalt and well marked. The start is at the Lupenice sports complex, and the race is part of the Great Prize of Eastern Bohemia. Each participant runs at their own risk, and those under 18 must provide parental consent.
course_highlights: 12 km course with an elevation gain of 98 m
100% asphalt surface
Marked route in the Lupenice sports complex
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 8:00 to 10:00 at a price of 250 CZK. The registration fee includes a start number, refreshments along the course and at the finish, and facilities at the start and finish area. The registration fee is non-refundable in case of absence. On-site registration is also possible, with the start at 10:30. The event is open to the general public, including families with children.

name: Jenštejnská pětka
location: Jenštejn, Jenštejn, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jenštejnská pětka is an annual 5 km running race held in the village of Jenštejn since 2014. In addition to the main race, other running categories are organized, allowing participation from a wide range of runners. The event is a traditional sports gathering in the Central Bohemian Region and offers an opportunity for sporting activity in the picturesque environment of Jenštejn.
course_highlights: Race over 5 km in the village of Jenštejn
Various running categories for all age groups
Traditional annual event since 2014
additional: The race takes place on September 5, 2026, and is part of the local sports calendar, offering different categories and being popular among locals and visitors.

name: Zbraslavská Závist
location: Nádraží v Praze-Zbraslavi, Praha-Zbraslav, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Zbraslavská Závist is a trail uphill run that starts in Prague-Zbraslav near the former mini zoo and leads to the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist. The course is 3.5 km long with an elevation gain of 190 meters, offering a challenging and interesting running experience. The race is suitable for athletes who are prepared for a brisk start and a demanding ascent. Organized by the KOPEC association, under the auspices of the Czech Athletic Federation, it is part of the traditional running calendar in Prague.
course_highlights: Trail uphill run with an elevation gain of 190 meters
Start near the former mini zoo in Prague-Zbraslav
Finish at the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist
additional: The race is recommended for athletes in good condition who can handle the demanding climb. The course begins flat, then starts ascending up to the lookout tower. The organizer is KOPEC, z.s., Petr Schovánek. The course length is 3.5 km with an elevation gain of 190 m, starting at the station in Prague-Zbraslav. The race offers beautiful views from the top of Hradiště Závist. Registration is possible online or on-site. The race is open to all age categories.

name: Běh s Klokanem
location: Olomouc-Hejčín, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Kangaroo Run is a traditional cross-country race in Olomouc-Hejčín, held annually at the end of September. The race is designed for children, youth, and adult athletes, and is part of the Olomouc Region Children's and Youth Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix. Men run 9 km, women 7 km, and shorter distances are available for children according to age categories. The event is not only sporting but also social, with accompanying activities for children and parents, including games, scooter rides, puzzles, and a raffle. Registration takes place at the U Travise Inn by the Mill Stream.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in terrain by the Mill Stream in Olomouc-Hejčín
Men run 9 km, women 7 km, children have courses from 60 m to 1.5 km depending on age
Part of the Olomouc Region Children's and Youth Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix
additional: Registration takes place at the U Travise Inn. The accompanying program includes scooter rides, sack jumping, puzzles, horse riding, a photo booth with a kangaroo, an educational trail about kangaroos, a performance by the band 3+1, and a raffle with valuable prizes. All children at the finish line receive sweets. Cross-country terrain, registration at the U Travise Inn, family event.

name: Ostrava City Marathon
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 600-1500 Kč podle druhu závodu a data registrace
description: The Ostrava City Marathon is the oldest marathon in the Czech Republic and a summer running festival full of fun for all runners. It takes place on September 6, 2026, in the center of Ostrava at Masaryk Square and offers courses for various performance levels including a mini-marathon, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon. The event is suitable for both competitive runners and hobbyists, and includes a charitable MiniMarathon. In addition to the races, a rich accompanying program is prepared to enliven the city center with sport and culture.
course_highlights: The course passes through historic, industrial, and green parts of Ostrava
Refreshment stations are located approximately every 5 km with water, isotonic drinks, and food
Start and finish are at Masaryk Square in the center of Ostrava
additional: Registration for competitors takes place on Saturday, September 5, 2026, from 14:00 to 19:00 and on Sunday, September 6, 2026, from 6:30 to 8:00 at the Ostrava University City Campus. The race time is measured with chip technology embedded in the non-refundable race bibs. Mobile toilets and baggage storage are available at Masaryk Square. Showers and changing rooms are available in the City Campus building. Refreshments are available approximately every 5 km and at the finish line. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square in the center of Ostrava. Men over 70 and women over 60 can register for free for the marathon after obtaining a registration code via email at info@ostravacitymarathon.cz. On-site registration is also possible. The event offers refreshments, showers, medals, and other equipment for participants.

name: Podčerchovský kros
location: Chodov u Domažlic, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Podčerchovský cross country is a demanding cross-country run held on Babí Hora near Chodov, which takes place on forest paths with several challenging ascents. The longest loop measures 2.5 km and is suitable for runners using spikes. The race is open to all age categories and offers various distances from children's categories to the main men's race. Results are announced shortly after the race, and winners receive medals, material prizes, and in the main category, monetary rewards.
course_highlights: The course runs on forest paths
The longest loop is 2.5 km with several demanding ascents
Option to use spikes
additional: Results for all categories are announced at 12:30. Categories have different distances: 1100 m (2x550 m), 4000 m (2x2000 m), 5000 m (2x2500 m), 7500 m (3x2500 m). Monetary rewards are paid in the main men's category and overall women's ranking according to the organizer's possibilities. The race offers pre-registration and on-site registration options, with over 100 runners participating, including children and youth, and is part of the Běžec Chodska series.

name: Běh na Lahti
location: Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: We invite you to the 47th edition of the traditional running race Lahti Run, which takes place on September 6, 2026, in Děčín. The race offers two courses - the main route nearly 10 km long with an elevation gain of 230 meters, leading over the Kvádberk lookout to the village of Ludvíkovice, and a shortened route of just under 5 km with an elevation gain of 130 meters. The trail runs through the terrain in the Děčín forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River, ensuring beautiful views and a challenging run. Registration and check-in are on-site at the start from 8:00 to 9:45 AM, with the race starting at 9:00.
course_highlights: Terrain trail in the Děčín forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River
Main course 9.8 km with a 230 m elevation gain, start at Kvádberk lookout
Shortened course 4.9 km with a 130 m elevation gain, turnaround at the cemetery in Ludvíkovice
additional: Registration and check-in on-site at the start (Kvádberk lookout) from 8:00 to 9:45. Children's races range from 100 to 1000 meters depending on the category. The main course is a loop with a turnaround after 5 km, the shortened course has a turnaround after 2.5 km. Online registration is available as well as on-site. Course maps and GPX files are available on the race website. The race takes place above the sandstone canyon and offers various distances suitable for the general public.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - září
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily with themselves. It also includes a trophy competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year. Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM, and winners are announced in each category.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.2 km) in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc
Race suitable for all age groups and running levels
Scenic environment near the fountain in the park, except for June and August races near the river
additional: Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The top three places are announced in each category. location: Rychnov nad Kněžnou, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

Each participant receives a start package and a medal, and the top runners in each category receive valuable prizes. The event also features an autograph session and a fun quiz for prizes, contributing to family comfort and community spirit.

Option to watch children during the race

This run, which revives the tradition of the original race, is intended for everyone who wants to support seriously ill patients and their families. Participants can run, walk, or make a symbolic contribution, with the entry fee being a donation that helps ensure home care for those who can no longer run. The event takes place in Písek and offers various routes including children's runs and family walks.

The race takes place around the Stone Bridge in Písek with safety measures and volunteer support

The program begins at 12:00, warm-up for children at 13:00. Children's runs start at 13:15, main runs from 14:00 to 15:30. Routes are marked with white arrows, there is a pacer and volunteers on the track. Parking, facilities, and refreshments are provided. After the race, results are announced and a raffle takes place. Terrain includes concrete, asphalt, cobblestones, bridges, and forest; T-shirts are available for purchase on-site; various age categories and distances are available.

The run is an opportunity for the general public to express support and solidarity with foster families. The organization has long-term involvement in professional counseling, education, and support for foster and adoptive families.

Family activities, face painting, and accompanying program

Part of the Czech Cup in uphill running

The race offers beautiful natural scenery, a friendly atmosphere, and the possibility of refreshments and baggage storage on site. Each participant receives a bib number, and the top three in each category earn diplomas.

Running through the Kačák Valley along the stream and the Berounka River

description: The Hanče and Vrba Memorial Run is a traditional mountain race held in the Krkonoše Mountains, starting at the White Bridge over the Elbe in Špindlerův Mlýn and ending at the Hanče and Vrba Memorial. The 9 km route with an elevation gain of 696 meters mainly runs on asphalt and terrain, offering beautiful views and unforgettable experiences. The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and is suitable for a wide range of runners in various age categories. After the race, there is an opportunity for refreshments and a raffle, as well as the use of public transportation back from the finish line.
course_highlights: 9 km route with an elevation gain of 696 m
65% asphalt, 35% terrain
Start at 715 m above sea level, finish at 1411 m above sea level
additional: Maximum number of participants is 100. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:30 in Špindlerův Mlýn. There are two refreshment stations along the route with water and isotonic drinks. After the race, there is a raffle and the possibility of refreshments at Vrbatova Bouda. No changing rooms or showers are provided. There is an option to transport light personal belongings from the start to the finish. Trail race with an elevation gain of 696 m, start at the White Bridge over the Elbe, finish at the Hanče and Vrba Memorial, online and on-site registration, part of the Czech Cup in uphill running.

description: Dětmarovická 10 is a traditional running race held in the village of Dětmarovice, offering a main race of 10 km, a relay of 2 x 5 km, and children's runs called Cipísek's Run. The course mainly runs on asphalt roads and forest trails, combining brisk sections with gentle challenges and allowing participants to enjoy the picturesque corners of the village. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiastic amateurs, with the joy of running and a sporting atmosphere being more important than performance. Short courses with a cheerful atmosphere and illustrations of Cipísek are prepared for children. Registration is conducted online with the possibility to register on-site, and runners receive a start number with a chip for timing and gift items from partners.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs on asphalt roads and forest gravel and dirt trails in the municipality of Dětmarovice
A combination of brisk sections and gentle challenges suitable for both experienced and amateur runners
Picturesque corners of Dětmarovice with a unique atmosphere
additional: Start and finish of the race are at the Dětmarovice Sports Hall. Participants will receive a start number with a chip for timing. Refreshment stations are located at the 6 km mark and at the finish line. Medical services are available at the finish. For the 2 x 5 km relay, transportation of runners between segments is provided. Children's runs are divided by age into 100 m, 200 m, and 400 m distances. On-site registration is possible but without guarantee of the same benefits as online registration. The race includes electronic registration, chip timing, medical security, refreshments, and a raffle. The course includes asphalt, forest, and gravel paths and is suitable for all levels of runners.

Each edition supports the charitable organization Centrum Bazalka, which receives a portion of the entry fees. After the race, there is a rich accompanying program including a raffle and prizes for the fastest runners.

Mostly asphalt cycle paths (60% asphalt, 40% gravel)
The route runs around Munický Pond, Hluboká, ZOO, and Bažantnice

The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup, the course is fast and flat, start is from 9:30 to 15:30, registration is open until September 13, 2026.

description: Vrchlabský City Half Marathon is the first edition of the half marathon held in the heart of the Krkonoše Mountains at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí. Participants will enjoy a sporting challenge on asphalt roads, field and forest paths, as well as a cultural program and a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main half marathon, shorter routes of 2 km and 9 km are available, suitable for children, juniors, and families with children, which lead through the city and its side streets. The event combines running, experiences, and community and is co-financed by the State Environmental Fund of the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt roads, field and forest paths
Start and finish at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí
Side streets of the city are part of the shorter routes for children and juniors
additional: The 2 km route starts at 13:00 with categories 7 - 9, 10 - 12, and 13 - 15 years. The half marathon (21.1 km) starts at 15:00 with categories 18 - 29, 30 - 39, 40 - 49, and 50+ years. Parking is available in the city center; some parking lots are paid, others free. The larger parking lot near the monastery is temporarily closed; it is recommended to use the parking lot at the cultural house, about a 10-minute walk from the square. The course includes asphalt roads, field, and forest paths; registration is possible via contact details on the website.

The race is suitable for the general public, including children and youth, who can participate for free. Participants can enjoy abundant refreshments, a finisher's medal, and race photos. Registration begins at 9:00 AM and the start is scheduled for 9:45 AM, with the race taking place in all weather conditions. The organizer emphasizes safety and the participants' health, who run at their own risk.
course_highlights: 14 km course through fields, forests, and gravel paths with light trail terrain
Pink ground arrows complemented by red and white ribbons for course marking
Rich refreshments at the finish line including drinks, fruit, and homemade buns
additional: Registration begins at 9:00 AM, on-site registration is possible no later than 30 minutes before the start, bib numbers are issued by the organizer 20 minutes before the start. Participants receive a finisher's medal and refreshments at the finish. Portable toilets provided by Johny servis are available. The start is in Záluží near Plzeň, best accessible by tram line 4. Each participant runs at their own risk and is not insured by the organizer. Registration takes place 30 minutes before the start, which is scheduled for 9:00 AM. The race is part of a series of trail events in the region and is suitable for the general public.

The race offers various courses from short children's categories to the main race, which is 8 km long and part of the ISCAREX Cup. The main race starts at 11:30 AM, with children's categories starting as early as 10:30 AM. The race is suitable for the general public and offers prizes for winners in individual categories. Applications can be submitted on-site on the day of the race from 8:00 to 9:45 AM.

Additional courses for children and youth from 200 m to 5 km
Race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026

The event is part of the cup series and offers various distances for different age groups and runner levels.

name: Kokořínský kros
location: Mšeně, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kokořínský cross is a trail run held in the picturesque nature of the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, near Prague. The race offers three main routes with distances of 15 km, 10 km, and 5 km, which lead through romantic gorges and around unique sandstone towers. The start and finish are located in the area of the municipal baths in Mšeno, where facilities including refreshments and a children's corner are provided. The race is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced, and offers a variety of categories with the possibility to change the route length even on race day.
course_highlights: Routes lead through scenic Kokořínsko with sandstone cliffs and ponds
Romantic gorges and unique sandstone towers, which are rare in the Czech Republic
Start and finish in the municipal baths area in Mšeno with swimming options
additional: Children's corner for kids aged 3 to 10 with art activities and supervision by an experienced teacher. Possibility to change the route length on race day during registration. Refreshments at the finish include Corny bars, bananas, water, and Ionilyte electrolyte drink. Parking is available at a designated lot approximately 200 meters from the race facilities. Entry of dogs is prohibited at the swimming area. Trail routes with registration options, gift vouchers, parking, and refreshments on site, as well as individual registration with personalized bib number.

The race takes place around the reservoir, golf course, and meanders of the Botič River, predominantly on forest paths with minimal asphalt. It starts without timing technology; the winner is the one who best estimates their time. The atmosphere is natural, brewery-themed, and suitable for all age groups, including children.

Family and natural atmosphere with brewery facilities

Forest surface, online registration until September 11, 2026, start at Hostivar Brewery, refreshments on the course and at the finish, accompanying program, raffle, family atmosphere.

name: 4Drun

description: 4Drun is a traditional running race organized by the Sports Club DDsport, z.s., held in the picturesque environment of Dubany near Prostějov. The race offers a 10.2 km course through the surroundings of Dubany, neighboring villages Hablov and Bystročice, and a newly built cycle path, combining asphalt and cross-country sections. The program also includes a 2x5 km relay race, a 4 km family run, and children's races, making the event suitable for all age groups. During race day, a rich accompanying program is prepared, and each participant will receive a commemorative medal.

Combination of asphalt and cross-country sections
Family run of 4 km suitable for participation with a stroller

The races are part of the 16th edition and are suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to professionals. The course is certified, and a 10 km run can meet the limit for the Czech Championships. After the race, there is an opportunity for socializing and refueling at the local restaurant, contributing to a relaxed running atmosphere.

Pleasant atmosphere and post-race refreshments

Registration is possible in advance. The event supports both regular and recreational runners.

This run brings together runners of all ages who want to express support and hope for those trying to change their behavior. The course is 5 km long and suitable for everyone who wants to support a good cause and enjoy outdoor activity. The organizer is Diakonie ČCE, a major provider of social services in the Czech Republic.

The event promotes therapeutic programs and violence prevention.

description: Li.t.r. is a weekend trail festival featuring a main race of 108 km with over 2000 meters of elevation change around Lipno. The run offers a unique opportunity to explore the unknown landscape of Lipno, its history, and stories during a challenging ultratrail. The race is open to both solo runners and teams, and is complemented by an accompanying program from Friday to Sunday. The atmosphere is community-oriented and friendly, organized by runners for runners with respect for nature and local culture.

The route is divided into 8 sections (8 - 14 km), all transfer points are easily accessible by car

The accompanying program runs from Friday to Sunday, including lectures, music, and group activities. The registration fee is non-refundable but transferable. Participants must be at least 18 years old, or 15+ with parental consent. Children under 6 years old only with accompaniment. A multi-segment trail race with an accompanying program, accommodation options, involvement of local gastronomy and history.

The event is suitable for all lovers of movement and nature and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments on the track and at the finish. The start and facilities are located at the back of Kačina Castle, where registration and results announcement also take place.
course_highlights: Routes lead around Kačina Castle and through the extensive castle park
70% gravel path, 30% forest path
Refreshments on the track and at the finish (bananas, orange, apple, water)
additional: Registration begins at 9:00 for children's races and at 12:30 for adult races in the back part of Kačina Castle grounds. Children immediately receive a participation medal after finishing. Parents can run with children in categories 2-3 and 4-5 years old. The race takes place in any weather; safety and fair play rules must be observed. A one-time start number with clips, which must be attached to the chest. Parking is available according to the parking map, with a warning not to park on the road shoulders. Course maps and videos are available on the website; the race takes place in the castle park of Kačina.

name: Leskros Mácháč
location: Doksy, Máchovo jezero, CHKO Kokořínsko, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Mácháč is a new event of the season with beautiful routes ideal for running and canicross in the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, near Lake Máchovo. The routes lead over soft sandy terrain sprinkled with pine needles, ensuring a pleasant running experience in a natural environment. The race offers various distances from children's races up to 21 km, including categories for running, canicross, walking/running, and dogtrek. The race facilities include refreshment stations for people and dogs, massages, taping, and canine physiotherapy advice, contributing to the comfort of all participants.
course_highlights: Soft routes with sandy terrain sprinkled with pine needles
Location in Kokořínsko PLA near Lake Máchovo
Refreshment stations for people and dogs at the finish and along the route
additional: Registration from 8:00, baggage storage, changing rooms, Leskros kindergarten for children (10:30 - 14:00), massages and taping for competitors, canine physiotherapy advice, rental of canicross equipment by arrangement, parking and toilets near the start. The race includes charitable activities, children's races, equipment rental options, refreshments, and an accompanying program in the natural environment of Kokořínsko PLA near Lake Máchovo.

name: Štramberský Jasoň
location: Frýdlant nad Ostravicí, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Spolek Bezva běh pro bezva lidi z. s.

description: Štramberský Jasoň is a traditional hiking and running event held on September 19, 2026, in Frýdlant nad Ostravicí and the surrounding area. It offers 22 routes of various lengths from 6 km to 67 km, including competitive and tourist variants. Participants can choose routes through Lysá hora, Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník, and other scenic locations in the Moravian-Silesian Region. At the finish in Štramberk, all registered participants receive an original medal and can order a T-shirt with a print. The event is suitable for the general public, including families with children, and offers routes adapted for strollers and seniors.
course_highlights: 22 routes from 6 km to 67 km including competitive and tourist variants
Routes pass through Lysá hora, Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník, and other natural attractions
Finish in Štramberk with an original medal for all participants
additional: Registration is only possible online. During registration, you can order a cotton T-shirt with a print for 390 CZK (children's 350 CZK). Re-registration to another participant is possible until September 11, 2026, at 20:00 via email redakce@bezvabeh.cz or on-site. The finish in Štramberk will close at 21:00. The event offers various route lengths, online registration, medals for participants, optional T-shirts, and detailed route maps available for download.

name: Havlíčkova pětka
location: Havlíčkův Brod, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při on-line registraci a zaplacení na účet do 31. května 2026

description: Havlíčkova pětka is a running race approximately 5.2 km long, primarily along cycle paths and sidewalks along the Sázava River in Havlíčkův Brod. This race is suitable for those who do not have a relay team or consider a half marathon too demanding. The start is from Havlíčkovo náměstí, and part of the registration fee is dedicated to supporting sports equipment for youth. The race is part of the Vysočina Runner Running Cup and offers refreshments at the start and finish lines.
course_highlights: The course runs on public cycle paths and sidewalks, mostly along the Sázava River
Elevation gain without significant ascent (up to 20 m)
Surface: 95% asphalt, 5% trail or paving
additional: Refreshments are provided at the start and finish areas. Starting numbers for paid registrations before September 1, 2026, include the runner's name. The race offers a medal, refreshments on the track and after the race, facilities with changing rooms, baggage and bike storage, mobile toilets, drinking water, musical accompaniment, and professional electronic chip timing with online results. 15% of each registration fee is allocated to support secondary schools and sports programs in the city. The course includes asphalt roads, trails, and paving; registration is possible online or on-site; the race supports youth sports activities and offers various supplementary events as part of the running day.

name: Běh rodným krajem Emila Zátopka
location: Kopřivnice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 400 Kč - platí pro závodníky přihlášené do 17. září 2026 - startovné se hradí na účet

tiers.label: tier_2

description: The Emila Zátopka Running Race through his native land is a traditional event dedicated to the legacy of the famous Olympian Emil Zátopek, held regularly on the Saturday closest to his birthday, September 19. The race starts in his hometown of Kopřivnice at the Emil Zátopek statue and finishes at the Wallachian Open-Air Museum in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm after a challenging 22.3 km course with a hilly profile. The race is open to participants aged 15 and older and also offers accompanying runs for children and the public. After the race, a ceremonial award ceremony takes place with the participation of prominent guests.
course_highlights: Course length of 22.3 km from Kopřivnice to Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
Surface asphalt and gravel in forest sections
Elevation gain of 375 m, undulating and hilly profile
additional: There are three refreshment stations and one hydration station along the route. The race takes place with full road traffic. The time limit is 3 hours from the start, with an intermediate cut-off at 1:20 hours in Veřovice. Changing rooms are available at the Cultural House in Kopřivnice and at the Wallachian Open-Air Museum in Rožnov. Belongings are transported by bus to the finish line. The organizer provides bus transportation from Rožnov to the start and back after the race. Accommodation at the Stadion Hotel in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm is available at the runner's expense. Participants under 18 require parental consent. The event also includes accompanying runs for children and the public. The route includes asphalt and forest paths, registration is required, team and relay races are available, transportation and accommodation are arranged, and prizes are awarded.

name: Kocelovice-Hornosín-Kocelovice
location: Kocelovice, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Cross-country race Kocelovice - Hornosín - Kocelovice is a traditional sporting event organized by the municipality of Kocelovice in the South Bohemian Region. The race takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, and participants can expect a route leading from Kocelovice to Hornosín and back. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts and those active in the scenic tourist and cycling terrain. The start and finish are at the building of the former school in Kocelovice, where the race organization also takes place. The event lasts approximately 4 hours.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque South Bohemian countryside with ideal tourist and cycling terrain
Start and finish at the building of the former school in Kocelovice
Cross-country race connecting the villages of Kocelovice and Hornosín
additional: The event lasts approximately 240 minutes (4 hours). The start and finish are at the building of the former school in Kocelovice. Organized by the Municipality of Kocelovice. The race is held annually in autumn, with the last edition in September 2023, and the next planned for September 2026. The length of the course is approximately 18 km, with varying levels of difficulty and terrain.

description: The Havlíčkobrod Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Havlíčkův Brod, which will celebrate its 14th edition in 2026. The main half marathon course runs along public cycle paths and sidewalks, mostly along the Sázava River, passing through Havlíčkův Brod Square. In addition to the main race, the event includes children's races, relays, and the shorter Havlíček Five race, allowing broad public participation across various age groups and performance levels. The race offers quality facilities, refreshments on the course and after the race, professional timing, and a rich accompanying program.
course_highlights: The course runs along public cycle paths and sidewalks, mostly along the Sázava River
A 5.2 km loop is run four times (half marathon)
Start and finish at Havlíčkův Brod Square, with no significant elevation gain
additional: The registration fee includes a race bib (with the runner's name for registrations paid by September 1, 2026), a medal, refreshments on the course and after the race, free entry to the Vysočina amusement park, facilities (changing room, baggage and bike storage, mobile toilets, drinking water, seating), musical accompaniment, event moderation, professional electronic chip timing, online results display, medical services, and race organization. The half marathon time limit is 3 hours. 15% of each registration fee is donated to support secondary schools and sports programs in the city. Children's and Havlíček Five results count towards the Vysočina Runner running cup. The event traditionally takes place in September and offers a diverse program for all age groups and levels, including relays and children's races.

name: Běh pro Hospic Anežky České
location: Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

description: The Run for the Anežka Česká Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, offering courses for all age groups. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes children's courses along forest paths and courses of 2, 5, and 10 km on rolling mixed terrain predominantly asphalt with some forest and field roads. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services. Bibs are issued from 8:15 AM, and the winners of the main race will be announced at 12:00 PM.
course_highlights: Children's courses run along forest paths
Courses of 2, 5, and 10 km on rolling mixed terrain with predominance of asphalt
Beautiful scenery of the Kostelec ponds with views of the Orlické Mountains, Krkonoše, and Hejšovina
additional: Bibs are issued from 8:15 AM, registration closes 30 minutes before the start. A small gift is prepared for the first 300 registered participants. Parking is available on a grassy meadow near Náchodská Street, about a 10-minute walk from the race venue. The race is part of the Primátor CUP 2026 running series with fair-play rules and no accompaniment of dogs, scooters, or bicycles. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, in Červený Kostelec, supports hospice services, with registration and details available on the website.

name: Jilemnice - Žalý
location: Jilemnice, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jilemnice - Žalý is an uphill running race with a total elevation gain of 569 meters, held in the picturesque environment of Jilemnice in the Liberec Region. This race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers a challenging course of 9.5 km. The start is at the square in Jilemnice, and the race is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in hilly terrain. The organizer is ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s., which ensures professional organization and support for competitors.
course_highlights: Course length of 9.5 km with an elevation gain of 569 m
Uphill run in the scenic environment of Jilemnice
Start at the square in Jilemnice
additional: The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running. The organizer is ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s., contact person Roman Koucký, phone 602 265 857. Race regulations are available for download on the official website. The race takes place on a mountain trail; registration details are not specified. Results are announced at the finish line. The event is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running.

name: Soběchlebský Š-krpál
location: Soběchleby, Olomouc, Czech Republic
organizer: místní běžečtí nadšenci ve spolupráci s obcí Soběchleby a SDH Soběchleby
price_range: 200 Kč dospělí, 150 Kč kondiční běh, děti zdarma
description: The Soběchlebský Š-krpál is a traditional running race held since 2017 around the village of Soběchleby. The main course measures approximately 11.7 km with an elevation gain of 268 meters and is 90% on field and forest paved paths. Starting in 2024, the race also includes a fitness run over 6 km, suitable for beginner runners and walkers. The start and finish are at the football field in Soběchleby, where facilities including changing rooms, showers, and refreshments are available. The accompanying program includes children's races for various age groups.
course_highlights: Main course 11.7 km with an elevation gain of 268 m
The route is 90% on field and forest paved paths
Fitness run 6 km with an elevation gain of 137 m suitable for beginners
additional: Registration for children's races is always on-site on race day. For the main race and fitness run, registration is available online or on-site until 11:30. Facilities at the football field include changing rooms, showers, and toilets. Refreshments (soup, beer/non-alcoholic drinks) are provided after the race. Parking is available nearby the venue. The route runs on field and forest paths, with start and finish at the football field, including refreshments, showers, and parking close by.

name: Černošický běh
location: Černošice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Černošice Run is a traditional running race held in Černošice, offering courses for various age groups from young children to adults. The race takes place on a field at the end of Husova Street and includes short courses for children, a family relay, and longer distances for adult runners. Starts are sequential from 14:00 to 15:40, allowing participants of different age groups to join comfortably. The event is suitable for families and competitors seeking a sporting challenge in a pleasant city environment.
course_highlights: 200 m course for children born in 2018 and younger
Family relay 3 x 900 m
Longer courses 3 km and 10 km for adults and older youth
additional: Registration begins at 13:00 and ends 30 minutes before the start of each category. Starts are sequential from 14:00 to 15:40. The venue is a field at the end of Husova Street in Černošice. Categories are divided by age and course length, including a family relay. The course is cross-country type, running on asphalt and unpaved paths; participants run at their own risk; the event is sponsored by community activities in Černošice.

name: Trail Český ráj
location: Branžež, Český ráj, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Český ráj is a popular terrain half marathon that takes you through the heart of Český ráj, including the courtyard of Kost Castle, pine groves, and sandstone cliffs. This race is a continuation of the eleventh edition of the popular ELEVEN HALF MARATHON ČESKÝ RÁJ and offers probably the most beautiful trail of a terrain half marathon in the Czech Republic. The start is at Komárovský Pond and the finish line is a reward for every runner. The race is complemented by rich services for competitors including refreshments, changing rooms, and medical services.
course_highlights: The route passes through the courtyard of Kost Castle
Surroundings of pine groves and sandstone cliffs
Terrain half marathon with beautiful natural scenery of Český ráj
additional: Start and registration take place at the race center near Komárovský Pond. There are changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, catering, and parking available near the race center. Participants will receive an original medal, a start package, an electronic chip for timing, and can use medical services. Photos and diplomas can be downloaded after the race, and the accompanying program and prizes for the top three in categories are provided. The event offers medals, start packages, refreshments, medical support, and parking. Registration is possible online with late registration options. There are also obstacle races and special categories for dogs and children.

name: PoHodová devítka
location: Velká Bíteš, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: PoHodová Devítka is a traditional running race in Velká Bíteš, held every September after the local festivities. The main course is 9 km long and suitable for all runners, with shorter distances available for children. The race offers a friendly atmosphere and is open to the general public, including categories for children and youth. The route is approximately one-third on asphalt and two-thirds on unpaved paths, run in full road traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.
course_highlights: Main course 9 km
Approximately 1/3 asphalt, 2/3 unpaved paths
Race run in full road traffic
additional: Children start according to categories from 11:00, first the youngest, then younger and older pupils. The children's race starts immediately after the main race begins. For children, there is a bouncy castle, face painting, and a small prize for everyone. A raffle for a voucher for an extended PoHodová Devítka running weekend is drawn from start numbers. Registration includes the chance to participate in the raffle for a weekend running package. The race is connected with local festivities and offers various age categories and courses.

name: Memoriál Matěje Mauera

The race is held in the picturesque location of Capartice near Plzeň and is part of the Chodsko Runner series. This race offers runners the opportunity to test their strength in a natural environment with a more challenging course profile. It is suitable for runners seeking a terrain challenge and wanting to enjoy the atmosphere of a traditional race.
course_highlights: Length of the course 9 km
Mostly forest paths
One longer ascent
additional: The race is part of the 'Best Chodsko Runner' competition, offers various age categories, and detailed results from previous editions. The event takes place on September 20, 2026.

name: 404. Malá cena Monaka
location: Slatiňany, Pardubice, Czech Republic

This race has a long-standing history and is part of the running calendar of the KRB Chrudim club. The race offers a sporting atmosphere and an opportunity to test strength on an interesting course in a beautiful environment. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Traditional running race with a long history
Course runs around Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region
Organized by the KRB Chrudim club with a rich running tradition
additional: The race includes various course lengths, including a half marathon and other runs; specific details about the routes and registration are not specified.

Part of the registration fee is donated to help the severely visually impaired, emphasizing the charitable nature of the event. In addition to the run, there is an accompanying program for all participants.
course_highlights: Choice of route on site - running or walking
Start at Míru Square at 20:00
Starter packs with a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration counters are open from 18:00. An entry ticket with a unique code (printed or on mobile) is required to enter the area. Holders of TP, ZTP, and ZTP/P cards with an escort have free entry; they can purchase a starter pack on site for 250 CZK. The race capacity is limited for safety and participant comfort. The accompanying program will be specified. Route choice at the start, accompanying program, capacity limited for safety.

organizer: Běžecký spolek z.s. a Sportuj s námi, z.s.

description: The Campus Run is a running race in Brno, held in the Bohunice area. The race features a 5.6 km loop, which is completed by both men and women in a single category. The program also includes a children's race for kids of any age with a loop length determined before the start. The event is friendly and open to all runners, offering an opportunity to explore interesting places in Brno.
course_highlights: 5.6 km loop in the University Campus area in Bohunice
Start and finish on Netroufalky Street with public transport access (bus lines 50, 60, 61, 69 and trolleybuses 25, 37)
Friendly atmosphere with a children's race and refreshments after the run
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 16:15. The children's race starts at 16:45, the main race at 17:00. After the race, water and a storage tent are available. Participants run at their own risk. Parking is available in adjacent streets. The course is 5.6 km long, registration is before the race, start in Bohunice, refreshments after the race, public transport access, facilities at the event site.

name: Eleven Večerní běh

price_range: 250 Kč pro dospělé, 100 Kč pro mládež
description: ELEVEN Evening Run is a night race over 5 km held in the late afternoon rhythm at the VOLT brewery premises in Jablonec nad Nisou. The route passes around three reservoirs and is suitable for men, women, and youth aged 16 and older, as well as children up to 15 years old. The race offers a sporting atmosphere with chip timing and valuable gifts for the first registered participants. The start and finish are located within the brewery premises, where race numbers can also be picked up.
course_highlights: The route passes around three reservoirs
Night race over 5 km
Start and finish at the VOLT brewery premises
additional: The first 50 registered participants will receive a sports headband with a special race design. The first 200 registered participants will receive a valuable gift from Dr. Oetker. Race numbers can be picked up at the start area from 18:00 to 19:30. Chip timing is provided by Datacontrol.cz. The race takes place around three lakes, registration is possible online and on-site, and prizes are prepared for the best and early registered participants.

The start is at 17:00, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and commemorative prizes for the best in each category. The race has a long-standing tradition with over 39 editions since 1992.

Approximately 30% of the course is on asphalt
The loop includes passing through the village of Věžnice and returning via forest and field paths
additional: Online registration until 12:00 on race day, possibility to use a season ticket worth 1000 CZK for start fees, runners from 3 years old can participate, prizes for the top three in each category according to the organizer's capabilities, refreshments available at the clubhouse buffet at the stadium. The race takes place on September 25, 2026, with start and facilities in Polná near Jihlava. The routes include various lengths and terrains, including the main race of 10.75 km and shorter categories.

name: Mělnický vinařský běh
location: Mělník, Mělník District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Mělník Wine Run is a traditional running race in Mělník, offering courses of 10 km and 21 km. The race takes place on a single loop with beautiful views of the castle and vineyards, with the route passing through historical and natural attractions around the town. After finishing, participants can enjoy a tasting of local wines, a commemorative glass, a free lunch, and a rich raffle. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own free races. The organizer is the association Run the World, which promotes running as a community and friendly activity.

The loop includes crossing a lock chamber and passing through Hořín Park
Refreshment stations along the route, including a turnaround point at Vrbno

The registration fee varies depending on the registration date. The event supports charitable causes to help people with cystic fibrosis. The race is limited to 500 runners.

name: Grymovská pětka
location: Grymov, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Grymovská pětka is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering athletes the opportunity to test their strength in the pleasant environment of Grymov. Liga stovkařů Olomouc is a specialized club for fitness and performance running, organizing a number of endurance races in the Olomouc region. The race is part of their running calendar and attracts runners of various age groups and performance levels. The club also supports runners in training and race preparation, ensuring a quality sporting experience.

Opportunity for both fitness and performance runners
Part of the Great Olomouc Region Endurance Race Cup

name: Běh Bohutínem
location: Fotbalové hřiště Litavan, Bohutín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic

description: The Bohutín Run is a traditional running race organized by SK Sporting Bohutín, held at the Litavan football field. The race offers courses for men of 8 km and for women of 4 km, with a surface combining asphalt and forest paths. The event also includes children's races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. The main race starts at 1:00 PM, and the atmosphere is friendly and sports-oriented.

Men run 8 km, women 4 km
Start and finish at Litavan football field

The start is at Litavan football field at 1:00 PM, the event includes children's races and runs in a natural environment with asphalt and forest sections.

name: Běh Zlínského kraje
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zlín Region Run is part of the celebrations of Zlín Region Day, which takes place on September 26, 2026, in Zlín. The event offers not only a sporting experience in the form of a 6 km run but also a cultural program, regional gastronomy, and family activities. The run is open to the general public and is part of a rich day full of entertainment, crafts, and regional products. The organizer is the Zlín Region, which supports sports and local traditions.
course_highlights: The course runs on a closed asphalt circuit in the Baťovský area
The day also includes a children's run and other sports activities
The program includes regional gastronomy, crafts, and cultural performances
additional: Regional gastronomy, run, sports and cultural program, family activities, regional products

name: Běh Velké skály
location: Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Velká skála Run is a traditional running race held in Děčín, offering courses of 11 km and 6.5 km in forest and urban terrain. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including children, for whom special races are prepared. The start is at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium, and the race atmosphere is enhanced by beautiful nature and rock formations in the surroundings. The race is already in its 56th year and is known for its exceptional atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Forest and urban terrain
Courses of 11 km and 6.5 km
Start and finish at ASK Děčín athletics stadium
additional: Registration is possible online at www.nazavody.cz with a deadline of September 23, 2026, at midnight. Payment of the entry fee must be made in advance for the lower price; on-site payment is possible at a higher price. The race office is open for late registration no later than 30 minutes before the start of the category. The course is in forest and urban terrain, registration via www.nazavody.cz, children's races and relay races are available, and the main race is part of the Děčín Running Cup.

name: Plzeňský kardioběh
location: Plzeň-Roudná, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Pilsen Cardioběh is the largest cross-country run in Pilsen with courses of 5.8 km and 10 km. The race is part of the Youth Running Cup of the Pilsen Region and also the Czech Republic Championship for medical personnel in cross-country running. It is organized by Pro Sport Activities, an agency with many years of experience in organizing sports events in Pilsen and the surrounding area. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a quality sports experience in the natural environment of Pilsen-Roudná.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in Pilsen-Roudná
Two courses: 5.8 km and 10 km
Czech Republic Championship for medical personnel in cross-country running
additional: The races include cross-country and asphalt routes, there are children's races and an accompanying program with activities. Registration is handled through the company Apachi, and parking is available at Rychtářka.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Konopiště
location: Konopiště, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: KEEN Prague Park Race - Konopiště is a running race held in the beautiful nature of Konopiště, offering a unique running experience in the picturesque environment of the Central Bohemian Region. The course runs on both paved and unpaved paths and features a combination of natural scenery and historic sites. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series, known for its relaxed atmosphere and high-quality organization. It welcomes runners of all levels who want to experience a sports challenge close to nature.
course_highlights: The course runs on both paved and unpaved paths in the nature of Konopiště
Combination of natural scenery and historic sites
Friendly atmosphere and high-quality race organization
additional: Participants can choose between an 8 km or 14 km course with the option to change the course before the race. The longer course features a refreshment station approximately at the 8th km, with refreshments also available at the finish line. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series with pre-race runs. Registration is available through irontime.cz, and payment must be made within three days of registration. The event includes a children's race, on-site registration, parking nearby, and a detailed schedule on the website. The event also features test rides and KEEN running shoe presentations.

name: 7 pohoří Beskydy
location: Ski Areál Severák, Trojanovice, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The Beskydy race takes place in the amphitheater at Horečky in Trojanovice and offers technical trails, epic views, and an atmosphere you won't experience anywhere else. The routes lead along forest paths and trails with climbs to interesting peaks and long descents. Each participant receives a commemorative medal and can look forward to refreshments and professional facilities.
course_highlights: Technical trails with an elevation gain of 1,230 meters on the main 23 km route
Routes lead along forest paths and trails with climbs to interesting peaks
Beautiful views and atmosphere in the amphitheater at Horečky in Trojanovice
additional: The race has a time limit of 4 hours, after which the runner is marked as DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration booth. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The registration fee includes chip timing, refreshments on the route and at the finish line, and a commemorative medal. The races are held at Ski Area Severák in Trojanovice, and registration includes a start number, chip timing, medal, refreshments, and facilities. The time limit is 4 hours.

name: ŠumpeRUN
location: Šumperk, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: ŠumpeRUN is a popular city running race held in the historic center of Šumperk. The eighth edition of the race will offer routes for the general public including the main race over 10 km, a 3.33 km race, relay races for three-member teams, and children's races of various lengths. The race promotes a healthy lifestyle, community cohesion, and commemorates the cultural heritage of the city. For 2026, a rich accompanying program is prepared, including group warm-ups and musical entertainment on the course.
course_highlights: The course runs through the historic center of Šumperk, a city monument zone, pedestrian zones, and parks
The main race is 10 km long, consisting of three laps of 3.33 km with a total elevation gain of approximately 60 meters
Children's races are held in Sady 1. máje park with distances from 100 m to 2 km depending on age
additional: Registration begins on June 1, 2026. Children's races have free entry. A joint warm-up with professional instructors will take place before the start of children (10:30) and adults (14:00). There will be musical accompaniment on the course by a DJ or live band. The start and finish are at Svoboda Square near Hotel PERK and the Business Academy. The capacity of the main race is 350 runners, 100 runners for the 3 km race, 50 relay teams, and 100 children in each category. The race is aimed at the general public, offers various categories, and results are available online. The event is part of the local sports calendar and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: K3-run
location: Krčmani, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: K3 - Krčmaňský běh přes tři vrcholy is a race with a length of 11.3 km and an elevation gain of approximately 350 meters. The route takes runners through beautiful scenery over three peaks, mostly on paved paths and partially on grass with a predominantly hard surface. This race offers athletes a pleasant experience in nature and a challenge in the form of uphill running and trail running.
course_highlights: Race length 11.3 km
Elevation gain approx. 350 m
Route passes over three peaks mostly on paved paths
additional: The race is mainly on paved paths and grass, suitable for runners of all levels, and offers beautiful views of the surrounding landscape.

name: Běchovice - Praha, MČR v silničním běhu mužů, žen, juniorů a juniorek
location: Běchovice, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Běchovice - Prague is a legendary road race over 10 km with the longest uninterrupted tradition in Europe, held for the 130th time. The race is the official Czech national championship in road running and offers a challenging course of 10,031 meters, which will test every runner. The race atmosphere is exceptional and complemented by modern facilities, including an accompanying program and commemorative medals. The race is open to a wide range of categories from juniors to veterans and also offers a relay race.
course_highlights: The course measures 10,031 meters, 31 meters longer than the traditional 10 km
Start in Běchovice, finish at Pražačka in Prague
Official Czech national championship in 10 km road running with 26 categories
additional: Start numbers are issued at the Masaryk Railway Station hall in Prague on the days before the race and on race day in Běchovice. The race offers a functional Joma T-shirt and a commemorative medal included in the registration fee. The relay race starts simultaneously with the 3rd wave of the race at 11:50, consisting of 4 members with predetermined segments. The race capacity is 3,333 runners. Photos and personalized videos from the race are free of charge. The race is part of the celebrations and tradition of running sports in Prague, offering online registration and start in Českobrodská Street in Běchovice.

name: Běh metropole Praha 1
location: Praha 1, Centrum Prahy, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Metropole Run is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and community belonging among residents. The race is open to all age categories, from children to seniors and people with disabilities, who represent their city district. Each start provides points for the competition for the most athletic district of Prague. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with unique medals and gifts for participants.
course_highlights: Races take place in different districts of Prague, including the city center
Support for a healthy lifestyle and community spirit among Prague residents
Categories for all age groups including people with disabilities
additional: Each participant represents their city district based on permanent residence and contributes to the point evaluation of the districts. The project emphasizes competition among Prague districts for the title of the most athletic district. Participants receive original medals and running magnets for their race bibs as souvenirs. The races feature various distances, are part of a series with medals and updates on the event locations; registration is available online and on-site.

name: Ivančická hodinovka
location: Městský stadion Ivančice, Ivančice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Ivančice Hour Race is a traditional athletic event organized by the Ivančice Athletic Club, held at the Ivančice Municipal Stadium. The race takes place at the stadium near Malovaný mlýn and offers a sporting experience in a pleasant city environment with a rich history. The start is scheduled for the morning, allowing participants to enjoy the race and other activities in Ivančice. The event is suitable for the general public and sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Race at Ivančice Municipal Stadium
Pleasant sporting environment in a historic town
Start at 10:30 AM
additional: The race is organized by the Ivančice Athletic Club at the FC Ivančice field on Malovansko. The venue is Ivančice Municipal Stadium, U Malovaného mlýna no. 1515, 664 91 Ivančice. The race offers chip timing, online and on-site registration options, and is part of the local sports tradition.

name: Svatováclavský běh Blažovicemi
location: Blažovice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Spolek přátel Svatováclavského běhu - sdružení Vévoda
description: The Svatováclavský Run in Blažovice is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the picturesque environment of Blažovice in the South Moravian Region. It offers two main routes of 10 km and 5 km, which mainly follow natural paths and forest sections. The event also includes fun runs and children's races ranging from 50 to 1100 meters, making the race attractive to the general public and families with children. The organizer is the Association of Friends of the Svatováclavský Run, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail character of the routes
Two main routes: 10 km and 5 km
Fun runs and children's races from 50 to 1100 meters
additional: The race starts at the football field in Blažovice. The main category begins at 12:45 PM. The organizer is the Association of Friends of the Svatováclavský Run - Vévoda association, contact person František Kubínek, phone 739 150 283. The race is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletic Federation. It is part of the local running tradition and offers various race lengths including children's categories, making the event suitable for the whole family.

name: Běh Neumannovou stezkou
location: Unhošť, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: The Neumannová Trail Run is a traditional running race organized by the T. J. Sokol Unhošť running club in the picturesque forested surroundings of Unhošť. The race offers an opportunity for outdoor sports activity and is complemented by children's runs. Registered participants in advance benefit from a lower entry fee. The event has a long-standing tradition and is regularly held in the fall.
course_highlights: Picturesque forested surroundings of Unhošť
Traditional running race with children's runs
Natural terrain suitable for running
additional: The race includes children's runs. Pre-registered participants have a cheaper entry fee. Results and statistics are regularly published on the website. Trail maps are available in a photo album. The start is scheduled for September 28, 2026, at 10:00 AM. Exact registration details are not provided. The event is suitable for the general running public.

name: MilešovKa(p)
location: Teplice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: MilešovKa(p) is a traditional running race from Teplice to Milešovka, covering a distance of 17.5 km with an elevation gain of 846 meters. The course runs on asphalt, hiking trails, field and forest paths and is marked with red and blue signs by the Czech Tourist Club. The race is open to the general public and offers awards for the best in categories, mountain climbers, and age record holders. It is organized by the SPONA Teplice association, which supports amateur sports in the region. The results are announced together with other running events in November.
course_highlights: Distance of 17.5 km with an elevation gain of 846 m
Surface: asphalt, hiking trail, field and forest paths
Course marked with red and blue signs by the Czech Tourist Club
additional: Awards for the top five in each category, medals and diplomas, trophies for winners and teams, bonuses for mountain climbers and the fastest Václav, plaques for five and ten consecutive participations. The course is marked by the Czech Tourist Club. Results are announced in November together with BĚKODO. Registration is open until August 31, 2025. Participants will receive a T-shirt and a race medal. The race is part of a series of local runs in Teplice.

name: Běh kolem Panské skály
location: Kamenicko Šenov-Prácheň, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The run around Panská Skála is a popular trail race held on September 28, 2026, in Kamenický Šenov-Prácheň in the Liberec Region. The race offers routes of 3 km and 6 km, which lead through hilly terrain around Panská Skála, and is part of the District Running League of Česká Lípa. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and experienced competitors, providing a unique outdoor running experience with beautiful views.
course_highlights: Trail routes through hilly terrain with views of Panská Skála
Two distances: 3 km and 6 km suitable for various levels of runners
Included in the District Running League of Česká Lípa
additional: The race is supported by local organizations, results and regulations are regularly published, the event has a long tradition and attracts runners from the surrounding area as well as from across the country.

name: Podzimní běh projektantů "Od hospody k hospodě"
location: Krčský les, Praha 4-Krč, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Autumn runners' project "From pub to pub" is a traditional running event held in the picturesque environment of Krč Forest in Prague 4-Krč. This race is popular among runners and has been organized for many years, welcoming all running enthusiasts and nature lovers. Organizers Pepa Krejčí and Honza Vočko warmly invite you to participate in this popular course, which offers a pleasant experience in nature. Registrations are accepted on the day of the race approximately one hour before the start.
course_highlights: The route runs through the picturesque Krč Forest
A traditional running course popular among local runners
Pleasant natural environment in Prague 4-Krč
additional: Registrations for the race are accepted on the day of the event about 1 hour before the start. Running course in Krč Forest, event for design enthusiasts and runners
